*Zhaolu Kang,Tailong Luo,Lei Wei,Guangyuan Dong,Sihan Liu,Yingjie He,Siheng Wang,Shuaibo Li,Rongchao Zhang,Zhen Tian,Richeng Xuan,Zhichao Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文指出视频世界模型的像素MSE与策略收益不匹配，提出双层框架DRILL，直接以想象rollout后GRPO更新的策略回报为目标训练世界模型，给出闭式代理(DRILL-VWI)与全元梯度(DRILL-IMG)两种实现，在五个操作仿真器和两种VLA骨干上将平均成功率较WMPO提升13.1分、较RLVR-World提升7.9分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在强化学习后训练VLA策略时，世界模型用于减少真实环境交互，但其训练目标通常是单步像素预测。该目标与"产生能改进策略的学习信号"这一实际用途存在错配：更低的像素MSE可能带来更差的策略梯度；反之，以策略效用训练的世界模型即使下一帧像素MSE高17%，也能得到更好的下游策略。

Method: 提出DRILL双层框架：内层在想象rollout上执行GRPO更新，外层更新世界模型以最大化更新后的策略回报。两个实例化：DRILL-VWI为无需额外仿真器rollout的闭式代理，按策略访问分布、GRPO组相对优势和模型置信度对预测误差重新加权；DRILL-IMG为完整元梯度方法，通过截断Hessian-向量积对内层更新求导。理论上证明在score-compatibility与小残差假设下，DRILL-VWI可恢复DRILL-IMG元梯度的局部单步分量。

Result: 在五个操作仿真器和两种VLA骨干上，DRILL-IMG的平均成功率较WMPO提升13.1个百分点、较RLVR-World提升7.9个百分点，且与RLVR预训练互补而非竞争。

Conclusion: 用于VLA强化学习的视频世界模型可依据其产生的策略梯度来训练，而不仅依赖像素级预测；以策略效用为对齐目标的世界模型训练是可行且有效的。

Abstract: World models are increasingly used to reduce environment interaction when post-training vision-language-action (VLA) policies with reinforcement learning. Yet they are typically trained to predict pixels one step ahead, even though their role here is not merely to render visually faithful videos but to produce learning signals from imagined rollouts that improve the policy. We show that this mismatch is substantial: lower pixel MSE can produce worse policy gradients, and a world model trained for policy utility can yield better downstream policies despite 17% higher pixel MSE on the next frame. We propose the Downstream-Return Imagination Learning Loop (DRILL), a bilevel framework that updates the world model to maximize the policy's return after an inner GRPO update on imagined rollouts. DRILL has two instantiations. DRILL-VWI is a closed-form surrogate, requiring no additional simulator rollouts, that reweights prediction errors by policy visitation, the group-relative GRPO advantage, and model confidence. DRILL-IMG is a full meta-gradient method that differentiates through the inner update using truncated Hessian-vector products. We show that DRILL-VWI recovers the local one-step component of the DRILL-IMG meta-gradient under score-compatibility and small-residual assumptions. Across five manipulation simulators and two VLA backbones, DRILL-IMG raises mean success rate by 13.1 points over WMPO and 7.9 points over RLVR-World, and complements RLVR pretraining rather than competing with it. More broadly, we believe video world models for VLA reinforcement learning can be productively trained by the policy gradients they produce, not only by pixel-level prediction.

</details>


### [36] [Loop to Look Better: Learning Adaptive Depth for Question-Guided Perception in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30824)
*Wencheng Ye,Anning Hu,Hongye Fang,Tianyi Wang,Junchi Yan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LoopLook 是一个编码器侧的轻量循环感知框架，通过在中后层视觉编码器中循环回访并注入问题表征，使预训练 VLM 获得自适应视觉深度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 VLM 虽支持更长推理，但视觉 token 仍由单次、任务无关的编码器前向生成，形成"证据获取瓶颈"：模型推理更久却未精炼回答问题所需的视觉证据。作者主张感知应像推理一样迭代、任务导向。

Method: 在视觉编码器的中后层窗口上循环回访；每个循环注入问题表征以引导视觉精炼；学习式停止机制自适应决定循环深度；token 级 Mixture-of-Looks (MoL) 融合不同循环的表示，使每个视觉 token 选择性整合跨步信息。框架为轻量插件，适配预训练 VLM。

Result: 在 4 个骨干和 8 个基准上一致优于基线，MMStar 最高提升 8.6%，HallusionBench 提升 8.1%；TTFT 仅增加 5.1–6.5%。分析显示其逐步精炼视觉注意力、按任务难度自适应分配深度，并在降低输入分辨率时更好保留任务相关视觉信息。

Conclusion: 通过将循环从推理引入感知，LoopLook 把视觉感知从一次性瞥见转变为自适应循环精炼过程。

Abstract: Visual perception should be iterative and task-directed, with representations refined in response to the question and the need for further processing. While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) increasingly support extended reasoning, their visual tokens are still typically acquired in a single, task-agnostic encoder pass. This creates an evidence-acquisition bottleneck: models may reason longer without refining the visual evidence needed to answer the question. We propose LoopLook, a lightweight encoder-side recurrent perception framework that equips pretrained VLMs with adaptive visual depth. LoopLook recurrently revisits a middle-to-late window of the vision encoder, injecting question representations at each loop to guide visual refinement. A learned stopping mechanism adaptively determines the recurrent depth, while a token-wise Mixture-of-Looks (MoL) combines representations from different loops, allowing each visual token to selectively integrate information acquired across recurrent steps. Across four backbones and eight benchmarks, LoopLook consistently improves performance over the baseline, yielding gains of up to 8.6% on MMStar and 8.1% on HallusionBench. Our analysis shows that LoopLook progressively refines visual attention and adaptively allocates depth according to task difficulty. It also better preserves task-relevant visual information under reduced input resolution, while increasing time to first token (TTFT) by only 5.1-6.5%. By bringing recurrence from reasoning back into perception, LoopLook transforms visual perception from a one-shot glimpse into an adaptive process of recurrent refinement.

</details>


### [37] [One Evaluation Is Enough: Inversion-Free Image Editing with Trajectory Correction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30827)
*Lifan Jiang,Taiyang Chen,Senlin cheng,Bolei Xu,Xiaobo Li,Can Ye,Dehai Zhao,Deng Cai,Boxi Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Endpoint-Calibrated Transport (ECT)：利用VP一步模型中单次查询的"对偶性"（角语义切向+干净端点位移），以切向积分得到名义一步传输、再以端点位移经约束投影校正，实现无需反演、单次噪声级、一次潜变量更新的闭式免训练编辑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实图像编辑通常依赖反演与迭代采样，效率低；高效的一步编辑器则需在多个噪声级上估计并平均编辑场以稳定大更新。作者追问更严格的问题：单次时序场评估是否足以支撑可靠的免反演编辑。

Method: 基于方差保持(VP)一步模型中此前未被充分利用的对偶性：在共享噪声状态下的单个源-目标查询，同时确定局部角度语义切向与干净端点位移。将切向沿解析已知的剩余VP角度积分，得到名义一步传输；再用端点位移通过约束投影校正其长跨度外推。构造为"先传输、后校正"的闭式、免训练编辑器，仅需1个噪声级、2个文本条件打包进一个去噪器批次、1次潜变量更新，可直接用于预训练的epsilon预测VP一步生成器。

Result: 在报告的基准设置中，ECT在极短编辑时间内在编辑质量上取得稳定提升。

Conclusion: 单次时序场评估足以实现可靠的一步免反演编辑；ECT无需图像反演、轨迹积分、第二次时序观测或迭代优化，兼顾效率与编辑质量。

Abstract: Real-image editing commonly relies on inversion and iterative sampling, while efficient one-step editors often stabilize a large update by estimating and averaging editing fields at multiple noise levels. We ask a stricter question: is a single temporal field evaluation sufficient for reliable inversion-free editing? Our answer rests on a previously underused duality in a variance-preserving (VP) one-step model: one source-target query at a shared noisy state simultaneously determines a local angular semantic tangent and a clean endpoint displacement. We integrate the tangent over the analytically known remaining VP angle to obtain a nominal one-step transport, and use the endpoint displacement to correct its long-horizon extrapolation through a constrained projection. This transport-first, correction-second construction yields Endpoint-Calibrated Transport (ECT), a closed-form, training-free editor requiring only one noise level, two text conditions packed into one denoiser batch, and one latent update. ECT requires no image inversion, trajectory integration, second temporal observation, or iterative optimization, and can be directly applied to pretrained epsilon-prediction VP one-step generators. Across the reported benchmark settings, ECT delivers stable gains in editing quality within an extremely short editing time.

</details>


### [38] [RECAP: Looking Once Is Not Enough for Vision-Language Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30834)
*Zhaolu Kang,Tailong Luo,Chenxin Li,Yingjie He,Zhenyu Yu,Fengyu Zhou,Jiachen Qian,Lei Wei,Shuang Chen,Jiachen Li,Eric Hanchen Jiang,Rongchao Zhang,Zhengtao Yao,Hoi Leong Lee,Guansu Wang,Kaiyue Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出视觉回访（visual revisit）现象并据此设计RECAP训练方法，将回访轨迹转化为信用分配信号，在多个VLM上稳定提升图像根基推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长链思维推理提升视觉语言模型性能，但存在时序性根基失效：推理过程中模型会逐渐偏离图像证据，而强化学习仅提供最终答案奖励，无法对中间步骤进行有效信用分配。

Method: 先以"视觉回访"（推理中时序局部化的图像证据再激活）为切入点做诊断与因果分析（遮蔽峰值、注入峰值、对照分析排除注意力强度/不确定性/logit margin/隐状态范数）；再提出RECAP——GRPO兼容方法，利用分离的回访轨迹做信用分配，包含回访条件优势估计、动态折扣与门控价值预测，无需额外奖励、额外采样或推理期改动。

Result: 回访峰值可预测正确性且具因果作用；在Qwen2.5-VL-7B、InternVL3-8B、LLaVA-OV-7B上，RECAP稳定优于GRPO与VPPO，相对SFT基座在HallusionBench提升+6.1~+6.5，并保持推理与纯文本性能；更大LoRA模型、中文零样本、视觉扰动与人工评测均验证鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 视觉回访是连接中间推理步与最终奖励的有效桥梁，RECAP以低成本方式实现步骤级信用分配，显著增强图像根基推理的鲁棒性。

Abstract: Long chain-of-thought reasoning improves vision-language models (VLMs), but it also exposes a temporal grounding failure: as generation unfolds, models may drift from image evidence while reinforcement learning still provides only a final-answer reward. We study this gap through visual revisit, a temporally localized reactivation of image evidence during reasoning. Across three VLM backbones, revisit peaks are predictive of correctness and causally linked to performance: masking them degrades accuracy more than masking non-peaks, while injecting revisit-like peaks into failed rollouts partially restores correct answers. Control analyses show that this signal is not explained by raw attention strength, uncertainty, logit margin, or hidden-state norm. We propose RECAP, a GRPO-compatible training method that turns detached revisit traces into a credit-assignment signal. RECAP uses revisit-conditioned advantage estimation, dynamic discounting, and gated value prediction to propagate final rewards through visually important reasoning steps, without extra rewards, additional rollouts, or inference-time changes. Across Qwen2.5-VL-7B, InternVL3-8B, and LLaVA-OV-7B, RECAP consistently improves over GRPO and VPPO, yielding $+6.1$--$+6.5$ HallusionBench gains over the SFT base while preserving reasoning and text-only performance. Results on larger LoRA-tuned models, Chinese zero-shot benchmarks, visual perturbations, and human evaluation further demonstrate robust improvements in image-grounded reasoning.

</details>


### [39] [CAVC: Convergence-Adaptive Audio-Visual Cache for Modality-Asymmetric Diffusion Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30854)
*Lifan Jiang,Yibo Zhao,Senlin cheng,Bolei Xu,Xiaobo Li,Can Ye,Dehai Zhao,Deng Cai,Boxi Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练的音视频非对称缓存框架CAVC，仅缓存音频分支计算、保留视频全量精化，实现1.10–1.35倍加速并改善视觉动态指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有扩散式音视频生成在整个采样轨迹上对音频与视频潜变量做均匀的联合去噪，每个时间步都重复执行模态专属去噪分支与跨模态注意力，计算开销大；作者观察到"模态非对称可恢复性"：中途缓存导致的音频侧漂移可被末端少量联合去噪步显著消除，而视频侧退化（运动与时序细节丢失）不可恢复，故均匀联合计算并非必要。

Method: 提出Convergence-Adaptive Audio-Visual Cache（CAVC），一种免训练的模态非对称缓存框架，采用"三明治"式计算分配：先检测音频去噪器输出进入缓存容忍区间，随后在中间阶段缓存并复用音频去噪器输出，跳过音频去噪与跨模态注意力，同时视频分支保持独立的时空精化；末端恢复少量联合步以减小累积的跨模态漂移并提升同步性。

Result: 在多个公开基准上取得1.10–1.35倍实际耗时（wall-clock）加速，多项视觉动态与时序统计指标提升，同时保持有竞争力的音频保真度与音视频对齐性能。

Conclusion: 模态非对称可恢复性可作为音视频扩散模型推理加速的设计依据；有选择地缓存可恢复的音频侧计算、完整保留视频侧精化，能够在几乎不损失生成质量（甚至改善视觉动态）的前提下显著降低计算成本，且无需额外训练。

Abstract: Diffusion-based audio-visual generation methods typically perform joint denoising of audio and video latents throughout the entire sampling trajectory, repeatedly executing modality-specific denoising branches and cross-modal attention at every timestep. However, we observe that such uniform joint computation is not always necessary. The key is a modality-asymmetric recoverability: audio-side drift introduced by mid-stage caching can be substantially reduced by only a few terminal joint denoising steps, whereas video-side degradation caused by caching leads to persistent loss of motion and temporal details. This asymmetry suggests that inference acceleration should selectively cache recoverable audio-side computation while preserving full video refinement. Motivated by this observation, we propose \textbf{Convergence-Adaptive Audio-Visual Cache (CAVC)}, a training-free modality-asymmetric caching framework. CAVC adopts a sandwich-structured computation allocation: after detecting that audio denoiser outputs enter a cache-tolerant regime, it caches and reuses the audio denoiser output to bypass audio denoising and cross-modal attention in the middle stage, while the video branch continues independent spatio-temporal refinement; a few joint steps are then restored at the end to reduce accumulated cross-modal drift and improve synchronization. Experiments across multiple public benchmarks demonstrate that CAVC achieves 1.10--1.35x wall-clock acceleration, improves several visual dynamics and temporal statistics, and maintains competitive audio fidelity and audio-visual alignment.

</details>


### [40] [Direct Forcing: A Single-Stage Training Recipe for Few-Step Autoregressive Text-to-Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30861)
*Haojun Xu,Jie Huang,Xin Lu,Mingchen Zhong,Zihao Fan,Linjiang Huang,Si Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Direct Forcing 单阶段框架，将因果适配与分布匹配统一，使预训练双向视频模型直接学得四步自回归生成器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有少步自回归视频生成训练将因果适配与分布匹配割裂：表示类文生视频方法从 ODE 初始化检查点出发，需要单独初始化阶段，且当目标分布直接由参考视频定义时这种分离并不必要。

Abstract: Concept bottleneck models (CBMs) let clinicians inspect and correct skin disease diagnoses through clinical concepts, but only if the concept annotations are reliable.   <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Lifting vision-language features such as CLIP into 3D Gaussian reconstructions enables open-vocabulary segmentation through natural-language queries. Although CLIP represents a broad range of semantic concepts, the lifted features of individual scenes can exhibit strong directional concentration, while raw cosine similarity does not account for the scene-specific feature distribution. We show that substantial segmentation gains can be obtained by changing how a fixed lifted feature field is compared with text. Our method partially subtracts a shared scene direction from visual features and text prototypes and whitens text prototypes using a fixed reference vocabulary of generic terms. It then uses soft clustering for multiclass prediction and CSLS with a relevance margin against the reference vocabulary for single-query prediction. Beyond reducing directional concentration, scene centering improves class-relative feature separation in every evaluated scene. Across seven lifting methods and four datasets, the resulting query-time calibration consistently improves mean intersection over union in both multiclass and single-query segmentation. </details>

*Pengfeng Song,Shaozhong Zhang,Pengfei Shao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出分层细粒度跨模态对齐框架HFCMA，通过动态粒度发现构建自适应视觉区域与文本短语，并以熵正则最优传输实现结构化区域-短语匹配，提升细粒度图文检索判别力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 细粒度图文检索需同时建模全局语义一致性与局部视觉证据（对象、属性、数量、动作、关系），以区分语义相近候选。现有方法采用固定图像块、检测区域或文本token作为匹配单元，并通过最大池化、交叉注意力或相似度累加聚合局部交互，在语义单元构建与全局匹配一致性上存在局限。

Abstract: Fine-grained image-text retrieval requires a model not only to assess global semantic consistency between an image and a text, but also to model visual evidence for local textual semantics, including objects, attributes, quantities, actions, and relations, so as to distinguish semantically similar candidates. Existing methods commonly use fixed image patches, detected regions, or text tokens as the basic matching units and then aggregate local interactions through max pooling, cross attention, or similarity accumulation. Such strategies remain limited in semantic unit construction and global matching consistency. This paper proposes a hierarchical fine-grained cross-modal alignment framework, termed HFCMA. The framework progressively transforms low-level patch and token representations into adaptive visual regions and textual phrases, and then performs structured region-phrase matching within a global retrieval scoring process. Specifically, HFCMA first adopts dynamic granularity discovery (DGD) to aggregate raw patches and tokens into semantically compact visual regions and textual phrases. It then formulates region-phrase matching as an entropy-regularized optimal transport problem, thereby estimating a structured alignment matrix under global marginal constraints. To reduce background noise and local semantic drift, HFCMA further introduces background debiasing, textual importance weighting, and prototype consistency regularization. Experiments on Flickr30K and MS-COCO show that HFCMA effectively combines dynamic semantic unit construction with OT-based structured matching under a dual-encoder retrieval framework. The resulting fine-grained score provides structured local alignment information for candidate ranking and improves the discrimination of subtle semantic differences.

</details>

*Nimrod Shabtay,Asaf Yehudai,Avihu Dekel,Eli Schwartz,Raja Giryes*

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLMs的in-context learning能力显著弱于纯文本模型。初步研究发现VLM依赖文本捷径（textual shortcuts），对视觉示例利用不足。作者据此假设：VLM并未被充分训练以进行视觉上下文学习(vICL)，问题出在训练数据缺失而非模型能力上限。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) struggle with in context learning compared to their textual counterparts. Our preliminary study shows that VLMs rely on textual shortcuts and underutilize the visual demonstrations. We therefore hypothesize that VLMs are insufficiently trained to perform visual in-context learning (vICL). To this end, we construct MIME, a task-agnostic vICL training set without textual shortcuts. We ensure the instruction does not state the rule linking the demonstration images to their answers, so the model must infer it from the visual demonstrations. Fine-tuning on MIME improves vICL accuracy by 8.1 to 18.0 points across three VLMs, preserves single-image performance, and improves multi-image and text only in-context learning. In contrast, stating the rule in the training data sharply reduces this gain. We further propose DTAD (Demonstration Text Attention Dropout), which randomly withholds demonstration labels during training so that the VLM must infer the rule from the demonstration images. While achieving comparable vICL accuracy to fine-tuning on MIME, DTAD yields more consistent attention to the demonstration images. On TrueMICL, Qwen3-VL-8B trained on MIME matches frontier models such as Claude Opus 5, and surpasses them with DTAD. Finally, adding MIME to the instruction-tuning mix of LLaVA 1.5 13B more than doubles its vICL accuracy without hurting single-image abilities, whereas a same-size multi-image set improves it only slightly. These results suggest that vICL data should be a standard component of VLM training.

</details>

*Songlin Yang,Zhe Wang,Xiaotong Zhao,Xi Wang,Ran Zhang,Shuai Li,Taiyi Wu,Songlian Li,Eric Liu,Alan Zhao,Anyi Rao*

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电影级视频生成需要两项能力：从稀疏（而非逐帧）引导中进行时序推断，以及对角色、场景、动作、镜头进行因子感知控制。MLLM虽具备相关先验，但其表示并不能直接用于视频生成：DiT可能通过原生条件通路绕开MLLM潜变量，且使用MLLM并不保证因子可控或具备可生成兼容的时序预测能力。

Method: 1）潜变量专用生成器接地：冻结MLLM与连接器，仅以MLLM潜变量训练DiT，强化其对该潜表示的实际依赖；2）因子跨度替换：用配对视频指定目标因子变化与非目标保持，训练DiT在输出中实现该关系，实现因子感知控制；3）时序推断：以纯文本与“文本+完整视频”两种观测共享同一视频目标，冻结已训练DiT，反向通过DiT优化MLLM与连接器，使有限输入表示适配生成，同时保留完整观测重建作为互补训练模式。

Result: 在稀疏到视频、因子感知编辑、多镜头生成三类电影级视频生成任务上，性能一致优于基线；消融验证FAPL对MLLM特征利用、时序控制与因子协同均有贡献。

Conclusion: 将MLLM潜表示的有效使用视为共享前提，并以互补学习信号分别针对因子控制与时序推断，是耦合MLLM与视频DiT的可行范式；分阶段解耦训练可避免DiT绕开潜变量，并获得兼顾控制性与时序预测的生成能力。

Abstract: Cinematic video generation requires both temporal inference from limited inputs (i.e., sparse rather than frame-by-frame guidance) and factor-aware control of character, scene, action, and camera. Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) offer useful priors for both capabilities, but their representations are not automatically actionable for video generation: a Video Diffusion Transformer (DiT) may bypass them through native conditioning pathways, and using them does not ensure either factor-aware control or generation-compatible temporal prediction. We propose Factor-Aware Predictive Learning (FAPL), which establishes effective MLLM latent use as a shared prerequisite and then targets the two capabilities with complementary learning signals. First, latent-only generator grounding trains the DiT with a frozen MLLM and connector, strengthening the DiT's use of MLLM latents for generation. Second, for factor-aware control, paired videos specify a target-factor change and non-target preservation, and factor-span replacement trains the DiT to realize this relationship in its output. Third, for temporal inference, text-only and text-plus-complete-video observations share a video target, and the trained DiT is then frozen while the MLLM and connector are optimized through it. This final stage trains limited-input representations for generation while retaining complete-observation reconstruction as a complementary training mode. Extensive experiments demonstrate our consistently better performance on three cinematic video generation tasks (i.e., sparse-to-video, factor-aware editing, and multi-shot generation) over baselines and validate FAPL's contributions to MLLM feature use, temporal control, and factor coordination.

</details>

Abstract: Auxiliary patient data can improve chest X-ray report generation, but directly concatenating heterogeneous clinical information with visual tokens produces long, variable-length decoder prompts and may expose the model to redundant or image-irrelevant context. In Stage~2, it improves RadGraph-F1 from 24.00 to 28.86, CXR-BERT similarity from 56.86 to 62.80, and BLEU-4 from 5.14 to 7.96 compared with CXRMate-ED, while reducing the average prompt length from 373.89 to 288.37 tokens, corresponding to a 22.9\% reduction. Abstract: Combined hepatocellular-cholangiocarcinomas (cHCC-CCA) are a type of cancer that share components of two other primary liver cancers: hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) and cholangiocarcinoma (CCA). ### [50] [GraphCAD: Geometry-Aware Diffusion on Edge-Adjacency Graphs for CAD Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30974)
*Wenhao Zheng,Xianggen Liu,Li Yue,Jiancheng Shi,Jiancheng Lv*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GraphCAD 以边邻接图(EAG)为核心表示，用混合图扩散联合建模离散拓扑与连续几何，并引入几何感知去噪实现B-rep CAD生成，构建EAGBench数据集，在多面复杂模型上取得SOTA几何保真度与分布对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: B-rep CAD 中离散拓扑连通性与精确空间几何相互耦合，而现有序列建模范式缺乏显式拓扑归纳偏置，难以刻画这种交互。

Method: 提出 Edge-Adjacency Graph (EAG) 图表示；采用混合图扩散同时建模 EAG 的离散与连续分量；几何感知去噪机制将节点属性渲染为空间点集，经 SE(3)-等变骨干编码后融合回节点表示；并构建大规模工程 CAD 数据集 EAGBench。

Abstract: Generative modeling for Computer-Aided Design (CAD) remains fundamentally challenged by the need to capture the intricate interplay between discrete topological connectivity and precise spatial geometry inherent in Boundary Representations (B-reps). Existing generative approaches largely formulate CAD construction as a sequence modeling problem, but consequently lack an explicit topological inductive bias. In this work, we present GraphCAD, a geometry-aware generative framework that centers modeling on the Edge-Adjacency Graph (EAG), a novel graph-based CAD representation tailored for generative tasks. GraphCAD adopts a hybrid graph diffusion formulation to jointly model the discrete and continuous components of EAG and introduces a geometry-aware denoising mechanism that renders node attributes into spatial point sets. These point sets are encoded by an SE(3)-equivariant backbone and fused into the node representations, thereby grounding the generative process in physical geometry. To support this study, we construct EAGBench, a large-scale dataset of engineering CAD models. Extensive experiments show that GraphCAD can generate complex CAD models with more than 50 faces and achieves state-of-the-art performance in geometric fidelity and distributional alignment compared with sequence-based baselines.

</details>

*Ignacy Kolton,Wenxuan Li,Zongwei Zhou,Jarosław B. Ćwikła,Arkadiusz Sitek,Pedro R. A. S. Bassi,Szymon Płotka*

TL;DR: 提出DLoss，一种架构无关、可微的序列级目标函数，直接作用于解码器token概率，通过非对称池化鼓励参考报告支持的诊断在至少一个位置获得足够概率、并在所有位置抑制不支持的诊断，从而提升3D MedVLM放射报告生成的诊断忠实度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有医学视觉语言模型多用token级最大似然训练，偏好文本表层一致性而非诊断关键术语，导致漏报关键诊断和引入错误诊断；作者将这一问题归因于常规语言建模目标与放射报告"支持诊断须明确表述、不支持诊断须避免"的非对称诊断需求之间的目标错位。

Conclusion: 非对称序列级监督对放射报告生成具有价值，可在不改变模型结构与推理成本的前提下纠正语言建模目标与诊断需求间的错位；代码已开源。

Abstract: Automated radiology report generation requires models to do more than produce fluent clinical narratives: they must explicitly state supported diagnoses while avoiding unsupported ones. However, existing medical vision-language models (MedVLMs) are typically trained with token-level maximum likelihood objectives, which prioritize text agreement over diagnostically critical terms. As a result, models can miss key diagnoses and introduce wrong ones. We identify this as an objective misalignment between conventional language modeling and the asymmetric diagnostic requirements of radiology reporting. To encode these requirements, we introduce Diagnostic Loss (DLoss), a differentiable, architecture-agnostic objective that operates directly on decoder token probabilities. DLoss separately aggregates probability mass over vocabularies associated with diagnoses supported by the reference report and with unsupported alternatives. Using asymmetric pooling across token positions in the report, it encourages supported diagnoses to receive sufficient probability in at least one position while suppressing spurious probability spikes for unsupported diagnoses across all positions during training. The loss can be applied to existing 3D MedVLMs without modifying their vision backbones, language decoders, or inference procedures, and introduces no additional inference-time computation. We train and evaluate DLoss on 50,000 abdominal CT scans across several 3D MedVLM architectures on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution report-generation benchmarks. Across these settings, DLoss improves diagnostic faithfulness while maintaining competitive performance on conventional language-generation metrics, showing the value of asymmetric sequence-level supervision for radiology report generation. The code for DLoss is available at https://github.com/gmum/DLoss.

</details>


### [52] [ResGVC: Residual Coding for High-fidelity Generative Video Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31039)
*Ding Ding,Daowen Li,Ying Chen,Kai Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ResGVC 提出一种面向生成式视频压缩的残差编码框架，通过传输逐去噪步的残差段为扩散去噪提供显式源约束，并在像素域直接去噪，配合以扩散 Transformer 为熵模型的残差编解码器，在 LPIPS 与 PSNR 上分别取得 63.7% 和 83.8% 的 BD-rate 降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 GVC 方法多在潜空间依赖解码端扩散模型生成式先验去噪，缺乏对原始信号的显式约束，且潜表示瓶颈带来不可逆信息损失，限制重建保真度。

Method: 先用学习型视频编解码器编码原始视频，将编解码重建与原始图像之间的失真分解为一系列残差段，每个去噪步对应一段残差；残差段由新型残差编解码器压缩，并以扩散 Transformer 作为熵模型；去噪直接在像素空间进行，整个去噪过程引入显式源约束。

Conclusion: 以残差传输实现显式源约束、以扩散先验增强熵建模、以像素域去噪规避潜瓶颈，是提升生成式视频压缩率失真性能的有效路径。

Abstract: Generative video compression (GVC) methods usually employ decoder-side diffusion models to denoise reconstructed signals based on generative priors. Besides, most of these methods perform denoising in latent space rather than directly in pixel domain. In this paper, we propose ResGVC, a residual coding framework for GVC that guides denoising toward original pictures by transmitting residual signals. ResGVC first encodes the original pictures within a learned video codec, and then decomposes the distortion between the codec reconstruction and the original pictures into a sequence of residual segments, where each residual segment is acquired at each denoising step. Residual segments can further be compressed by a novel residual codec with a diffusion transformer as an entropy model. Unlike prior methods, ResGVC introduces explicit source constraints throughout denoising rather than relying on decoder-side generation alone. The diffusion-based entropy model also enables more effective distribution modeling capability based on the powerful generative priors. Moreover, denoising directly in pixel space avoids the irreversible information loss caused by latent representation bottlenecks. Experimental results show that, compared with the previous state-of-the-art method, ResGVC achieves 63.7% and 83.8% BD-rate reductions in terms of LPIPS and PSNR, respectively, while also delivering superior visual quality.

</details>


### [53] [A General-Purpose Dual-Path Interaction Framework for Multi-View Medical Image Segmentation: Alleviating Data Volume Dependency in Small-Sample Regimes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31065)
*Shuhuan Wang,Yuanyuan Cui,Pengju Wang,Huimin Guo,Ling Yue,Yin Gu,Yanchao Zhang,Wei Feng,Yunhe Liu,Wei Qian,Mingjun Xu,Shuang Liu,He Ma*

TL;DR: 提出通用即插即用的双路径交互框架DPIF，利用跨视角解剖互补性降低医学图像分割对标注的依赖。

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学图像分割依赖大量标注数据，低样本场景下模型性能显著下降；现有半监督/弱监督方法依赖特定网络结构，传统多视角辅助分割需严格配对样本，限制临床应用。

Method: DPIF可与任意编码器-解码器分割网络兼容，包含三部分：1）基于Sinkhorn最优传输的跨视角分布对齐，无需样本级配对即可建立全局语义对应；2）条件互信息引导的特征解耦，仅在共享语义空间内进行双向知识迁移以抑制视角特有噪声；3）基于持续同调的拓扑正则化，将解剖不变量作为无监督先验以缓解过拟合。

Conclusion: DPIF为数据稀缺的多视角医学图像分割问题提供了通用且可扩展的解决方案。

Abstract: The performance of medical image segmentation depends on a large amount of annotated data, and most segmentation models experience a significant drop in performance in low-sample-size scenarios. Existing semi-supervised and weakly supervised methods rely on specific network architectures, while traditional multi-view-assisted segmentation methods require strictly paired samples, which limits their clinical applications. To address these issues, we propose DPIF, a general-purpose plug-and-play dual-path interaction framework compatible with arbitrary encoder-decoder segmentation networks, which leverages cross-view anatomical complementarity to reduce annotation reliance. DPIF first performs Sinkhorn optimal transport-based cross-view distribution alignment to establish global semantic correspondence without sample-level pairing. It then adopts conditional mutual information-guided feature decoupling to enable bidirectional knowledge transfer only within the shared semantic space, suppressing view-specific noise. Finally, persistent homology-based topological regularization encodes anatomical invariants as unsupervised priors to mitigate overfitting. Experiments were conducted using 24 baseline models on a private multicenter echocardiography dataset and two public datasets. The results show that DPIF-enhanced models outperform single-view baseline models when trained on comparable amounts of data. Notably, most dual-path variants trained on 40\% - 60\% of the data achieve performance comparable to that of single-view models trained on the full dataset. This demonstrates that DPIF provides a general-purpose and scalable solution for data-scarce multi-view medical image segmentation problems.

</details>


### [54] [I$^2$-KAN: Interpretable Intra- and Inter-Modal Multi-Pathway Representation Learning for Multimodal Sentiment Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31087)
*Xiaoting Xie,Feng Qiao,Xianwei Zhang,Hailong Chen,Kaiwen Zheng,Joemon M. Jose,Xuri Ge,Yujun Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出可解释多通路框架I²-KAN，将模态内与成对模态间信息分置于独立结构通路并显式融合，揭示模态单独效用与交互条件效用可以不一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态情感分析融合方法将模态特定表征与跨模态交互混入联合表征，难以判断预测效用来自模态本身还是来自其与其他模态的交互；且模态的单独预测效用未必能忠实反映其交互条件下的预测效用。

Method: I²-KAN框架在结构上将模态内信息与成对模态间交互信息分配到彼此独立的多通路中；每条通路经任务解耦线性门控去噪瓶颈（TDL-GDB）精炼，学习紧凑且任务相关的表征；随后采用结构化Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN）进行融合，保留显式的通路关联并支持多层次解释。

Result: 在CMU-MOSI、CMU-MOSEI与CH-SIMS v2上取得较强的整体性能；消融与可解释性分析在三个基准上一致表明：低单独预测效用并不意味着低交互条件预测效用，单独看似弱的模态可通过成对交互保持信息量。

Conclusion: 多模态效用具有交互依赖性，应从单独效用与交互条件效用两个视角共同刻画模态效用。

Abstract: Multimodal sentiment analysis (MSA) aims to infer sentiment by integrating linguistic, acoustic, and visual information. However, many fusion methods integrate modality-specific representations and cross-modal interactions into joint representations, making it difficult to determine whether predictive utility arises from a modality itself or from its interactions with others. More fundamentally, a modality's standalone predictive utility may not faithfully reflect its interaction-conditioned predictive utility. To address this issue, we propose I$^2$-KAN, an interpretable multi-pathway framework that explicitly maintains intra-modal and pairwise inter-modal information in separate structural pathways. Each pathway is refined by a Task-Decoupled Linear-Gated Denoising Bottleneck (TDL-GDB) to learn compact and task-relevant representations, followed by structured Kolmogorov-Arnold Network fusion that retains explicit pathway associations and supports multi-level interpretation. Extensive experiments on CMU-MOSI, CMU-MOSEI, and CH-SIMS v2 demonstrate strong overall performance. Ablation and interpretability analyses consistently show across the three benchmarks that low standalone predictive utility does not necessarily imply low interaction-conditioned predictive utility: a modality that appears weak in isolation can remain informative through pairwise interactions. These findings highlight the interaction-dependent nature of multimodal utility and suggest that modality utility should be characterized from both standalone and interaction-conditioned perspectives.

</details>


### [55] [DRAFT: Decoding and Reconstructing 3D Room Layouts from fMRI and Camera Trajectories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31108)
*Chi-Wei Lee,An-Kai Chen,Cheng-Han Chiang,Yi-Chun Chang,Po-Chih Kuo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文首次提出仅凭已知相机轨迹与被试观看室内漫游时的fMRI信号、在无任何视觉帧的条件下重建留出场景三维房间布局的任务，并提出DRAFT方法，将早期视觉皮层的紧凑布局表征与相机运动导出的几何自由空间融合，在十个留出场景、20名被试上取得layout r=0.480，优于仅用相机路径（0.446）及七种fMRI解码器（最高0.429），且无需重训练即可作为插件提升所有解码器至0.487–0.493。

Abstract: Detailed image captioning is usually framed as an amount problem: a model should mention more visual facts while avoiding hallucination.   <summary>Details</summary>

Conclusion: 通过秩归一化消除跨模态数值参数化差异，RankAlign 以即插即用方式提升无监督类级视觉-语言匹配的鲁棒性与理论可解释性。

Existing relational matching methods compare within-modality similarity kernels directly, although the same semantic structure may be represented through different numerical parameterizations across modalities. We propose RankAlign, a rank-based normalization strategy for class-level unpaired vision-language matching. RankAlign transforms each within-modality similarity kernel into an ordinal relational representation before permutation matching, while leaving the correspondence space and matching solver unchanged. The resulting representation is invariant to strictly increasing reparameterizations of similarity values while preserving the ordinal structure used for matching. We provide exact-recovery and stability guarantees that characterize correspondence recovery under both exact and partial ordinal agreement. Experiments across diverse frozen vision and language encoders and multiple datasets demonstrate improved and more stable class-level correspondence recovery, including under label corruption and domain shift.

*Mingjie Li,Yukun Jiang,Yicong Tan,Yang Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出WildFakeToolBench基准，从公开网络来源收集156个可执行图像处理工具，评估其对6种AI图像检测器的规避能力，发现单工具攻击成功率达25.25%–100%，八工具池最坏情况覆盖超80%，且有效性稀疏且检测器特异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI生成图像日益普及，公共论坛、代码仓库与摄影教程中广泛流传相关处理信息；借助LLM辅助的代码翻译，攻击者无需专业知识或本地GPU即可利用这些信息规避检测器。现有工作缺乏对这类"野外真实来源"风险的系统性量化评估。

Method: 构建WildFakeToolBench：从142个领域的220个公开源中提取156个可执行图像处理工具，每个工具保留来源证据，并通过语法、执行与输出失真检查（不使用被测检测器反馈）。在来自5个生成器的105张生成图像上，用6种SOTA检测器评估各工具的处理效果，并与6种选定图像处理基线对比；同时评估八工具池子集的覆盖情况。

Result: 最强单工具在各检测器上取得25.25%–100%的攻击成功率，均超过对应检测器下6种基线中最强者；八工具池的任意子集评估显示每个检测器最坏情况覆盖率超80%。有效性呈稀疏且检测器特异分布：候选池整体高覆盖率并不意味着可靠的一次性规避。

Conclusion: 结果揭示了网络来源工具的真实规避风险，并表明可基于此类野外信息构建AI图像检测器鲁棒性评估框架；单一覆盖指标不足以刻画鲁棒性，需关注检测器特异的稀疏有效工具。

Abstract: As AI generated images are getting popular these days, discussions on such generations are widely existed in current public forums, software repositories, and photography tutorials. Moreover, with the help of LLM-assisted code translation, malicious actors can adopt such information to evade detectors without specialized knowledge or local GPU execution of the resulting tools. To evaluate such risks, we introduce \textsc{WildFakeToolBench}, a benchmark suite of $156$ executable image-processing tools derived from $220$ public sources across $142$ domains. Each tool retains its source evidence and passes syntax, execution, and output-distortion checks without using feedback from the evaluated detectors. On $105$ generated images from five generators, we evaluate six state-of-the-art detectors with images processed by the tools in our collected bench to assess their effectiveness against such in-the-wild risks. The strongest individual tools achieve attack success rates of $25.25\%$--$100\%$ across detectors, exceeding the strongest of six selected image-processing baselines for each detector. Evaluating subsets of an eight-tool pool yields worst-case coverage above $80\%$ for every detector. Effectiveness is sparse and detector-specific: high coverage across candidates does not imply reliable one-shot evasion. These findings not only highlight the potential of such web-sourced risks, but also show the potential on establishing AI-image detector robustness evaluation framework based on those in-the-wild information.

</details>


### [63] [Beyond Watching and Searching: Benchmarking Agents for Video-centered Deep Research Reports](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31158)
*Jiahao Meng,Qize Yang,Yuxuan Wang,Yunfei Chu,Wensi Dai,Jin Xu,Yunhai Tong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出以视频为中心的深度研究报告生成任务，并构建技能化工作流、OmniDR-Bench 基准与 Omni Atomic Rubric Trees 评测体系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度研究智能体可将开放网络证据综合为长报告，但缺少以源视频为核心的评测基准；该任务有明确实用价值：帮助用户定位关键片段、核验论断、复现演示流程并做出决策。

Method: 提出技能式工作流与 OmniDR-Bench 基准；评测采用 Omni Atomic Rubric Trees（Omni-ARTs），每棵树含 3 个维度、23 个共享方向及任务特定原子二值判据，覆盖视听 grounding、多模态证据使用与交互式呈现；通过 Audited Rubric Construction（ARC）以独立证据收集、自动检查、行为校准与迭代人工复核构建评分树。

Result: 基准含 50 个中英文任务、19 个真实世界子类、6,414 条判据；18 种智能体配置中最佳系统得分 63.3/100；当前智能体在内容覆盖广度、跨模态因果与逻辑分析、引文支撑准确性方面仍存在不足。

Conclusion: 该工作填补了视频中心深度研究评测的空白，并提供细粒度原子化评测框架；同时分析了模型、harness、技能配置、视频类别与研究轨迹，代码与数据已开源。

Abstract: Deep research agents synthesize open-web evidence into long reports, but current benchmarks do not evaluate research centered on a source video. We introduce Video-Centered Deep Research Report Generation. Given a video and user request, an agent identifies research questions, retrieves external multimodal evidence, and produces an interactive report linked to relevant video moments. This task has direct practical value because it helps users locate relevant moments, verify claims, reproduce demonstrated procedures, and make informed decisions from video content. We present a skill-based workflow and OmniDR-Bench for this task. For evaluation, we propose Omni Atomic Rubric Trees (Omni-ARTs). Each tree contains three dimensions, 23 shared directions, and task-specific atomic binary criteria. The directions test audiovisual grounding, multimodal evidence use, and interactive presentation. Audited Rubric Construction (ARC) builds these trees through independent evidence collection, automated checks, behavioral calibration, and iterative human review. OmniDR-Bench contains 50 Chinese and English tasks across 19 realworld subcategories. It includes 6,414 criteria. Across 18 agent configurations, the best system scores 63.3 out of 100. Current agents still need broader content coverage, stronger causal and logical analysis across modalities, and more accurate citation support. We further analyze models, harnesses, skill configurations, video categories, and research trajectories. The code and data are released at https://github.com/marinero4972/OmniDR-Bench.

</details>


### [64] [HiSTEVE 1.0: Harnessing Human-Interface VLA Agents for Open-World Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31162)
*Zecong Tang,Zian Guan,Yuncheng Guo,Zhanqiu Zhang,Yiwen Guo,Bo Dai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HiSTEVE：面向 Minecraft 的分层 VLA 智能体，通过编排层（结构化记忆+VLM 规划器+策略耦合完成检测器）与单一 VLA 控制层（纯视觉、原生键鼠）结合，实现原子任务 SOTA 与长程自主任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放世界游戏中的虚拟具身智能体需同时具备长程自主性与可靠的原生接口控制，但现有工作二者割裂：或仅有原生视觉运动控制而无长程自主，或依赖环境 API/预定义技能做高层规划。本文旨在弥合这一鸿沟。

Method: 提出分层 VLA 智能体 HiSTEVE 及能力感知的 agent harness。编排层：结构化记忆跟踪进度，VLM 规划器在 VLA 能力范围内选择子任务；引入策略耦合的任务完成状态检测器，以 VLA 策略上下文为条件给出候选完成信号。控制层：单一 VLA 以纯视觉感知执行全部子任务并输出原生键鼠动作；针对 GUI 与非 GUI 交互干扰，设计分域 RMSNorm 分支与独立鼠标移动 token 嵌入。训练采用世界知识注入、模仿学习及基于环境反馈的强化学习以提升可靠性与恢复能力。

Result: 在 MineStudio Bench 上取得 85.0% 的原子任务得分（SOTA），OpenHA 平均成功率 37.4%；并能像人类玩家一样从零完成制作铁镐等长程任务。

Conclusion: 将高层编排（记忆+规划+完成判定）与单一原生接口 VLA 控制统一，可在无 API、无预定义技能的条件下兼顾原子任务精度与长程自主性，为开放世界具身智能体提供可行范式。

Abstract: Building virtual embodied agents that operate in open-ended games like human players is a long-standing goal requiring both long-horizon autonomy and reliable native-interface control. As a procedurally generated open world, Minecraft provides a natural testbed for studying the integration of these capabilities. Existing agents typically provide either native visuomotor control without long-horizon autonomy or high-level planning executed through environment APIs or predefined skills. To bridge this gap, we propose HiSTEVE, a hierarchical VLA agent with a capability-aware agent harness. At the orchestration level, we equip the harness with structured memory for tracking progress and a VLM planner for selecting subtasks within the VLA's capabilities. To reliably determine subtask completion, we further introduce a policy-coupled task completion state detector that conditions on VLA policy context to signal candidate completion. At the control level, a single VLA executes all subtasks with vision-only perception and native keyboard-and-mouse actions. To mitigate interference between heterogeneous GUI and non-GUI interactions, we introduce regime-specific RMSNorm branches and separate mouse-movement token embeddings. We also train the VLA through world knowledge injection, imitation learning, and reinforcement learning with environment feedback to improve reliability and recovery. HiSTEVE achieves state-of-the-art atomic-task performance, scoring 85.0% on MineStudio Bench and a 37.4% average success rate on OpenHA, while also completing long-horizon tasks such as crafting an iron pickaxe from scratch like human players.

</details>


### [65] [RaSFNet: Ray-aligned and Scan-aware Fusion Network for LiDAR Semantic Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31186)
*Chuang Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出射线对齐与扫描感知融合网络RaSFNet，解决投影式LiDAR点云语义分割中的几何信息丢失与空间关系建模不足问题，在SemanticKITTI和nuScenes验证集上分别取得70.2%与77.7%的mIoU。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 投影式方法将3D点云映射为2D表示存在三类问题：(1)投影时多点的聚合会模糊同一frustum内的几何差异，且局部特征提取限制了跨扫描区域的空间关系建模；(2)投影表示中的邻近不等于3D空间中的邻近；(3)点特征与投影特征交互时会混入不同距离范围的特征，降低语义可分性。

Method: RaSFNet包含三个核心设计：RAGDE（射线对齐几何分布编码）模块在射线对齐坐标系下刻画每个frustum内的点分布；STAM（扫描拓扑感知Mamba）模块依据LiDAR方位角采样模式组织frustum特征并捕获跨扫描区域的长程依赖；RCPFF（距离约束的点-frustum融合）机制利用共享的距离信息引导点与frustum表示间的特征交换，保持空间对应关系。

Result: 在SemanticKITTI和nuScenes验证集上分别达到70.2%和77.7%的mIoU，与所评估方法相比具有竞争力。

Conclusion: 将点云几何结构与LiDAR扫描特性显式融入投影式分割框架，可有效缓解投影聚合的信息损失与跨区域建模不足问题，验证了射线对齐编码、扫描拓扑感知建模与距离约束融合的有效性。

Abstract: LiDAR point cloud semantic segmentation is a fundamental component of 3D perception for autonomous driving and robotics. Projection-based methods map 3D point clouds into 2D representations for feature extraction using 2D networks. However, aggregating multiple points during projection can obscure geometric differences within each frustum, while local feature extraction limits the modeling of spatial relationships across scanning regions. Moreover, proximity in the projected representation does not necessarily imply proximity in 3D space, and interactions between point and projected features may mix features from different ranges, reducing semantic discriminability. To address these challenges, we propose the Ray-aligned and Scan-aware Fusion Network (RaSFNet), which incorporates point cloud geometry and LiDAR scanning characteristics into projection-based semantic segmentation. Specifically, the Ray-Aligned Geometric Distribution Encoding (RAGDE) module characterizes point distributions within each frustum using a ray-aligned coordinate system. To model spatial context, a Scan-Topology-Aware Mamba (STAM) block organizes frustum features according to the LiDAR azimuth sampling pattern and captures long-range dependencies across scanning regions. In addition, a Range-Constrained Point-Frustum Fusion (RCPFF) mechanism uses shared range information to guide feature exchange between point and frustum representations while maintaining spatial correspondence. RaSFNet achieves mIoU scores of 70.2% and 77.7% on the SemanticKITTI and nuScenes validation sets, respectively, indicating competitive segmentation performance compared with the evaluated methods.

</details>


### [66] [A Visual Grounding Benchmark for Retinal OCT with Multimodal Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31205)
*Ronald Fecso,José Morano,Botond Fazekas,Paul Widmann-Sedlnitzky,Dorota Himel,Laetita Hinterhuber,Virginia Mares,Andreas Pollreisz,Hrvoje Bogunović*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出首个视网膜OCT生物标志物视觉定位基准RetinaGroundBench及新指标AggIoU，发现27个开源MLLM定位能力普遍不足，并发布微调模型RetGrounder将定位F1提升至33.9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLLM可回答医学影像相关的临床问题，但可信使用需具备视觉定位能力，即模型应定位其所报告的病灶而非依赖伪相关捷径。然而MLLM能否在眼科最常用的视网膜OCT影像上实现临床发现的视觉定位，尚缺乏系统评估。

Method: 构建RetinaGroundBench基准：815张B-scan由眼科医生详尽标注4,537个边界框，覆盖8种疾病的13类生物标志物。针对MLLM常将单一病灶碎片化为多个局部预测的问题，提出AggIoU指标，评估重叠预测框的并集是否覆盖标注区域。评估27个开源MLLM（0.8–38B），并设计结合定位与文本信息的OCT专用微调策略，得到8B模型RetGrounder。

Result: 视觉定位整体仍未解决：最佳通用模型宏F1仅23.7%，召回率持续偏低，尽管其在生物标志物存在性问答上的平衡准确率可达73%。RetGrounder将定位F1提升至33.9%，相对提升43%。

Conclusion: 该基准为基于MLLM的OCT诊断领域提供了衡量进展的参照点，表明当前模型在生物标志物定位上存在显著能力缺口，专用微调可部分弥补但仍有较大提升空间。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can answer clinical questions about medical images, but trustworthy use requires visual grounding: models should localize the pathology they report rather than rely on spurious shortcuts. Whether MLLMs can visually ground clinical findings in retinal optical coherence tomography (OCT), the most widely used imaging modality in ophthalmology, remains largely unexplored. To address this gap, we introduce RetinaGroundBench, the first benchmark for biomarker visual grounding in retinal OCT. It comprises 815 B-scans exhaustively annotated by ophthalmologists with 4,537 bounding boxes covering 13 biomarkers across 8 diseases. Because MLLMs often fragment a single lesion into multiple partial predictions, we propose AggIoU, a metric that evaluates whether the union of overlapping predicted boxes covers the annotated region. Across 27 open-source MLLMs (0.8-38B parameters), we find that visual grounding remains largely unsolved: the best general-purpose model achieves a macro F1 of just 23.7%, with consistently low recall, despite reaching up to 73% balanced accuracy on biomarker presence questions. To narrow this gap, we developed RetGrounder, an MLLM fine-tuned using an OCT-specific strategy integrating grounding and textual information. Despite its relatively small size (8B), RetGrounder improves grounding F1 to 33.9%, a 43% relative improvement. Our benchmark provides a reference point for measuring progress in the field of OCT diagnosis with MLLMs.

</details>


### [67] [Moving Regions, Not Moving Objects: Segmenting What Actually Moves under Camera Motion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31209)
*Wenhua Jin,Tiancheng Chen,Sheng Tang,Jiahao Li,Yupeng Liu,Weiqi Zhang,Juntong Fang,Zesong Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出MoRSe，将运动分割从实例级重新表述为区域级，通过联合解读两帧直接预测运动区域掩码，无需光流、点轨迹或独立掩码生成器，并发布MoRSe-5K基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有运动目标分割在序列/实例级别建模，只要实例在视频中某处运动就标记整个实例；近期的瞬时形式虽区分运动与静止区间，但仍依赖冻结的分割基础模型在物体级别生成掩码。由于掩码源自实例级提案，运动被归因于整个实例而非真正运动的区域；且即使实例完全静止也会输出掩码。核心问题是：运动并非实例的固有属性，必须通过比较至少两帧才能确定。

Method: 提出MoRSe，联合解读两帧输入以预测运动区域掩码，区分真实场景运动与相机引起的表观运动。用单一RGB编码器替代多阶段基础模型堆叠，推理时不需要光流、点轨迹或单独的掩码生成器。同时构建MoRSe-5K基准，包含42个序列，设Static、Dynamic-Static与Dynamic三种设置，用于评估在不同相机与场景运动条件下区分并定位运动/静止区域的能力。

Result: MoRSe优于专门的运动目标分割方法，也优于经运动阈值化处理的稠密4D重建方法；在无任何运动的序列上产生的误报（false positives）最少。

Conclusion: 运动应被定位到真正发生运动的区域而非整个实例，且必须基于帧间比较来判定；单一RGB编码器的两帧联合建模范式可在无需光流与实例级基础模型的前提下实现更准确的区域级运动分割，并在静止场景中显著抑制误报。

Abstract: Moving object segmentation is conventionally formulated at the sequence and object level, marking an entire instance as moving once it moves anywhere in a video. Recent instantaneous formulations distinguish moving from stationary intervals, but still generate masks at the object level through frozen segmentation foundation models. Because the mask is derived from an instance-level proposal, motion is typically attributed to the entire instance rather than localized to the regions that actually move. Moreover, such instance-level predictions can produce masks even when no part of the instance is actually moving, revealing a more fundamental issue: motion is not an intrinsic property of an instance; it can only be determined by comparing at least two frames. Building on this premise, we introduce MoRSe, which jointly interprets two frames to predict a moving-region mask, distinguishing actual scene motion from apparent motion induced by the camera. A single RGB encoder replaces multi-stage foundation stacks, so no optical flow, point tracks, or separate mask generator is needed at inference. We release MoRSe-5K, a benchmark of 42 sequences with Static, Dynamic-Static, and Dynamic settings designed to evaluate the model's ability to distinguish and localize moving and stationary regions under different camera and scene motion conditions. MoRSe outperforms both specialized moving object segmentation methods and dense 4D reconstruction methods with motion-thresholded predictions, while producing the fewest false positives on sequences where nothing moves.

</details>


### [68] [GLOW-FM: Efficient Generative Low-Light Image Enhancement with One-Step Latent Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31222)
*Ariel Lapid,Yuval Haitman,Reuven Peretz,Arnon Netzer,Idit Diamant*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GLOW-FM：基于冻结Tiny-VAE潜空间与终端速度匹配（TVM）的一步生成式低光照图像增强框架，单次函数评估、约34 GFLOPs即可获得有竞争力的感知质量与SOTA跨数据集泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散类生成式LLIE虽感知质量强，但迭代采样计算开销大，难以实际部署；现有高效方案仍难以在单次函数评估、低总算力下应对多样化真实低光场景。

Method: 在冻结Tiny-VAE的潜空间中进行条件传输（conditional transport），采用Terminal Velocity Matching（TVM）目标，使增强可在一次函数评估（1 NFE）内完成；并与其它一步目标做匹配对比，属TVM首次用于图像复原/LLIE。

Result: 在挑战性真实基准上取得有竞争力的图像质量，并实现最优的跨数据集泛化；小模型仅需1 NFE、34 GFLOPs。

Conclusion: 单步推理+紧凑潜空间建模可使生成式LLIE更接近实用部署；TVM是有效的一步生成式复原设计。

Abstract: Low-light image enhancement (LLIE) aims to recover well-exposed and perceptually faithful images from severely degraded observations. Recent diffusion-based generative methods achieve strong perceptual quality by leveraging powerful image priors, but their iterative sampling incurs substantial computational cost, limiting practical deployment. Despite recent efficiency gains in generative LLIE, high-quality enhancement with a single function evaluation and low overall computation remains challenging, particularly under diverse real-world low-light conditions. We introduce GLOW-FM, a one-step latent flow-matching framework for efficient generative LLIE. GLOW-FM performs conditional transport in the latent space of a frozen Tiny-VAE and leverages Terminal Velocity Matching (TVM) to enable enhancement with a single function evaluation. Matched comparisons with alternative one-step objectives support TVM as an effective design choice, and, to the best of our knowledge, this is its first adaptation to image restoration and specifically to LLIE. Extensive experiments on challenging real-world benchmarks demonstrate that GLOW-FM achieves competitive image quality and state-of-the-art cross-dataset generalization while requiring only a single function evaluation and 34 GFLOPs for the small variant. These findings highlight the potential of GLOW-FM to bring generative LLIE closer to practical deployment through single-step inference and compact latent modeling. Code will be made publicly available upon publication.

</details>


### [69] [Lightweight Frame Compensation for Real-Time Polyp Segmentation under Frame Skipping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31228)
*Weihao Gao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出77K参数的即插即用轻量帧补偿模块LFC，插入冻结分割骨干之前，用三帧窗口的时空注意力融合生成补偿帧，无需专家标注（仅用不同随机种子模型生成的伪标签训练），在保留2.05X–2.55X吞吐增益的同时恢复到接近逐帧推理的精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 计算机辅助结肠镜下的实时息肉分割受严格延迟预算约束，高精度模型难以部署；跳帧推理（每K帧一次）虽提升吞吐，但带来运动模糊和病灶错位，损害时间一致性。

Method: Lightweight Frame Compensator（LFC）：77K参数的plug-and-play模块，置于冻结的分割骨干之前；在连续三帧窗口上通过时空注意力融合为单张补偿帧；仅用由不同随机种子模型生成的伪标签进行训练，不使用专家标注。还评估了CNN、金字塔Transformer、全局注意力Transformer三类骨干对跳帧的敏感度谱。

Result: 在三个息肉视频基准上，LFC挽回了直接跳帧造成的大部分精度损失，部分设置下达到逐帧推理精度，同时保持2.05X–2.55X吞吐增益；三类骨干对跳帧的敏感性呈谱系分布，取决于其局部或全局聚合错位输入的方式；LFC的补偿增益符合该谱系——对高容量Transformer骨干增益最大（其静态精度最佳但跳帧下退化最严重）。

Conclusion: LFC提供了一条轻量、可插拔、易部署的实时息肉分割路径。

Abstract: Real-time polyp segmentation in computer-assisted colonoscopy is hampered by the difficulty of deploying high-accuracy models under strict latency budgets. Frame skipping, which performs inference every K frames and reuses or interpolates the rest, improves throughput but introduces motion blur and lesion misalignment that degrade temporal consistency. To close this gap, we propose the Lightweight Frame Compensator (LFC), a 77K-parameter plug-and-play module inserted before a frozen segmentation backbone. Operating on a three-frame window, LFC fuses consecutive frames via spatio-temporal attention into a single compensated frame, and is trained only on pseudo-labels generated by a differently seeded model, without any expert annotation. Experiments on three polyp video benchmarks show that LFC recovers most of the accuracy degraded by direct frame skipping and, in several settings, reaches the accuracy of frame-by-frame inference, while retaining a 2.05X--2.55X throughput gain. We further evaluate the temporal stability of three backbones spanning CNN, pyramid Transformer, and global-attention Transformer architectures, revealing a spectrum of sensitivity to frame skipping that arises from how locally or globally each architecture aggregates misaligned input. The compensation gain of LFC follows this spectrum: it is largest for high-capacity Transformer backbones, which achieve the best static accuracy but suffer the most under skip-frame inference. LFC thus offers a lightweight, pluggable, and deployment-friendly route to real-time polyp segmentation.

</details>


### [70] [Reinforcing intra-operative tumour localisation with weak supervision from pre-operative appearances](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31253)
*Sidhart Sami,Ali Sharjeel,Sri Atluri,Miao Zhao,Caroline Roney,Eirini Marouli,Shaheer U. Saeed*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出弱监督跨模态框架：将在术前MR上训练的肿瘤存在分类器用于术中CT的窗口分类，以其弱信号引导强化学习智能体在术中CT上定位HCC肿瘤；比较直接迁移、少样本适应与合成迁移（CT→合成MR），在外部HCC队列上合成迁移最优，无需配对MR-CT训练数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 术中影像上肿瘤可见性差，使CT引导的HCC靶向导航困难；由此导致带标注数据难以构建，且因术中形变和缺乏配对术前-术中数据，基于配准的术前勾画迁移仍具挑战性。

Method: 1) 在术前MR上训练肿瘤存在与否的分类器；2) 将其应用于术中CT的滑窗，获得跨域弱监督信号（尽管存在域间差异，含瘤窗口平均概率更高）；3) 以该弱信号为奖励驱动强化学习智能体在术中CT上定位肿瘤；4) 对比三种策略：直接迁移、少样本适应、合成迁移（用非配对MR与CT训练，先将CT翻译为合成MR再定位）。

Result: 在外部HCC队列上，合成迁移优于直接迁移、少样本适应以及仅用CT的基线方法；且分类器虽存在域间差距，仍对含瘤窗口给出更高的肿瘤存在概率。

Conclusion: 该框架实现了无需配对MR-CT训练图像的跨模态肿瘤定位，为术中影像弱可见条件下的手术导航提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Limited tumour visibility on intra-operative images complicates surgical navigation, including liver hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) targeting on computed tomography (CT) imaging. This makes labelled datasets difficult to curate for deep learning, and transferring pre-operative delineations through registration remains challenging due to intra-operative deformation and lack of paired pre- and intra-operative data. We propose to transfer tumour appearances learned from pre-operative magnetic resonance (MR) images to guide localisation on intra-operative CT through weak supervision. A classifier is trained to classify tumour presence on pre-operative images. This is applied to windows on intra-operative images, and despite the domain gap, it assigns higher tumour-presence probabilities on average to tumour-containing windows. These weak cross-domain signals guide a reinforcement learning agent to localise tumours on intra-operative images. We compare direct transfer, few-shot adaptation and synthetic transfer (trained using unpaired MR and CT), which translates CT into synthetic MR before localisation. On an external HCC cohort, synthetic transfer outperformed other tested methods and CT-only baselines. Our framework enables cross-modality tumour localisation without paired MR-CT training images.

</details>


### [71] [ReCoG: Relational Concept Graph for Training-Free Personalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31282)
*Changseon Yu,Hyeokjun Kweon*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ReCoG——关系概念图，用有向边显式刻画概念对之间的判别性线索，并在推理时进行成对比较消歧，用于免训练个性化；同时构建FINGER基准，在易混淆概念集上取得最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于检索器的免训练个性化方法将各概念孤立处理，检索到的描述性证据虽合理但缺乏判别性，在包含高度易混淆的细粒度类别时尤为失效。作者认为个性化本质上是关系性的：正确识别取决于概念与其最近替代项之间的具体差异。

Method: ReCoG将概念建模为节点，并在数据库构建阶段由冻结VLM引出概念对之间的判别性线索，形成有向边。推理时先检索候选短名单，再依据相应关系边进行显式成对比较，选出在竞争中稳定胜出的概念。另构建FINGER基准评估易混淆概念集上的个性化识别。

Result: 在FINGER上显著优于先前方法，且在最易混淆的场景下增益最大；在captioning与VQA等已有基准上同样取得一致最优性能，表明关系性证据在细粒度场景之外也广泛有益。

Conclusion: 将个性化建模为关系图上的成对判别与比较，是提升免训练VLM个性化识别的有效范式，尤其适用于细粒度易混淆概念集。

Abstract: Training-free personalization adapts a frozen vision-language model (VLM) to recognize user-defined concepts from only a few exemplars by retrieving concept entries at inference time. While recent retriever-based methods enrich each concept with descriptive evidence, they largely treat concepts in isolation, so the retrieved information can be plausible yet non-discriminative, especially when the personalized concept set contains highly confusable, fine-grained categories. We argue that personalization is inherently relational: correct recognition depends on the specific distinctions between a concept and its nearest alternatives. To this end, we propose ReCoG, a Relational Concept Graph for retrieval-augmented personalization. ReCoG represents concepts as nodes and augments them with directed edges that explicitly capture discriminative cues between concept pairs, elicited by a frozen VLM during database construction. At inference, ReCoG retrieves a shortlist and resolves ambiguity via explicit pairwise comparisons conditioned on the corresponding relational edges, selecting the concept that consistently wins against competing candidates. We also introduce FINGER benchmark to test personalized recognition on confusable concept sets. Across FINGER, ReCoG substantially outperforms prior methods, with the largest gains in the most confusable regimes. ReCoG also achieves consistently best performance on established personalization benchmarks including captioning and VQA, confirming that relational evidence is broadly beneficial beyond fine-grained settings. Project Page: https://csy-98.github.io/ReCoG/

</details>


### [72] [Retrieval-Augmented Online Textual Memory for Episodic Memory Video Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31284)
*Raffaele Cali,Giuseppe Lando,Rosario Forte,Antonino Furnari*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文系统研究检索在多模态大模型的第一人称长视频情景记忆问答中的作用，最优配置 Parent 以 56.4% 准确率匹配全记忆与强检索基线，同时仅暴露少量文本记忆，并揭示提升检索预算虽能提高 Hit@K/Recall@K 却可能因干扰项降低准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时第一人称视频需将视觉流压缩为可高效检索、又能保留答题证据的记忆表示；作者希望将检索作为单一变量隔离出来，系统厘清检索单元、查询形式、上下文预算与重排序对情景记忆视频问答的影响。

Method: 基于在线文本记忆框架（第一人称视频转写为带时间锚定的字幕），在 QAEgo4D-Closed 上做多选题评测，固定底层生成记忆不变，仅改变检索配置：检索单元、查询表述、上下文预算与重排序策略；最优配置 Parent 先匹配细粒度字幕子块，再将完整父级字幕提供给推理模型。

Result: Parent 配置达到 56.4% 准确率，匹配强全记忆与检索基线，而提问时仅暴露小部分文本记忆；分析显示增加检索预算可提升时序 Hit@K 与 Recall@K，但因引入视觉上合理的干扰项与不确定的字幕证据，准确率反可能下降。

Conclusion: 检索增强的第一人称记忆不应仅以证据召回为优化目标，还需兼顾所检索上下文的可靠性、具体性与答案判别性；研究呼吁构建超越原始字幕检索的结构化情景记忆，走向证据感知表示以支撑长时序第一人称推理。

Abstract: Long egocentric videos pose a central challenge for multimodal language models: the visual stream must be compressed into a memory representation that can be searched efficiently while still preserving the evidence needed for question answering. Building on an online textual-memory framework in which first-person videos are converted into temporally grounded captions, this work systematically studies the role of retrieval in episodic-memory video question answering. We evaluate how different retrieval units, query formulations, context budgets, and reranking strategies affect multiple-choice answering on QAEgo4D-Closed, isolating retrieval as the main variable while keeping the underlying generated memory fixed.
  Our best configuration, Parent, matches fine-grained caption subchunks, then provides their full parent captions to the reasoner. It achieves 56.4 % accuracy, matching strong full-memory and retrieval baselines while exposing only a small fraction of the textual memory at question time. More importantly, our analysis shows that better temporal coverage does not necessarily translate into better answers: increasing the retrieval budget improves temporal Hit@K and Recall@K, but can reduce accuracy by introducing visually plausible distractors and uncertain caption evidence. These findings suggest that retrieval-augmented egocentric memory should not be optimized only for evidence recall, but also for the reliability, specificity, and answer-discriminative value of the retrieved context. The study motivates more structured episodic memories that move beyond raw caption retrieval toward evidence-aware representations for long-form egocentric reasoning.

</details>


### [73] [RecallGS: Geometry-Grounded Recall for Online Semantic Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31293)
*Thanh-Khoi Nguyen,Thien-Phuc Tran,Minh-Triet Tran*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RecallGS 提出一种轻量、免训练的机制，将智能体的历史观测作为非参数化几何-语义先验，通过"召回-定位-融合"流程为在线语义3DGS补充几何上下文，在ScanNet系列上以2.48 FPS实现强语义分割性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有在线语义3DGS方法为弥补图像语义特征中缺失的几何上下文，需额外学习一个3D网络，带来训练与推理开销。作者观察到此类几何-语义证据已存在于观测历史中，可被检索而非学习。

Method: RecallGS（Geometry-Grounded Recall）采用免训练的非参数化方法：CLIP检索相关历史观测；用alpha合成权重识别几何支持的视角；再在每个高斯渲染足迹上聚合这些语义特征。

Result: 在ScanNet与ScanNet++上取得强语义分割性能，运行速度达2.48 FPS。

Conclusion: 几何-语义上下文可有效从观测历史中恢复，无需额外的学习式3D分支，验证了以历史观测作为先验的免训练范式可行性。

Abstract: Online semantic 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables open-vocabulary scene understanding from streaming observations. However, existing methods recover geometric context missing from image-derived semantic features using an additionally learned 3D network, incurring extra training and runtime overhead. We observe that such geometric-semantic evidence may already exist in the agent's observation history and can be retrieved rather than learned. Based on this insight, we introduce RecallGS (Geometry-Grounded Recall for Online Semantic Gaussian Splatting), a lightweight, training-free mechanism that treats past observations as a non-parametric geometric-semantic prior. RecallGS follows a recall-ground-fuse pipeline: CLIP retrieves relevant observations, alpha-compositing weights identify geometrically supported views, and aggregate their semantic features over each Gaussian's rendered footprint. On ScanNet and ScanNet++, RecallGS achieves strong semantic segmentation performance at 2.48 FPS, demonstrating that geometric-semantic context can be effectively recovered from observation history without an additional learned 3D branch.

</details>


### [74] [PiHand: Latent Hand-Object Interaction Priors for Physics-Based Policy Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31299)
*Niklas Berndt,Xianghui Xie,Enes Duran,Yixiao Wang,Gerard Pons-Moll*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PiHand：面向灵巧手-物体交互的物理接地、交互感知运动合成框架——先用专家策略在仿真中跟踪动捕，再经目标条件VAE蒸馏成统一的手-物体交互先验，最后在潜空间做有界残差探索求解多样操作任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法要么仅跟踪动捕轨迹、难以迁移到新物体，要么依赖单手生成先验而无法刻画手-物体耦合运动，导致接触保真度低、样本效率差。同时需兼顾细微接触动力学、多样几何与目标轨迹并保持自然抓握。

Method: 1) 在仿真中训练专家策略跟踪动捕演示；2) 用目标条件VAE将专家蒸馏为统一的手-物体交互先验；3) 在潜空间中通过有界残差探索求解任务；仅用单一奖励、无需复杂课程学习。

Result: 在GRAB与DexYCB上获得可泛化到未见物体与轨迹的通用桌面操作策略；同一先验可迁移到物体接取与双手交接（训练数据中罕见）；所有任务上各项指标均优于基线。

Conclusion: 物理仿真专家蒸馏 + 交互先验 + 潜空间有界残差探索，可高效生成物理可信、接触保真的灵巧手-物体交互，并具备跨任务泛化能力；将开源处理后的数据与模型检查点。

Abstract: Synthesizing physically grounded dexterous hand-object interactions is important for VR/AR, gaming, and robotics, yet remains challenging because subtle contact dynamics, diverse object geometries, and target trajectories must be jointly respected while maintaining natural grasps. Existing methods either track mocap trajectories with limited transfer to novel objects, or rely on hand-only generative priors that fail to capture coupled hand-object motion, sacrificing contact fidelity and sample efficiency. To tackle these challenges, we introduce PiHand, a Physically grounded Interaction-aware Hand motion synthesis framework. PiHand first trains expert policies that track mocap demonstrations in simulation, distills them into a unified hand-object interaction prior using a goal-conditioned VAE, and finally solve diverse dexterous manipulation tasks through bounded residual exploration in its latent space. With only a single reward and no complex curriculum training, this yields general tabletop manipulation policies that generalize to unseen objects and trajectories on GRAB and DexYCB. The same prior transfers to object catching and bimanual handover, two tasks that are rarely seen in its training data. Across all tasks, PiHand consistently outperforms baselines in all metrics. We will release the processed data and model checkpoints.

</details>


### [75] [Data-Driven Vision-Language Models for Remote Sensing: A Survey](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31304)
*Yue Zhou,Shujun Zhao,Xue Yang,Ruigang Li,Tianwen Zhang,Mengcheng Lan,Chaofeng Chen,Lingfei Ma,Hongjie He,Jonathan Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该综述聚焦视觉语言模型(VLM)时代遥感(RS)研究从"模型中心"向"数据中心"的范式转变，系统梳理面向VLM的RS数据集发展现状，并提供从数据构建到微调与评估的全流程实践指南。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习时代RS视觉模型创新集中于针对特定任务的网络架构优化与端到端训练；进入VLM时代后，受巨大算力成本约束，主流范式转为用RS垂直领域数据微调通用VLM而非改动核心架构。尽管数据重要性上升，学术界仍缺乏系统性的、以数据为中心的综述来指导高质量RS视觉语言数据集的构建及其上的高效微调与性能评估。

Method: 采用以数据为中心的综述方法：系统回顾面向VLM的RS数据集发展现状，并围绕"数据构建—微调—评估"全链路给出面向大模型时代RS研究者的综合实践指南。

Result: 明确了研究范式的转变（模型中心→数据中心），梳理了RS视觉语言数据集的发展脉络与现状，并形成了覆盖数据集构建、模型微调与性能评估的完整实践指导框架。

Conclusion: 呼吁学术社区针对RS各细分领域构建更多样、更高质量的视觉语言数据集，并汇聚为任务覆盖广、地理分布广的综合RS视觉语言语料库，为遥感领域迈向通用人工智能奠定坚实的数据基础。

Abstract: During the deep learning era, innovations in remote sensing (RS) vision models primarily focused on optimizing network architectures for specific tasks and conducting end-to-end training. However, with the advent of the Vision-Language Models (VLMs) era, constrained by substantial computational resource demands, the mainstream research paradigm has shifted towards adapting general-purpose VLMs using RS vertical domain data for fine-tuning, rather than modifying their core architectures. This transition marks a change in the innovation pathway from model-centric to data-centric. Despite the increasing importance of data, the academic community still lacks a systematic, data-centric survey to guide researchers in constructing high-quality RS vision-language datasets for various application scenarios and in conducting effective model fine-tuning and performance evaluation based on these datasets. To address this gap, this paper presents a systematic review of the development status of RS datasets tailored for VLMs. It further provides a comprehensive practical guide for RS researchers in the large model era, covering the entire pipeline from data construction to fine-tuning and evaluation. This paper aims to encourage the academic community to build more diverse and higher-quality vision-language datasets for specialized RS sub-fields. Ultimately, the goal is to converge these efforts into a comprehensive RS vision-language corpus that offers extensive task coverage and a wide geographical distribution, thereby laying a solid data foundation for advancing towards general artificial intelligence in RS.

</details>


### [76] [Stream4D: Streaming 4D Reconstruction with Training-free Motion Decoupling via Causal KV-Cache Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31320)
*Wei Zhang,Ying Feng,Mengtong Wu,Shiqiang Gong,Huaqi Zhang,Qi Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出无训练的运动解耦流式重建框架Stream4D，利用causal attention中KV cache隐含的时序运动线索生成动态掩码，抑制动态区域干扰以提升位姿估计与静态场景重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 4D场景重建需处理动态物体，但现有流式方法多假设静态场景，在长序列上产生位姿漂移与重影伪影。

Method: 无需训练，可直接嵌入因果Transformer主干（如StreamVGGT、Stream3R）。基于causal attention的KV cache隐含时序运动线索，跨多层注意力与多时间窗自适应聚合，并与深度先验融合（应对遮挡、无纹理区域），生成精确动态掩码以解耦静态/动态区域；再以软键掩码（soft key masking）抑制causal attention中动态区域干扰。

Result: 在多个动态场景基准上显著提升相机位姿估计与静态场景重建质量，输出可靠的动态掩码，有效缓解长序列重影；继承causal attention效率并兼容现有流式架构。

Conclusion: Stream4D表明KV cache中的隐式时序运动线索可被有效利用以解耦动态物体，为流式4D重建提供高兼容、低开销的动态处理方案。

Abstract: 4D scene reconstruction requires robust handling of dynamic objects, yet existing streaming methods commonly assume static scenes, leading to pose drift and ghosting artifacts over long sequences. We introduce Stream4D, a training-free, motion-decoupled streaming reconstruction framework that can be directly integrated into causal Transformer backbones (e.g., StreamVGGT, Stream3R). Our key observation is that causal attention implicitly encodes rich temporal motion cues within the KV cache. We adaptively aggregate these cues from multiple attention layers and across temporal windows, and fuse them with depth priors to handle challenging cases such as occlusions and textureless regions, producing precise dynamic masks that decouple static and dynamic regions. We then apply a soft key masking scheme that leverages these dynamic masks to suppress interference from dynamic regions in causal attention, thereby improving camera pose estimation accuracy. Stream4D inherits the efficiency of causal attention and remains compatible with existing streaming architectures. On diverse dynamic-scene benchmarks, Stream4D significantly improves camera pose estimation and static-scene reconstruction quality, yields reliable dynamic masks, and effectively mitigates long-sequence ghosting.

</details>


### [77] [MVLoMa: Multi-View Local Feature Matching with Any Geometry Foundation Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31321)
*Xinyang Lu,Shengzhe Wei,Sheng Tang,Weiqi Zhang,Juntong Fang,Zesong Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MVLoMa，一种星图稀疏多视图匹配器，将LoMa从图像对扩展到多视图，注入冻结多视图几何模型的跨视几何上下文，一次前向匹配中心图与全部邻居。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SfM与视觉定位通常将一张参考图与多个检索或共视邻居匹配，但现有成对匹配器逐边独立运行，重复计算参考侧特征，且无法利用其余观测提供的互补多视几何证据。

Method: 首先用冻结的多视图几何模型联合描述星图内所有图像，将跨视几何上下文注入局部描述子；随后通过逐视图自注意力与双向中心-邻居交叉注意力，在单次前向中完成中心图与所有邻居的匹配。监督方面，仅从深度有效且互可见的稠密warp中生成正对应，并对违反对极几何的高置信度匹配显式施加惩罚。

Result: 在HyperSim、ScanNet++、Mip-NeRF 360与Tanks and Temples的25视图星图上，三个阈值下均取得最佳macro-average相对位姿AUC（58.65/85.41/90.99）；匹配器比串行执行24条中心-邻居边快2.20倍。设计兼容DA3、π³、VGGT、VGGT-Ω四种冻结几何编码器，DA3-Giant在全部编码器消融指标上最优。受控消融进一步分离了几何感知描述子、可见性过滤、几何负监督与联合多视图推理各自的贡献。

Conclusion: MVLoMa以单次联合推理替代逐边独立匹配，在提升相对位姿估计精度的同时显著降低参考侧重复计算，验证了多视几何上下文注入与联合推理的有效性。

Abstract: Local feature matching is typically formulated for image pairs, although structure-from-motion and visual localization commonly match one reference image against many retrieved or covisible neighbours. Applying a pairwise matcher independently to these centre-neighbour edges duplicates reference-side computation and prevents the matcher from exploiting complementary multi-view geometric evidence from the remaining observations. To address these limitations, we introduce MVLoMa, a sparse star-graph matcher that extends LoMa from image pairs to multiple views. MVLoMa first uses a frozen multi-view geometry model to jointly describe all images in a star, then injects the resulting cross-view geometric context into local descriptors. It then matches the centre image to all neighbours in a single forward pass through per-view self-attention and bidirectional centre-neighbour cross-attention. For supervision, we derive positive correspondences only from depth-valid, mutually visible dense warps and explicitly penalize high-confidence matches that violate epipolar geometry. On 25-view star graphs from HyperSim, ScanNet++, Mip-NeRF 360, and Tanks and Temples, MVLoMa obtains the best macro-average relative-pose AUC among the compared methods at all three thresholds (58.65/85.41/90.99). Its matcher is 2.20 times faster than sequential evaluation of the 24 centre-neighbour edges. The same design supports four tested frozen geometry encoders -- DA3, $π^3$, VGGT, and VGGT-$Ω$ -- with DA3-Giant performing best on all reported encoder-ablation metrics. Controlled ablations further isolate the effects of geometry-aware descriptors, visibility filtering, geometric negative supervision, and joint multi-view inference.

</details>


### [78] [WeVisOne-VL: Unified Visual Perception from Objects to Pixels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31329)
*Tianming Liang,Junyi Pan,Yuxi Li,Canmiao Fu,Zhipeng Huang,Chong Sun,Chen Li,Jing Lyu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出WeVisOne-VL，通过结构化下一词元预测统一目标级与像素级视觉感知，支持检测、指代定位、计数、OCR、分割、抠图等多任务，并在30余个基准上取得领先性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在细粒度视觉感知上仍不可靠，缺乏对任意用户指定粒度（点、框、掩码、alpha遮罩）的精确定位能力。

Method: 架构上将轻量像素解码器通过特殊<OBJ>词元接入VLM以生成实例级像素输出；训练采用三阶段课程式SFT，随后进行混合任务强化学习。

Result: 在30余个基准上，目标级与像素级任务均达到领先性能，并对目标缺失查询保持稳健的拒答能力。

Conclusion: WeVisOne-VL开源后将推动VLM从宽泛视觉理解走向面向真实部署的可靠感知系统。

Abstract: Existing vision-language models (VLMs) remain unreliable for fine-grained visual perception. In this report, we present WeVisOne-VL (WeChat Vision All-in-One), a powerful VLM that unifies object-level and pixel-level perception through structured next-token prediction. It supports multiple visual tasks including object detection, referring localization, counting, OCR, segmentation, and matting, enabling localization at any user-specific granularity, from points and boxes to masks and alpha mattes. Architecturally, we integrate a lightweight pixel decoder into the VLM via a special <OBJ> token to generate instance-level pixel outputs. We train the model with a three-stage curriculum SFT followed by mixed-task RL. Across over 30 benchmarks, WeVisOne-VL demonstrates leading performance on both object-level and pixel-level tasks, while maintaining robust rejection for object-absent queries. By releasing WeVisOne-VL to the open-source community, we hope to advance VLMs from broad visual understanding toward truly reliable perception systems for real-world deployment.

</details>


### [79] [A Task-Centric Survey of Long-Document Visual Question Answering: Taxonomy, Evolution, and Future Directions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31385)
*Yufei Tong,Guanjie Cheng,Tianle Wu,Leilei Zhang,Hang Zheng,Peihan Wu,Jianwei Yin,Shuiguang Deng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 一篇以任务为中心的综述，将长文档视觉问答（VQA）分解为文档解析、证据组织与检索、生成器组织与学习、评估四个组成部分，并沿技术动机与跨组件联系展开细粒度分类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有综述多聚焦模型架构或技术路线，较少关注任务瓶颈如何塑造技术选择与研究优先级。作者希望以任务瓶颈为线索，解释技术方案与研究方向的形成逻辑。

Method: 采用任务中心（task-centric）的综述方法：将长文档VQA拆解为四个组件——文档解析、证据组织与检索、生成器组织与学习、评估；对每个组件建立细粒度分类体系，追溯其动机、技术回应及跨组件关联；以显式检索为主线，同时覆盖直接阅读（direct reading）范式；并进行时间维度分析以刻画研究重点的演进。

Result: 时间分析显示研究优先级由多模态内容理解逐步扩展至充分且高保真的证据获取，以及持续性的证据管理；并梳理出组件间的依赖与联动关系。

Conclusion: 提出未来方向：证据充分性、可验证与可纠正的理解、预算感知的协调，并展望持续文档理解（continual document understanding）。

Abstract: Visual document understanding is essential for acquiring knowledge from visually rich documents and is attracting growing research interest. Existing surveys emphasize architectures or technical approaches, with limited attention to how task bottlenecks shape technical choices and research priorities. We present a task-centric survey that decomposes long-document visual question answering (VQA) into four components: document parsing, evidence organization and retrieval, generator organization and learning, and evaluation. For each, we develop a fine-grained taxonomy and trace motivations, technical responses, and cross-component connections. We focus on explicit retrieval while covering direct reading. Our temporal analysis traces expanding priorities from multimodal content understanding to sufficient, high-fidelity evidence acquisition and sustained evidence management. We outline future directions in evidence sufficiency, verifiable and correctable understanding, and budget-aware coordination, with an outlook on continual document understanding.

</details>


### [80] [MixPT: Point Transformer with Interleaved Window and Global Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31455)
*Minkyun Seo,Hyungtae Lim,Jaesik Park*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MixPT 通过交错使用窗口注意力与全局注意力模块，在单一固定序列化模式下兼顾计算成本与全场景交互，在室内外基准上以更低延迟取得有竞争力的精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 窗口注意力与全局注意力在"全场景交互"（跨场景内 token 的信息交换）上各有代价：窗口注意力受限于窗口内连接，跨窗口交互依赖窗口成员变化与层级池化；全局注意力虽直接连接所有 token，但 token 数大时计算开销高。作者希望在计算成本与全场景交互之间取得更好平衡。

Method: 提出 MixPT：一种点云 Transformer，以交错调度方式混合窗口注意力模块与全局注意力模块，且窗口模块保持单一固定的序列化模式。对 token 数较多的场景，全局注意力作用于空间池化后的 token，并将残差更新回传至原始分辨率特征流。此外通过重复该交错模式实现注意力阶段的深度扩展。

Result: 在室内与室外基准上，MixPT 取得与代表性窗口注意力和全局注意力基线相当的精度，同时延迟更低；并验证了在深度方向扩展注意力阶段（重复交错模式）的可行性。

Conclusion: 混合并交错窗口/全局注意力、配合固定序列化与池化 token 上的全局注意力，是平衡点云 Transformer 计算效率与全场景信息交互的有效设计，且支持深度扩展。

Abstract: Point cloud transformers aim to capture detailed local geometry and relationships across a scene at a manageable computational cost. Two common approaches are window attention and global attention. They differ in how they enable scene-wide interaction, which refers to information exchange among tokens across a scene. Window attention reduces computational cost by restricting self-attention to groups of tokens called windows; in serialized designs, each window contains a fixed number of consecutive tokens from a spatially ordered sequence. Because each block only directly connects tokens within the same window, information exchange across windows relies on changes in window membership across blocks and hierarchical pooling. Global attention, in contrast, directly connects all tokens within a scene, but computing attention over all token pairs can be costly when the number of tokens is large. To balance computational cost and scene-wide interaction, we introduce MixPT, a point transformer that uses a mix of window and global attention blocks in an interleaved schedule, while retaining a single fixed serialization pattern for its window blocks. For scenes with a large number of tokens, MixPT applies global attention to spatially pooled tokens and returns residual updates to the original-resolution stream. Across indoor and outdoor benchmarks, MixPT achieves competitive accuracy with lower latency than representative window and global attention baselines. We further demonstrate the feasibility of scaling the attention stage in depth by repeating the interleaved pattern of window and global attention blocks.

</details>


### [81] [AnyGameRenderer: Entity-Consistent Generative Rendering Across Games and an Entity-Level Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31466)
*Ruicong Liu,Liangyang Ouyang,Fengbo Lan,Zhixiang Wang,Kaipeng Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AnyGameRenderer 是一个视频到视频的生成式渲染器，可将 AI 智能体生成的"程序员美术"（灰模、彩色几何体、语义色块）游戏画面转换为具备角色、动作细节与特效的高质量视觉，同时保持布局、相机以及每个实体的位置与时间一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI 编码智能体已能在数分钟内构建小型可玩游戏，但产物普遍是灰模方块、彩色几何图元与扁平语义色块这类"程序员美术"，视觉质量低下。作者希望在不改变游戏逻辑与实体时序的前提下，自动将这些粗糙画面提升为高质量渲染。

Method: 以纯视频作为游戏状态输入，无需引擎 G-buffer、逐物体类别标签或低模代理；灰模、彩色图元、语义图、线框均可作为输入。实现上对 33B 的参考视频条件视频生成模型 MiniMax-H3 ref2va 进行 LoRA 微调。训练数据约 1 万对配对片段，来自三类来源：(i) 38 个由 AI 游戏创作工具 GEAR 导出的智能体自制游戏的多流渲染数据；(ii) Unreal Engine 双流渲染数据，通过程序化方式控制人群、数量变化与实体尺度；(iii) 真实游戏录像，通过 3D 框检测重建配对。此外提出一个实体级基准：59 个留出案例、753 个实体，以真值框评分。

Result: 相较基座模型，AnyGameRenderer 更好地保持实体对应关系：时序匹配率由 50.9% 提升至 62.9%，漏检数量变化由 34.7% 降至 21.3%，幻觉实体与未渲染实体均减少。方法泛化于塔防、自走棋、俯视角生存、回合制战斗、卡丁车竞速、人群跑酷等多种类型。

Conclusion: 以纯视频为接口的生成式渲染是提升智能体自制游戏视觉质量的有效途径，且通过针对性数据构造（多流与程序化控制数据）可显著改善实体级对应保真度；现有指标仍有较大提升空间（时序匹配仅 62.9%）。

Abstract: AI coding agents can now build small playable games in minutes, but the results usually look like programmer art: gray blockouts, colored geometric primitives, and flat semantic blobs. We present AnyGameRenderer, a video-to-video generative renderer that turns such footage into high-quality visuals with characters, motion detail, and effects. Throughout, it keeps the layout, camera, and every entity's position and timing intact.
