TL;DR: 本文报道一种单片钽酸锂光子芯片（称为 signal core），可在单芯片上生成、调制、路由并探测 100 GHz 至 2.5 THz 的离散连续波信号，且仅通过光纤光学接口与外部连接，并可在 4 K 稀释制冷机中工作。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 100 GHz 以上电子信号链受限于弱源、高噪声接收机与高损耗互连；现有光子方案仍依赖损耗较大的片外电学或自由空间链路，难以满足致密集成、低温及空间受限场景的需求。

Method: 构建单片钽酸锂光子芯片架构：片上集成高频功能模块，以微共面带状线（micro-coplanar striplines）将各模块串联为端到端信号链；利用双向相干电光转换实现信号生成、探测及纳秒级幅度与相位调制；外部仅采用光纤光学接口。

Result: 实现单光子电光耦合速率 g_0/2π = 10 kHz；峰值驱动功率归一化光子通量转换效率在生成端为 1.0%/mW、探测端为 0.5%/mW；覆盖 100 GHz–2.5 THz 离散频率；并在稀释制冷机 4 K 环境下经同一纯光纤链路正常运行。

Conclusion: 该工作建立了面向毫米波至太赫兹系统的全光子平台，为受电互连损耗、热负载与尺寸约束的应用提供了通用架构。

Abstract: Millimeter-wave and terahertz technologies offer new opportunities for high-capacity communications, sensing, and quantum systems, but electronic signal chains above 100 GHz are limited by weak sources, noisy receivers, and lossy interconnects. Photonic approaches mitigate these constraints by enabling chip-scale high-frequency components, yet existing implementations generally retain lossy off-chip electrical or free-space links, hindering dense and compact integration for cryogenic or space-constrained settings. Here, we show a monolithic lithium tantalate photonic chip, termed a signal core, which generates, modulates, routes, and detects continuous-wave signals at discrete frequencies between 100 GHz and 2.5 THz. The architecture integrates high-frequency functional modules on chip and uses exclusively fiber-based optical interfaces. Bidirectional coherent electro-optic conversion enables signal generation, detection, and nanosecond-scale amplitude and phase modulation, while micro-coplanar striplines interconnect the modules into an end-to-end signal chain on a single chip. Our modules achieve single-photon electro-optic coupling rates of g_0/2π=10 kHz and peak drive-power-normalized photon-flux conversion efficiencies of 1.0%/mW for generation and 0.5%/mW for detection. It also operates at 4 K in a dilution refrigerator through the same fiber-only optical links. Together, these capabilities establish an all-photonic platform for millimeter-wave-to-terahertz systems and offer a broadly applicable architecture for applications constrained by electrical-interconnect loss, heat load, and footprint.

</details>


### [187] [Reconfigurable Free-Space Optical Interconnects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30757)
*Jaekwon Lee,Carson G. Valdez,Anne R. Kroo,David A. B. Miller,Olav Solgaard*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 提出基于可重构微镜阵列的自由空间光互连系统，利用二维扩展实现超过1万个低速通道、总容量100 Tbps；在9通道概念验证中通过活塞式微镜优化实现-21.7 dB平均最坏串扰。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有光波导/光纤互连存在成本、能耗与封装约束；自由空间光互连可承载大量低速率通道，需解决通道密度提升带来的串扰与扩展性问题。

Method: 构建基于可重构微镜阵列的自由空间光互连架构，建立通道数二维扩展模型并与实验对比；在含活塞式（piston-motion）微镜阵列的概念验证系统中对9个通道同时进行优化，并在不同通道间距、同时照明及不同输出数条件下考察优化流程，与平面tip-tilt镜方案对比。

Result: 通道数随二维扩展有利增长，投影可支撑>10,000通道以低速通道实现100 Tbps；9通道同时优化获得-21.7 dB平均最坏串扰，通道间距仅两倍光束半径，小于平面tip-tilt镜所需间距；多条件下最坏串扰普遍优于平面tip-tilt镜。

Conclusion: 活塞式微镜在所提自由空间光互连中具有明显优势，可实现更小通道间距与更低串扰，支撑高通道数、大容量互连扩展。

Abstract: Free-space optical interconnects can support many low-data-rate channels while avoiding the cost, energy consumption, and packaging constraints of optical waveguide- or fiber-based systems that are widely used today. We propose a free-space optical interconnect system based on reconfigurable micromirror arrays, and show that it scales favorably due to its two-dimensional scaling. We discuss the channel count scaling model, compare our demonstration with theory, and project a channel count above 10,000 to achieve 100 Tbps with slow channels (e.g., <10 Gbps). In a proof-of-concept system with a piston-motion micromirror array, we demonstrate nine channels that are simultaneously optimized. The optimization enables -21.7 dB of average worst-case crosstalk for a channel pitch equal to twice the beam radius, a smaller channel spacing than that required in flat tip-tilt mirrors. The optimization flow is further investigated for different channel spacings, simultaneous illumination, and different numbers of outputs, which generally achieve smaller worst-case crosstalk than the flat tip-tilt mirror case. Overall, the work demonstrates the advantage of piston-motion micromirrors in the proposed optical interconnects.

</details>


### [188] [Nanopillar metasurfaces uniting high optical reflectivity with ultracoherent nanomechanics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31452)
*Alexander Jung,Anastasiia Ciers,Hannes Pfeifer,Albert Hansson,Johanna Örgård,Daniel Stachanow,Viktor A. Lilja,Philippe Tassin,Witlef Wieczorek*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 通过在薄膜上引入高折射率纳米柱超表面，利用光子晶体导模共振的平带行为，实现了对紧聚焦光束的高反射率与超相干机械模式的同时兼容。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机械顺应性反射镜是腔光力学的关键部件，但最优光学性能（紧聚焦光束需厚反射镜）与机械性能（超相干弯曲纳米力学需薄膜）通常相互矛盾，本文旨在消除这一权衡。

Method: 在薄膜上制备高折射率纳米柱超表面，将直径50微米的纳米柱阵列图案化为光子晶体；利用其导模共振的平带行为实现紧聚焦光束高反射；两个导模共振的组合形成1550纳米附近100纳米宽的高反射带；纳米柱图案化同时构成密度调制声子晶体，隔离出超相干局域机械模式。

Result: 对腰斑7微米的紧聚焦光束实现99.82(1)%反射率；在1550纳米附近形成100纳米宽高反射带；局域机械模式的Q·f乘积达2×10^14 Hz。

Conclusion: 该纳米柱超表面可制备轻质反射镜，适用于室温量子光力学，并可作为悬浮反射镜或光帆使用。

Abstract: Mechanically compliant mirrors are key components in cavity optomechanics. However, the requirements to achieve the best optical and mechanical performance are usually in direct competition. A high reflectivity for tightly focused beams entails thick reflectors, whereas ultracoherent flexural nanomechanics necessitates thin membranes. We eliminate this trade-off by introducing high-refractive-index nanopillar metasurfaces on top of a thin membrane. We pattern a 50 micrometer-diameter array of nanopillars to form a photonic crystal. The flat band behavior of guided resonances in the photonic crystal enables a reflectivity of 99.82(1)% for a tightly focused beam of 7 micrometer waist. The combination of two guided resonances creates a 100 nanometer-wide high-reflectivity band around 1550 nanometer. Simultaneously, the nanopillar patterning realizes a density-modulated phononic crystal that isolates an ultracoherent localized mechanical mode with a $Q\cdot f$-product of $2\cdot 10^{14}$Hz. The demonstrated nanopillar metasurfaces enable lightweight mirrors for room-temperature quantum optomechanics and for use as levitated mirrors or lightsails.

</details>


### [189] [Light pulse propagation through a dielectric slab. II. Two roads to the same field: numerical cross-validation of local (FDTD-ADE) and non-local (retarded integral-equation) solutions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30833)
*Giancarlo Reali*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 本文直接用数值方法求解Paper I中导出的延迟积分方程，绕过局域微分表述，并与FDTD-ADE结果及Airy精确参考进行交叉验证，在0.02–1.3%内一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Paper I已证明平面平行介质平板中光传播的局域微分方程与延迟积分方程解析等价，但两者此前仅由FDTD-ADE求解局域方程间接验证；需要直接从积分表述出发独立求解，以检验该等价性在真正含时（超短脉冲）情形下的数值可靠性。

Method: 直接对延迟积分方程做数值求解，不经由局域微分表述；在同一物理与材料条件下与FDTD-ADE结果对比反射/透射能量份额；吸收份额由Lorentz阻尼项独立计算而非用1-R-T反推；并以脉冲谱加权的Airy公式为精确参考，辅以Richardson外推；测试几周期脉冲与亚波长平板情形，并给出九帧场演化可视化。

Result: 两套结构不同、独立实现的数值方案在反射与透射能量份额上一致到0.02–1.3%；两法的吸收份额亦高度吻合；直接解与Airy参考吻合在0.3%以内，其Richardson外推与参考在所示全部数位上一致；结论对几周期脉冲与亚波长平板仍成立，此时积分方程的朴素不动点迭代并非实用收敛策略。

Conclusion: 直接求解延迟积分方程与FDTD-ADE求解局域方程在含时区域给出数值一致的反射、透射与吸收结果，从而数值上交叉验证了两种表述的等价性；这是该真正时间依赖情形下对该等价性的首次直接数值交叉验证。

Abstract: Paper I of this series (arXiv:2610.29336) solves, via the retarded Green's functions, the local differential equations governing light propagation in a plane-parallel dielectric slab, obtaining a pair of retarded integral equations that represent, at the continuum level, the microscopic multiple-scattering picture underlying the local formulation. The two formulations are thus proven to be analytically equivalent. The local system of differential equations is then solved numerically with a finite-difference time-domain scheme (FDTD-ADE). This report closes the loop by solving the retarded integral equations directly, without passing through the local formulation, and comparing the result with the FDTD-ADE solution under the same physical and material conditions. The two independently implemented, structurally different numerical schemes agree within 0.02-1.3% for the reported reflected and transmitted energy fractions; the absorbed fraction, computed independently in both schemes from the Lorentz damping term rather than merely inferred from 1-R-T, agrees closely between the two methods, to the precision reported. Both solutions are also compared with an exact reference, the Airy formula weighted over the pulse spectrum: the direct solution reproduces it to within 0.3%, and its Richardson extrapolation to all digits shown. The agreement persists for a few-cycle pulse and for a sub-wavelength slab, where naive fixed-point iteration of the integral equations is not a practical convergent strategy. A complementary set of movie-style, nine-frame visualizations is also presented, illustrating the same equivalence directly in the field rather than only in integrated observables. To the author's knowledge, a direct numerical cross-validation of these two formulations in this genuinely time-dependent regime has not previously been reported.

</details>


### [190] [Confinement of hybridized light modes in nonlinear-optical superpotentials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31643)
*Federico Presutti,Ryotatsu Yanagimoto*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 该文提出由相干频率转换诱导的时空光捕获机制：在泵浦非线性介导的两个信号模式（频域分束器作用）反向传播时，于非线性零点处产生时间捕获本征模，并与超对称量子力学建立联系，从而保证捕获模式的存在性与鲁棒性并给出解析解，进而提出基于薄膜铌酸锂的原理性验证实验与主动光子存储器应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索一种全新的主动光捕获/存储机制，将频域模式耦合与空间传播结合，为集成非线性光子学提供可实现的存储与多模量子非线性功能。

Method: 考虑波混频过程，泵浦非线性在两个信号模式间充当频域分束器；当两波反向传播时，在非线性剖面零点处形成时间捕获本征模。借助超对称量子力学（SUSY QM）框架证明该束缚模式的存在性与鲁棒性，并推导束缚本征模的解析解；设计薄膜铌酸锂上的原理性实验，并研究该时间陷阱与参量增益协同工作的情形。

Result: 建立了时空光捕获与超对称量子力学之间的直接映射，获得束缚本征模的解析解；表明反向和频转换可实现一类独特的有源光子存储器件，其设计参数与当前集成非线性光子学工艺水平兼容；并给出可验证的实验方案。

Conclusion: 相干频率转换可作为一种空间与时间维度上的光捕获机制，兼具理论优雅性（SUSY QM 保证）与工艺可行性，潜在应用于经典集成光子学及多模量子非线性光子学。

Abstract: In this work, we present a spatial and temporal light trapping mechanism induced by coherent frequency conversion. We consider a wave-mixing process, where a pumped nonlinearity mediates a frequency-domain beamsplitter interaction between two signal modes. When these wave modes are counterpropagating, temporally trapped eigenmodes emerge at the zero of the nonlinearity profile. We establish that such spatio-temporal trapping has a direct connection to supersymmetric quantum mechanics, which ensures the existence and robustness of the trapped modes and allows us to derive analytic solutions of the bound eigenmodes. Backwards sum-frequency conversion may thus enable a unique class of active photonic memory devices, whose design parameters are compatible with the state of the art in integrated nonlinear photonics. We propose proof-of-principle experiments to study this nonlinear-optical trapping effect on thin-film lithium niobate. In addition, as a case study, we show how the temporal trap can be used alongside parametric gain. Our work unveils potential applications ranging from classical integrated photonics to multimode quantum nonlinear photonics.

</details>


### [191] [Laser-design methodology for extending an available wavelength range of dual-wavelength injection-seeded laser](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30897)
*Ayaka Hashimoto,Tetsuto Watanabe. Sota Kobayashi,Megumi Otose,Ken'ichi Nakagawa,Masayuki Katsuragawa*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 提出一种通过给输出耦合镜引入波长依赖特性来扩展双波长振荡注入锁定激光器适用波长范围的方法，可在不增加腔内损耗的前提下实现增益中心与增益尾部同时振荡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双波长振荡注入锁定激光器的适用波长范围受限于增益谱；当要求同时覆盖增益中心与增益尾部（需求最严苛的情形）时，常规设计难以兼顾，且不希望以牺牲腔内损耗为代价。

Method: 在输出耦合镜上引入波长依赖的透过/耦合特性，而不在谐振腔内附加任何损耗元件；依据实验测量结果确定所需的波长依赖特性，并据此设计输出耦合镜。

Result: 使用所设计的输出耦合器，在增益中心附近与增益尾部附近的多种波长组合下实现了输出功率相等的双波长同时振荡，最大波长间隔达60 nm。

Conclusion: 输出耦合镜的波长依赖设计可有效拓宽双波长注入锁定激光器的工作波长范围，且不引入额外腔内损耗，方法可由实验测量指导设计并具实用性。

Abstract: This paper describes a method for expanding the applicable wavelength range of dual-wavelength oscillation injection-locked lasers. Special focus is placed on the laser design that enables simultaneous oscillations at both the gain center and gain tail, requiring the most stringent requirements. We show that a sufficient performance can be achieved by introducing a wavelength-dependence property onto the output coupling mirror, without giving any losses in the laser resonator. We also show how we can determine such wavelength-dependent property on the basis of experimental measurements. Using the designed output-coupler, in practices, we demonstrate simultaneous oscillations with an equal output power, across a variety of wavelength combinations of near the gain center and around the gain tail in which the wavelength separation amounts 60 nm at the most.

</details>


### [192] [Intrinsic Angular Momentum Contribution to the Sagnac Response of a Rotating Helical Optical Fiber](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30898)
*Lili Yang,Pengming Zhang,Longlong Feng*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 基于四分量光学狄拉克方程，研究结构光在机械旋转均匀螺旋光纤中的旋转诱导相位积累；证明在共路镜面反射几何中扭转几何相位与Sagnac相位整圈抵消，而内禀旋转-角动量相位保留，可作为探测内禀总角动量的共路干涉途径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探明结构光（携带内禀总角动量）在旋转螺旋光纤中相位积累的来源区分问题，即在扭转几何耦合、Sagnac面积效应与机械旋转耦合共存时，如何分离出与模式内禀角动量相关的相位成分，为旋转传感提供新的物理量。

Method: 采用四分量光学狄拉克型方程描述结构光在均匀螺旋光纤中的传播；在傍轴与弱几何近似下，将内禀动力学分解为扭转诱导的几何耦合与机械旋转-角动量耦合两项；分析共路镜面反射（往返）几何下各相位项的符号与积累行为。

Result: 在完整往返中，扭转诱导的几何相位与常规依赖面积的Sagnac贡献均相互抵消；仅内禀旋转-角动量相位（依赖模式内禀总角动量）得以保留。

Conclusion: 该保留下来的相位与结构光模式的内禀总角动量直接相关，提供了一条共路干涉式的旋转传感路径，可用于探测内禀角动量效应并抑制几何与Sagnac共模噪声。

Abstract: We investigate rotation-induced phase accumulation of structured light in a mechanically rotating uniform helical optical fiber using a four-component optical Dirac-like equation. In the paraxial and weak-geometry regime, the intrinsic dynamics contain a torsion-induced geometric coupling and a mechanical rotation--angular-momentum coupling. We show that, in a common-path mirror-reflection geometry, both the torsion-induced geometric phase and the conventional area-dependent Sagnac contribution cancel over a complete round trip, whereas the intrinsic rotation--angular-momentum phase survives. The surviving phase depends on the intrinsic total angular momentum of the structured optical mode and provides a common-path interferometric route for probing intrinsic angular momentum effects in rotational sensing.

</details>


### [193] [Efficient Modeling of 3D-Printed Freeform Waveguides with a Transformation Optics-Based Beam Propagation Method](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31004)
*Sina Foroutan-Barenji,Jonas Krimmer,Stefan Singer,Christian Koos,Wolfgang Freude*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 提出将变换光学(TO)与曲线网格结合，把3D打印自由曲面光子引线键合(PWB)映射为具各向异性材料的直波导，再用各向异性全矢量BPM求解；相比FDTD，仿真时间缩短两个数量级以上，功率传输MAPE为3.9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D打印自由曲面光子引线键合(PWB)结构弯曲、几何复杂，直接全波仿真（如FDTD）计算代价高，需要一种高效且精度可接受的数值方法。

Method: 采用变换光学(TO)结合曲线网格，将原始3D自由曲面PWB结构映射为等价的直线波导，该直波导具有各向异性材料参数；随后用各向异性全矢量光束传播法(BPM)对该等价结构进行求解，并与FDTD结果对比验证。

Result: 与FDTD相比，仿真时间缩短超过两个数量级（缩短程度取决于轨迹弯曲程度），功率传输仿真的平均绝对百分比误差(MAPE)为3.9%。

Conclusion: TO-BPM方法在保持较低误差的同时显著降低计算成本，是分析3D打印自由曲面PWB波导传播特性的高效数值工具。

Abstract: An efficient numerical method is introduced for simulating wave propagation in 3D-printed freeform waveguides, referred to as photonic wire bonds (PWBs). This approach integrates transformation optics (TO) with curvilinear meshing to map the original 3D freeform PWB structure onto a straight waveguide, which possesses anisotropic material characteristics. The resulting waveguide is then analyzed using an anisotropic full-vectorial beam propagation method (BPM). To validate the performance and effectiveness of the proposed TO-BPM algorithm, a comparison is made with the finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) technique. Our approach reduces the simulation time by more than two orders of magnitude, depending on the degree of trajectory bending, in combination with a mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) of 3.9% in power transmission simulation relative to the FDTD.

</details>


### [194] [Effective-action formulation of $\mathbf{k}$-odd bianisotropy and unidirectional polarization rotation in nonlocal temporal metamaterials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31022)
*Neng Wang,Guo Ping Wang*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 通过电磁拉格朗日密度的多尺度分析，导出含空间一阶导数的时域超材料有效作用量，揭示k-奇的非局部双各向异性耦合张量，并基于作用量的Hessian建立洛伦兹互易性判据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时域超材料（时间调制媒质）的有效介质描述通常只保留局域响应，缺乏对空间色散（非局部效应）的系统推导，也缺少统一的互易性判据来区分不同双各向异性耦合对洛伦兹互易性的影响。

Method: 对电磁拉格朗日密度作多尺度（空间多尺度展开）分析，展开至空间导数一阶，构造有效作用量；以作用量的Hessian为框架分析洛伦兹互易性，并用归一化Stokes矢量的旋转表征非互易性。

Result: 一阶空间修正给出对波矢k为奇数的有效双各向异性耦合张量；手性、赝手性与omega型响应是同一非局部耦合张量的不同方向表现，即使电、磁响应张量本身对称也可出现。omega型耦合下洛伦兹互易性保持，手性或赝手性耦合出现时互易性破缺，表现为Floquet工程手性/赝手性引起的归一化Stokes矢量单向旋转。

Conclusion: 时域超材料的空间非局部性可统一生成各类双各向异性响应，且互易性由有效作用量的Hessian结构决定；该框架可用于判别与设计时间调制体系中的非互易手性光学效应。

Abstract: We derive the effective action of temporal metamaterials up to first order in spatial derivatives through a multiscale analysis of the electromagnetic Lagrangian density. We show that the first-order spatial correction gives rise to an effective bianisotropic coupling tensor that is odd in the wavevector $\mathbf{k}$. Remarkably, chiral, pseudochiral, and omega-type bianisotropic responses emerge as distinct directional manifestations of a single nonlocal coupling tensor, even when the underlying electric and magnetic response tensors remain symmetric. Furthermore, we establish a framework for analyzing Lorentz reciprocity based on the Hessian of the effective action. We demonstrate that Lorentz reciprocity is preserved in the presence of omega-type coupling but is broken when chiral or pseudochiral coupling emerges. This nonreciprocity manifests as the unidirectional rotations of normalized Stokes vectors incurred by Floquet-engineered chirality and pseudochirality.

</details>


### [195] [The Mechanism of Chirality in Plasmonic Structures: Asymmetric Resonance Modes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31045)
*Abduweli Abdukerim*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 本文提出以非对称等离激元共振模式分布为核心的理论框架，解释手性纳米结构中手性产生与圆二色性（CD）的机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有研究将手性光学性质与共振差异相联系，但这些差异的具体性质与来源尚未被充分阐明，缺乏定量层面的机制解释。

Method: 定量分析模式非对称性引起的非对称电场分量；考察单个纳米棒与角堆叠耦合结构（CSCS）的近场对称性；对比RCP与LCP照明下复合结构中电磁场的相位与振幅响应，并结合吸收谱与CD谱进行分析。

Result: 手性源于非对称电场分布，其在RCP与LCP激发下产生不同的相位与振幅响应；吸收与CD谱在约910 nm处呈现明显特征，支持该机制。

Conclusion: 所提机制不局限于特定手性结构或共振模式，可为圆二色性的产生提供更普适的解释，并对手性光学材料设计具有指导意义。

Abstract: This study presents a theoretical framework for understanding the mechanism of chirality generation and circular dichroism (CD) in chiral nanostructures, with a particular focus on the role of asymmetric plasmon resonance mode distributions. Although previous studies have linked chiroptical properties to resonance differences, the specific nature and origin of these differences have not been fully elucidated. Here, we provide a more detailed explanation by quantitatively analyzing the asymmetric electric-field components arising from mode asymmetry. Specifically, we examine the near-field symmetry of individual nanorods and corner-stacked coupled structures (CSCS). The results demonstrate that chirality arises from asymmetric electric-field distributions, which give rise to distinct phase and amplitude responses of the electromagnetic fields in the composite structure under right-handed circularly polarized (RCP) and left-handed circularly polarized (LCP) illumination. The absorption and CD spectra, which exhibit distinct features around $910\,\mathrm{nm}$, support this mechanism and provide valuable insights into the design of chiroptical materials. The proposed mechanism is not restricted to a specific chiral structure or resonance and offers a broader explanation for the generation of circular dichroism.

</details>


### [196] [Shaping Near Fields of Photonic Modes into Topological Textures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31207)
*Jonas Biechteler,Michael Hirler,Connor Heimig,Martin Barkey,Haoran Ren,Stefan A. Maier,Enrico Baù,Andreas Tittl*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 该工作利用支持准连续域束缚态（quasi-BIC）共振的介质超表面，通过几何工程（单元条面内形变+旋转对称性设计）在无极化激元表面波参与的条件下塑造近场拓扑织构（同心环涡旋、阿基米德螺旋中的拓扑荷双峰），并用相位分辨s-SNOM实验验证，建立了光谱与空间可扩展的近场拓扑光子学平台。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近场光学拓扑（涡旋、斯格明子）对高密度信息编码与光-物质相互作用有吸引力，但现有实现主要依赖极化激元平台，其拓扑与材料色散强绑定，受传播损耗限制导致器件尺寸受限，且工作光谱范围固定。亟需一种不依赖极化激元表面波、可光谱与空间扩展的近场拓扑生成方案。

Method: 提出以介质超表面几何工程塑造近场拓扑：设计支持quasi-BIC共振的硅基超表面，单元条的面内形变可局域保持其共振驱动近场，从而使超表面几何与入射光偏振共同决定生成拓扑；通过将硅单元胞塑造成具有旋转对称性的几何构型实现可控拓扑荷；采用相位分辨散射型近场光学显微镜（s-SNOM）对近场进行实验表征。

Result: 实验表征到高纯度的共振锁定拓扑：同心环中的涡旋结构以及阿基米德螺旋结构中的拓扑荷双峰（topological charge doublets）；这些场织构为纯光子模式，径向为驻波形式的稳定standing wave，不依赖表面波传播或极化激元色散。

Conclusion: 该方案摆脱了极polariton platform对材料色散与传播损耗的依赖，实现了几何与偏振协同调控的近场拓扑，可在光谱和空间维度上扩展，为近场拓扑光子学（高密度信息编码、光-物质相互作用）提供了可扩展平台。

Abstract: Topological textures of light, such as optical vortices and skyrmions, are attractive for high-density information encoding and light-matter interactions. In the near field, topologies have primarily been realized using polaritonic platforms that inherently tie the platform to the material dispersion, limiting their footprint due to propagation losses and restricting their operating spectral region. Here, we introduce a route to shape near-field topologies through the geometric engineering of a dielectric metasurface supporting a quasi-bound state in the continuum resonance, without the need for polaritonic surface waves. In-plane deformation of our metasurface bars conserves their resonance-driven near-fields locally, so that the metasurface geometry and the polarization of the illuminating light dictate the generated topology. By shaping silicon unit cells into geometries with rotational symmetry, we create optical topologies with controllable topological charge. Using phase-resolved scattering-type near-field optical microscopy, we experimentally characterize high-purity resonance-locked topologies such as vortices in concentric rings and topological charge doublets in Archimedean spirals. In contrast to conventional topological textures, our purely photonic mode-based field textures are stationary standing waves in the radial direction, without relying on surface-wave propagation or polaritonic dispersion, establishing a spectrally and spatially scalable platform for near-field topological photonics.

</details>


### [197] [Second- and third-order nonlinearities in silicon nitride waveguides via heterogeneous integration of lithium niobate membranes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31243)
*Natale G. Pruiti,Cosmin Suciu,Eugenio Di Gaetano,Jonathan M. Silver,Douglas J. Paul,Marc Sorel*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 通过将预制的x切薄膜铌酸锂贴合到成品氮化硅波导上，实现单一波导同时产生跨越一个倍频程的超连续谱与二、和、差频过程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 厚膜色散工程氮化硅是集成三阶非线性光学的领先平台，可支持超连续谱与频率梳，但缺乏许多应用所需的二阶非线性。

Method: 以后端工艺方式，将预制x切薄膜铌酸锂膜键合到已完成的（商用可兼容的）氮化硅波导上。

Result: 单个氮化硅波导产生跨倍频程超连续谱，并借助铌酸锂膜同时实现二次谐波、和频与差频产生。

Conclusion: 为厚氮化硅光子学开辟新途径，可用于可见光产生及片上f-2f梳自参考，是迈向小型化授时与导航量子技术的关键一步。

Abstract: Thick, dispersion-engineered silicon nitride is a leading platform for integrated third-order nonlinear optics, supporting supercontinuum and frequency comb generation. However, it lacks the second-order nonlinearity required by many applications. Here we bond pre-fabricated x-cut thin-film lithium niobate membranes onto finished silicon nitride waveguides as a back-end step, compatible with commercially fabricated waveguides. A single silicon nitride waveguide generates an octave-spanning supercontinuum and, through the lithium niobate membrane, concurrent second-harmonic, sum- and difference-frequency generation. These results open new possibilities for thick silicon nitride photonics, from visible light generation to on-chip $f$-$2f$ comb self-referencing, a key step towards miniaturised timing and navigation quantum technologies.

</details>


### [198] [A New Twist on Astigmatic Transformation: Beyond Laguerre-Gaussian Beams](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31313)
*Gabriela Flores-Cova,Bikash Kumar Das,Carmelo Rosales-Guzman,Valeria-Rodriguez-Fajardo,Camilo Granados*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 该文证明散光变换的"相位-强度"转换不限于Laguerre-Gaussian模，对高阶Bessel-Gauss与完美涡旋场同样成立，强度极小值数目由方位相位绕数直接决定，并推广至不可分矢量Bessel-Gauss光束，实现分量空间模拓扑荷的偏振分辨独立测量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 散光变换长期被当作Laguerre-Gaussian涡旋光束拓扑荷读出的标准手段，但其是否依赖该特定径向分布尚不明确，限制了该方法的普适性与适用范围。

Method: 解析推导高阶Bessel-Gauss与完美光学涡旋场经散光变换后的场分布；以数值模拟与实验测量在两族光束上验证"强度极小值数目=方位相位绕数"的规律；进一步将该框架拓展至空间自由度与偏振自由度耦合的不可分矢量Bessel-Gauss光束，采用偏振分辨探测。

Result: 尽管径向结构差异显著，两类光束的散光变换图样中强度极小值数目仍由累积方位相位绕数唯一确定；模拟与实验均予证实；在不可分矢量光束中，偏振分辨探测可分别确定各组成空间模的拓扑荷。

Conclusion: 散光变换可作为一种对任意径向剖面的标量结构光场拓扑荷的直接探测手段，并可经偏振分辨推广至矢量结构光场，为拓扑荷测量提供与径向自由度无关的通用方法。

Abstract: Astigmatic transformation is widely used to convert the azimuthal phase structure of Laguerre-Gaussian vortex beams into intensity patterns from which the topological charge can be read out. Here, we show that this phase-to-intensity conversion is not just restricted to the Laguerre-Gaussian radial profile. We derive analytical expressions for the astigmatically transformed high-order Bessel--Gauss and perfect optical vortex fields, and find that, despite their substantially different radial structures, the number of intensity minima is directly set by the accumulated azimuthal phase winding. Numerical simulations and experimental measurements on both beam families confirm this result, establishing astigmatic transformation as a direct probe of the topological charge of scalar structured optical fields. We further extend the approach to non-separable vector Bessel-Gauss beams, in which the spatial and polarization degrees of freedom are coupled, and show that polarization-resolved detection allows the topological charge of the constituent spatial modes to be determined independently.

</details>


### [199] [Predictive electronic feedback control for narrow-linewidth lasers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31396)
*Jiatian Liu,Xuan Qi,Xiayang Fan,Shenchao Jin,Yuan Sun*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 提出基于Smith预估器的通用方法，在PDH反馈环的电子部分内部解决时延问题，仅增加一个FPGA控制器即可抑制相位噪声与伺服凸起。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 窄线宽激光在量子相干控制、量子精密测量与量子信息科学中至关重要，PDH是标准稳频手段，但反馈环固有时间延迟会引入过量相位噪声（伺服凸起）；已有方案多依赖电子反馈环之外的附加光学元件。

Method: 将Smith预估器引入PDH反馈控制环的电子部分，用于补偿时延引起的相位滞后；实现上仅在环内增加一个FPGA控制器，无需额外光学器件。

Result: 系统验证了该方法抑制相位噪声、降低伺服凸起的能力。

Conclusion: 该方法概念简洁、硬件开销极小、实际有效，并有望推广至多种未来应用。

Abstract: Narrow-linewidth lasers are essential for various key atom-laser interaction processes and optical setups in quantum coherent control, quantum precision measurement, and quantum information science. The Pound-Drever-Hall (PDH) technique is the standard method for the frequency-stabilization of narrow-linewidth lasers, but the inherent time delay in its feedback loop inevitably induces excessive phase noise, commonly known as servo bumps. Previous solutions primarily rely on additional optical components outside the electronic feedback control loop. Here, we propose and implement a generic method based on the Smith predictor to address the time-delay issue entirely within the electronic part of the PDH feedback control loop. We systematically demonstrate its capability to suppress phase noise and reduce servo bumps by adding only a single Field-Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) controller to the loop. This class of methods is demonstrated to be conceptually concise with minimal hardware overhead, effective in practice, and holds potential for a wide variety of future applications.

</details>


### [200] [Observation of Polarization Topology in Magneto-Optical BICs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31498)
*Yaqi Li,Mingyu Tong,Fujia Chen,Li Zhang,Rui Zhao,Yuze Hu,Bei Wu,Haiyao Luo,Hongsheng Chen,Yihao Yang*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 该工作实验重建了磁光BIC的二维远场本征偏振织构，在不依赖互易性的前提下提取共振输出偏振，测得其拓扑荷q=+1，并发现仅调磁场强度即可反转偏振手性而拓扑荷不变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 磁光BIC虽兼具偏振拓扑与磁可调手性，但时间反演对称性破缺使本征偏振难以提取，其实验表征长期困难。

Method: 对偏振分辨的角度分辨反射矩阵做奇异值分解（不假设互易性）以提取共振输出偏振，重建Γ点附近的远场本征偏振方位角织构；并建立非厄米耦合模模型解释手性反转。

Result: 偏振方位角绕Γ点逆时针缠绕2π，拓扑荷q=+1；仅改变磁场偏置强度即可反转偏振手性，而场方向与所测拓扑荷保持不变；耦合模模型将反转归因于BIC模式与泄漏模式的杂化。

Conclusion: 该工作建立了非互易光子学中动量空间偏振拓扑的实验探测途径，为研究拓扑奇点及其在主动时间反演破缺下的演化提供了可能。

Abstract: Polarization topology in momentum space is a fundamental characteristic of photonic bound states in the continuum (BICs), where the winding of far-field polarization defines a quantized topological charge. Although magneto-optical (MO) BICs combine polarization topology with magnetically tunable chirality, experimental characterization remains challenging because time-reversal symmetry (TRS) breaking complicates eigenpolarization extraction. Here, we experimentally resolve the momentum-space polarization topology of an MO BIC by reconstructing its two-dimensional far-field eigenpolarization texture. We extract the resonant output polarization using singular value decomposition of the polarization-resolved angle-resolved reflection matrix without invoking reciprocity. The reconstructed polarization azimuth winds counterclockwise by 2$π$ around the $Γ$-point singularity, yielding a topological charge of q = +1. Moreover, the polarization handedness can be reversed solely by varying the magnetic-bias strength, while the field direction and the measured topological charge remain unchanged. A non-Hermitian coupled-mode model traces this reversal to hybridization between the BIC mode and a leaky mode. This work establishes experimental access to momentum-space polarization topology in nonreciprocal photonics, opening a route to explore topological singularities and their evolution under active TRS breaking.

</details>

### [201] [The Cost of Saying Hello: An Empirical Study of Handshake Overhead in AI Agent Communication Protocols](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30151)
*Pranav Varshney*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文首次对三大智能体协议（MCP 2025 initialize 与 2026 discover 两个版本、A2A、ACP）的握手过程进行实证、分阶段基准测试，以往返次数、每阶段时延、线上字节数与 token 成本为指标，覆盖冷启动、热重复、能力不匹配与元数据退化等场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体通信协议综述普遍把"握手开销"列为效率标准，但尚无实测数据。本文旨在填补这一空白，量化握手成本并分解其来源。

Method: 使用各协议官方 SDK 对每次请求插桩，测量往返次数、分阶段时延、线上字节和 token 成本；在回环与模拟 50 ms RTT 环境下，覆盖冷启动、热重复、能力不匹配、元数据退化四类场景，每单元格 N=50。

Result: 往返次数主导握手成本：旧版 MCP 需 3 次往返、50 ms RTT 下 230 ms；A2A 仅 1 次往返、61.0 ms。此外存在 token 成本：由 LLM 读取对方元数据时，开销随能力清单规模线性增长，约每能力 24–107 token；200 个能力的对端会占用 200k 上下文窗口的 11%。MCP 2026 版将握手从 3 次往返降至 2 次，配合版本钉定在热重连时可降为零。

Conclusion: 握手成本由往返次数与元数据 token 体量共同决定；协议自身演进（MCP 2026 修订）印证了所测成本。作者开源了完整测试框架、原始数据与分析代码。

Abstract: Every interaction between AI agents begins with a handshake: the initiating agent must locate its counterpart, learn what it can do, and establish a session before the first useful message can be sent. Surveys of agent communication protocols name handshake overhead as an efficiency criterion, yet none report measurements. This paper presents the first empirical, phase-decomposed benchmark of the handshake in three major agent protocols: MCP (in both its 2025 initialize and 2026 discover eras), A2A, and ACP. Using each protocol's official SDK, we instrument every request for round trips, per-phase latency, wire bytes, and token cost across cold-start, warm-repeat, capability-mismatch, and degraded-metadata scenarios (N=50 per cell, on loopback and under an emulated 50 ms RTT). Round-trip count dominates handshake cost. A legacy MCP handshake takes three round trips and 230 ms at 50 ms RTT; A2A needs one round trip and 61.0 ms. Round trips are not the whole bill: when an LLM reads the counterpart's metadata, handshake cost scales with the counterpart's capability inventory at 24-107 tokens per capability, so a 200-capability counterpart spends 11% of a 200k-token context window before the agent reads its own task. MCP's own 2026 revision cuts its handshake from three round trips to two and, with era pinning, to zero on warm reconnects, protocol evolution that corroborates the cost we measure. We release the full harness, raw data, and analysis at https://github.com/pvarshh/handshake-benchmark.

</details>


### [202] [MCP vs CLI for AI Agents: A Comparative Analysis of Tool Integration Strategies for Autonomous Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30157)
*Arun Malik,Nitish Talasu,Bradley Klemick,Vineet Tushar Trivedi,Prachi Shah,Sanay Devi,Junjie Zhang,Kunal Sonawane*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文对比分析了AI智能体的两种接口范式：CLI（Shell命令执行）与MCP（基于JSON-RPC的结构化工具协议），指出两者各有优势场景，并建议生产系统采用混合架构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI智能体需要与文件、API、数据库、云服务等外部系统交互，目前存在CLI与MCP两种竞争性接口范式，但缺乏系统性的对比分析以指导选型。

Method: 构建覆盖14个评估维度的比较框架，结合具体实例（worked examples）、基于成熟合规框架（NSA CSI U/OO/6030316-26、OWASP安全标准）的安全评估，以及参考BCG和Gartner的经济学建模进行分析。

Result: CLI在单用户、纯本地工作流中效率更优；MCP解决了CLI根本无法满足的需求，包括细粒度访问控制、凭据隔离、结构化审计和多租户治理。同时，渐进式披露（progressive disclosure）技术消除了MCP长期存在的上下文窗口开销弱点，使其token效率达到与CLI相当的水平，同时保留其架构优势。

Conclusion: CLI与MCP并非替代关系而是互补关系：CLI适用于简单本地场景，MCP适用于需要治理与安全的复杂场景。建议生产系统采用混合架构，兼顾效率与合规治理能力。

Abstract: AI agents require interfaces to interact with external systems such as files, APIs, databases, and cloud services. Two competing paradigms have emerged: CLI (Command Line Interface), where agents execute shell commands directly, and MCP (Model Context Protocol), a structured JSON-RPC protocol providing governed, typed tool access. This paper presents a comparative analysis across 14 evaluation dimensions, supported by worked examples, security assessment against established compliance frameworks, and economic modeling. Our analysis indicates that CLI provides superior efficiency for single-user, local-only workflows, while MCP addresses requirements that CLI fundamentally cannot satisfy, including fine-grained access control, credential isolation, structured audit, and multi-tenant governance. We further examine how progressive disclosure techniques eliminate MCP's historical weakness (context window overhead), yielding token efficiency comparable to CLI while preserving its architectural benefits. A hybrid architecture is recommended for production systems. This analysis draws upon academic, government, and industry sources including NSA formal guidance (CSI U/OO/6030316-26), OWASP security standards, and economic modeling from BCG and Gartner.

</details>


### [203] [Accelerating Wildfire Hazard Mapping Across Canada with an AI Surrogate Modelling Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30170)
*Hager Radi Abdelwahed,Toluwaleke Olutayo,Chirag Goel,Jana Osea,Aldo Zaimi,Tom Swystun,Sandy Erni,Francisco Emiliano Lopez Saavedra,Yan Boulanger,Gaétan Marceau Caron*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出多任务深度学习代理模型，以秒级速度近似BurnP3+的野火模拟输出，实现806倍CPU加速，为全国性野火灾害制图提供高效方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 野火活动加剧，需要频繁的全国性灾害制图以指导燃料管理、土地规划、基础设施保护和疏散路线等主动减缓措施；但基于过程的模拟框架（BurnP3/BurnP3+）依赖计算密集的蒙特卡洛模拟，单个区域建模单元需数天至数周，构成计算瓶颈。

Method: AI研究者与野火建模专家合作，提出三项贡献：(a) 用于训练、微调和评估AI代理模型对照过程式模拟器的标准化框架；(b) 基于全国尺度数据训练的多任务深度学习代理模型，同时模拟燃烧概率、平均火强度和平均蔓延速率，输入包括燃料、地形、点火可能性等地理空间数据及区域气象；(c) 领域专用指标与反事实评估协议，用于探测分布外泛化能力。

Result: 模型在一致性、秩相关、误差和空间重叠指标上表现优异，保留了下游灾害分级，并对专家设计的反事实干预产生物理上合理的响应；在代表性区域实现806倍端到端CPU加速，主机内存占用仅为BurnP3+的13%。

Conclusion: 深度学习代理模型可在保持模拟输出质量与物理合理性的前提下大幅降低计算成本，支持快速情景分析，为频繁的全国性野火灾害制图提供可行路径。

Abstract: Canada's increasing wildfire activity requires frequent national hazard mapping to guide proactive mitigation, including fuel management, land-use planning, infrastructure protection, and evacuation routing. However, process-based wildfire simulation frameworks (e.g., BurnP3 and BurnP3+) rely on computationally intensive Monte Carlo simulations to model burn probability, fire intensity, and rate of spread. These workflows can take days to weeks to process a single regional modelling unit. To overcome these computational bottlenecks, we present three contributions developed through collaboration between AI researchers and wildfire modelling experts: (a) a standardized framework for training, fine-tuning, and evaluating AI surrogate models against process-based wildfire simulators; (b) a multi-task deep learning surrogate trained on national-scale data to emulate burn probability, mean fire intensity, and mean rate of spread at a fraction of the computational cost (seconds); and (c) domain-specific metrics and counterfactual evaluation protocols to probe out-of-distribution generalization. Integrating geospatial data (fuel, terrain, ignition likelihood) and regional weather, our model approximates BurnP3+ simulation outputs, achieving strong performance across agreement, rank-correlation, error, and spatial-overlap metrics. It preserves downstream hazard classifications and produces physically plausible responses to expert-informed counterfactual interventions. On a representative region, the surrogate achieves 806-fold end-to-end CPU acceleration and uses 13% of BurnP3+'s host memory, facilitating rapid scenario analysis.

</details>


### [204] [Neural Networks with Differentiable Belief-Function Layers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30173)
*Antonin Sulc*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文指出Dempster归一化因子(1−κ)⁻¹会在梯度中引入(1−κ)⁻²项，在证据冲突时发散，而Yager的⊞规则是双线性的、无此问题。据此构建全链条均为合法D-S质量函数的深度证据流水线，用m(Θ)作为"我不知道"信号，可在视觉与语言两种模态上排序人类分歧。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Dempster规则在高冲突下通过归一化把冲突质量重新分配回类单纯形，且其归一化因子在反向传播时会产生(1−κ)⁻²梯度项，恰在证据源相互矛盾处发散。作者认为反向传播也需要Yager 1987年基于认知论提出的规则：高冲突时把质量转给无知集而非归一化。目标是用可解释的"无知量"m(Θ)作为网络的不确定性/弃权信号。

Method: 理论分析：比较Dempster归一化(1−κ)⁻¹与Yager ⊞ 在梯度中的行为，论证后者双线性、无发散项。模型：构建深度证据流水线，从头到输出每一环的质量都是合法Dempster–Shafer质量函数，统一用Yager规则组合，输出无知集质量m(Θ)作为"I do not know"信号。训练：仅用硬标签拟合，不接触标注者分布。评测：在视觉(CIFAR-10H)与语言两种模态上检验m(Θ)对人类分歧的排序能力，并做OOD检测，与强单次前传基线及带clamp的Dempster变体对比。

Result: m(Θ)在两种模态上都能对人类分歧排序；Dempster规则的值也会上升且排序能力相近，但其归一化把冲突"除掉了"，在最受争议的CIFAR-10H图像上Yager的空虚度(vacuity)比Dempster大9倍，因此只有Yager的m(Θ)无需重校准即可读作无知量。OOD检测上Yager与强单次前传基线相当；而得分更高的clamp版Dempster变体在去掉clamp后梯度不稳定。

Conclusion: Yager ⊞ 在梯度性质与语义可解释性上均优于Dempster归一化：避免冲突导致的梯度发散，且m(Θ)可直接作为未校准的无知度量用于分歧排序与不确定性表达。clamp带来的性能提升以梯度稳定性为代价，属不可靠的权宜手段。

Abstract: Yager's 1987 rule of combination $\boxplus$ was proposed on epistemic grounds: under high conflict, mass should be redistributed to ignorance rather than renormalised onto the class simplex. We observe that backpropagation needs the same rule: Dempster's normaliser $(1{-}κ)^{-1}$, where $κ$ is the conflict mass, puts a $(1{-}κ)^{-2}$ term in the gradient that diverges exactly when evidence sources disagree, while Yager's $\boxplus$ is bilinear and has no such term. Building on this, we construct a deep evidential pipeline in which every mass in the chain from heads to output is a valid Dempster--Shafer mass function, combined by Yager's rule. The output mass on the ignorance set, $m(Θ)$, serves as the network's ``I do not know'' signal. The network is fit to hard labels and never sees an annotator distribution, yet $m(Θ)$ orders human disagreement in two modalities, visual and linguistic. Dempster's rises too and ranks contested inputs about as well, but its normaliser divides the conflict out: Yager's vacuity is $9\times$ larger on the most contested CIFAR-10H images, so only Yager's is readable as an amount of ignorance without recalibration. For out-of-distribution detection it is competitive with strong single-pass baselines, while the clamped Dempster variant that scores higher becomes gradient-unstable once the clamp is removed.

</details>


### [205] [When Stable and Preferred Semantics Agree: A Path-Based Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30176)
*Yan Zhang,Kehan Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出基于攻击图中"路径集合"及其诱导二元关系的框架，给出preferred与stable语义一致的通用路径判据，并以良基性表述充分条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 抽象论辩中preferred与stable语义的一致性（及stable扩展的存在性）通常依赖结构条件，但已有判据（Dung的limited controversiality与SCC-symmetry）互不统摄、缺乏统一解释。

Method: 选取攻击图的特定路径集合P，由P诱导二元关系，建立"路径型判据"：若该关系良基则两语义一致；再以不同路径类实例化。取偶数路径集即回收Dung结果。进一步构造两个无穷路径集序列，并证明第一个序列的Collapse Theorem（无穷多条良基条件归约为三条本质不同条件），第二个序列无此类坍缩。

Result: 所得条件严格推广limited controversiality与SCC-symmetry；有限与无限论辩框架均适用，有限情形可简化表述，并额外给出stable扩展存在的充分条件。

Conclusion: 路径—良基性视角为preferred/stable一致性提供统一且可扩展的结构判据体系，揭示了经典结果的统一来源与新型条件族的分层结构。

Abstract: We investigate structural conditions under which preferred and stable semantics agree in abstract argumentation frameworks. Our approach is based on suitably chosen sets of paths in the attack graph and binary relations induced by them. We establish a general path-based criterion for semantic agreement and instantiate it with several classes of paths, obtaining sufficient conditions expressed in terms of well-foundedness of the corresponding relations.
  The resulting conditions strictly generalize two principal structural criteria for preferred and stable agreement in the literature: Dung's limited controversiality condition and the SCC-symmetry condition. In particular, Dung's result is recovered as a special case by taking the relevant path set to be the set of even paths. We further introduce two infinite sequences of path sets, each yielding a family of agreement conditions. For the first sequence, a Collapse Theorem reduces the infinitely many associated well-foundedness conditions to three essentially distinct ones, whereas the second sequence gives rise to genuinely distinct conditions with no analogous collapse. Our results apply to both finite and infinite argumentation frameworks, admit simplified formulations in the finite case, and also yield sufficient conditions for the existence of stable extensions.

</details>


### [206] [Feedback That Backfires in Games: Do LLM Players Repeat the Move They Just Watched Fail?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30205)
*Esmail Gumaan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究发现在游戏化智能体任务中，将失败移动写入transcript会"适得其反"：8个指令微调模型（135M–1.7B）对失败移动的偏好上升（校正增益G=-1.38 nats/token），该效应主要经由移动的表面形式、对非法移动而非败着生效，且并非所有模型都存在；记录失败后失败移动的对数概率几乎不依赖此前的概率（斜率0.18），即偏好被"反转"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在工具调用中，harness把失败动作与错误信息写回上下文后再询问，会让小模型更倾向重复失败动作。作者希望验证这一"记录失败反而加剧重复"的现象是否同样出现在游戏场景（Sokoban、Connect Four、Othello），并探究其机制、边界条件与缓解手段。

Method: 构造固定探针项：对正确移动做扰动，分别在"非法"与"合法但致败"两类失败上精确验证；在8个指令微调模型（135M–1.7B）上测量失败移动概率变化，以每token nats 计的校正增益G量化。进行探索性分析（log-prob斜率、贪心解码行为），并做消融/对比：省略移动字符串的失败描述、OLMo 2 1B后训练阶梯（base→DPO）、RAGEN默认模型及其Sokoban格式、以及"不要重复"指令、clean retry、解码器禁用等干预。全部测量在float32、免费Colab GPU上完成，并先复现原论文数值。

Result: 记录失败使失败移动更可能被重复：校正增益G=-1.38 nats/token；效应经由移动表面形式产生，对非法移动显著、对败着不显著，且非所有模型一致。记录后失败移动的对数概率几乎与记录前的概率无关（斜率0.18）：本不会选的移动变得更容易被选、贪心解码开始输出它们；本将选的移动概率下降，但贪心解码仍重复38%。省略移动字符串的失败描述可保留模型原有偏好。OLMo 2 1B阶梯中，反转在base模型已存在、在DPO阶段基本消除；RAGEN默认模型在未经RL前即在其Sokoban格式中反转。"不要重复"指令无效；clean retry是最差harness；解码器禁用可阻止精确重复但无法阻止非法动作。

Conclusion: 失败记录在游戏中同样会诱发小模型重复失败动作，其机制是对移动表面形式的强先验覆盖，而非对历史概率的理性更新；该效应具模型依赖性与后训练依赖性，简单的指令或解码约束难以根治，需从上下文呈现方式与后训练阶段入手。

Abstract: When an LLM agent's move fails, the harness writes the move and the failure message into the transcript and asks again. In tool calling, this record makes small models more likely to repeat the failed action. We test whether the same holds in games (Sokoban, Connect Four, Othello), where a move can fail by being illegal or by being legal but losing, both verified exactly. On fixed probe items built by perturbing a correct move, the record backfires: pooled over 8 instruction-tuned models (135M-1.7B) it makes the failed move more likely (corrective gain G = -1.38 nats per token), through the move's surface form, for illegal moves but not for losing ones, and not for every model. An exploratory analysis shows what sets the sign: after the record, the failed move's log-probability barely depends on how likely it was before (slope 0.18). Moves the model would not have played become more likely, and greedy decoding starts to produce them; moves it was about to play become less likely, but greedy decoding still repeats 38% of them. A description of the failure that omits the move string keeps the model's preference instead. Along the OLMo 2 1B post-training ladder the inversion is present in the base model and largely removed at the DPO stage. RAGEN's default models invert in RAGEN's own Sokoban format before any RL. A "do not repeat" instruction does nothing, a clean retry is the worst harness, and a decoder ban stops exact repeats but not illegal play. All measurements ran in float32 on a free Colab GPU, which first reproduced the original paper's number.

</details>


### [207] [Breaking the high-degree barrier in Lehmer's problem with a human-AI discovery loop](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30277)
*Yuri Chervonyi,Sergei Gukov,Thang Luong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文通过"人–AI 发现闭环"（对话式提示 + 快速数值流水线 + 精确符号验证器 + 大规模分布式搜索）提出五参数的广义 Boyd 算法，消除 Boyd 单参数族的"跳度"问题，对每个目标偶数度 d 构造 Mahler 测度严格小于 α₁≈1.255434 的不可约整系数多项式，并在 d≤2000 上改进 6 个已发表数值、保持 99.6% 的最优记录。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Lehmer 问题（1933）问整系数多项式的 Mahler 测度能否任意小，其研究依赖大规模计算探索与解析综合。已知系统构造仅在偶数度 d≤180 完成；更高次时 Boyd 的单参数解析族经常因子分解，跳过近 50% 的目标度，缺少适用于任意 d 的通用构造，因此需要针对高次区域的系统性方法。

Method: 采用 human-AI discovery loop：AI 智能体本地原型化数值与符号求解器，跨分布式集群并行搜索，并与人类研究者协同提取与验证数学假设；在 Boyd 族基础上推广得到五参数"广义 Boyd 算法"以避免度跳跃。全流程由快速数值流水线筛选、精确符号验证器确认不可约性及 Mahler 测度界。

Result: 广义 Boyd 算法对每个目标偶数度均可构造不可约整系数多项式，其 Mahler 测度严格低于 Boyd 极限点 α₁≈1.255434；在全部偶数度 d≤2000 上评估，改进 6 个已发表数值，并占据全部已知最优记录中的 99.6%。

Conclusion: 五参数构造消除了度跳跃，为任意偶数度提供普遍的小 Mahler 测度多项式构造，显著推进高次区域的系统化探索；同时发布所有已研究偶数度上最小 Mahler 测度多项式的已验证数据集，为后续 Lehmer 问题研究提供基准资源，并展示人–AI 协同发现范式在数学计算探索中的可行性。

Abstract: While artificial intelligence has made rapid progress in mathematical reasoning, many open problems depend on structure that is revealed only through large-scale computational exploration and analytical synthesis. One such example is Lehmer's problem from 1933. It asks whether the Mahler measure of an integer polynomial, which measures how far its roots stray from the unit circle, can be made arbitrarily small. Previously, constructing irreducible polynomials with integer coefficients and small Mahler measure has been carried out systematically only for even degrees $d \le 180$. At higher degrees, Boyd's analytical one-parameter family frequently factors, skipping nearly 50% of target degrees and leaving no general construction for arbitrary $d$. Here, we address the high-degree regime through a human-AI discovery loop, in which we extend the conversational prompting with a fast numerical pipeline, an exact symbolic verifier, and large-scale distributed search. The AI agent prototypes numerical and symbolic solvers locally, launches parallel searches across distributed clusters and works with the human researcher to extract and verify mathematical hypotheses. Through this interactive loop, we derive a five-parameter construction, which we call the Generalized Boyd algorithm. It eliminates degree-skipping and constructs irreducible polynomials with Mahler measure strictly below Boyd's limit point $α_1 \approx 1.255434$ for every target degree. Evaluated across all even degrees up to 2000, our approach improves upon six previously published values and holds 99.6% of all best known records. With this work we release the verified dataset of polynomials with minimal Mahler measure across all studied even degrees.

</details>


### [208] [Route-and-Generate: KL-Regularized Router Improvement for Reasoning Routing in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30351)
*Tien-Phat Nguyen,Truong Nguyen,Thanh-Thien Le,Hoang Phan,Thien Huu Nguyen,Linh Ngo Van,Trung Le*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出分层训练框架 Rouge，将“推理投入分配”与“答案生成”解耦：路由策略在固定采样预算下为每个输入分配推理格式与长度，基模型用 GRPO 与基于排名的奖励优化，路由策略以闭式 KL 正则策略改进后蒸馏为神经路由器，从而在简单题上简洁作答、难题上保留长推理，改善准确率—效率权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大语言模型常常无差别地施加复杂推理，导致简单任务“过度思考”（overthinking）、困难任务“思考不足”（underthinking），推理投入与任务难度不匹配，造成计算浪费与性能损失。

Method: 1) 分层训练框架：将推理努力分配与答案生成解耦，引入路由策略在固定采样预算下跨多种推理格式进行分配；2) 基模型以 GRPO 优化，采用逐样本奖励（per-sample rewards）；3) 采用基于排名的奖励（rank-based reward），偏好更短的正确答案以促进高效推理；4) 路由策略通过闭式 KL 正则策略改进步骤更新，并蒸馏进神经路由器。

Result: 在多个推理基准上实现了更优的准确率—效率权衡：简单问题获得更简洁的答案，困难问题保留更长推理；自适应决策提升了整体精度效率表现。

Conclusion: 通过解耦推理投入分配与答案生成、并结合排名奖励与闭式策略改进蒸馏，Rouge 使 LLM 能按输入自适应决定“是否需要推理、需要多少推理”，在保持准确率的同时降低推理开销。

Abstract: Large language models often apply complex reasoning indiscriminately, leading to overthinking on simple tasks and underthinking on harder ones. We present Route-and-Generate (Rouge), a hierarchical training framework that enables LLMs to adaptively decide when and how much reasoning is required for each input. Our approach decouples reasoning effort allocation from answer generation by introducing a routing policy that allocates a fixed sampling budget across multiple reasoning formats, while the base model is optimized with GRPO using per-sample rewards. To promote efficient reasoning, we employ a rank-based reward that favors shorter correct solutions, and update the routing policy via a closed-form KL-regularized policy improvement step distilled into a neural router. This design encourages concise answers on easy problems while reserving longer reasoning for harder ones, achieving improved accuracy-efficiency trade-offs across multiple reasoning benchmarks.

</details>


### [209] [Soft Ontology Priors over Latent Concept Posteriors for Weakly Supervised Neuro-Symbolic Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30391)
*Tengwei Song,Robert Hoehndorf*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 向神经符号预测器注入软本体先验，并将其与任务约束编译为平滑、可分解的概率电路，以消除推理捷径、恢复概念可辨识性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仅用任务标签监督的神经符号（NeSy）预测器存在"推理捷径"问题：不同的概念映射可达到相同最大似然，导致恢复出的概念不可辨识，也无法安全地用于下游复用。

Method: 在训练目标中引入关于潜在概念的软本体先验，并与任务约束一起编译为平滑、可分解的概率电路。在独立伯努利感知假设下，神经叶权重在求值前折叠进电路，使结构化概念后验的归一化因子化简为与编译电路规模成线性关系的加权模型计数。软编译策略将专家公理置于电路权重而非支撑集（由数据生成过程保证的任务结构公理保持为硬约束），从而含噪公理只重新分配先验质量而不会清空支撑集。

Result: 刻画了先验如何通过本体违背能量差异对受标签限制的捷径质量进行重加权；证明软先验在有界公理噪声下仅产生有界对数密度扰动；并证明对应的硬支撑版本可被单条被污染公理变得退化。在真实 BDD-OIA 驾驶基准的六概念审计视图与受控 NeSy 任务上验证了上述预测。

Conclusion: 软本体先验经概率电路编译后能有效抑制推理捷径、提升概念可辨识性，且对专家公理噪声具有有界鲁棒性，优于易退化的硬约束方案。

Abstract: Neuro-symbolic (NeSy) predictors that supervise only the task label suffer from reasoning shortcuts: distinct concept mappings achieve the same maximum likelihood, leaving the recovered concepts unidentifiable and unsafe for downstream reuse. We attack this failure by injecting a soft ontology prior over the latent concepts into the training objective and compiling it together with the task constraint into a smooth, decomposable probabilistic circuit. Under independent Bernoulli perception, the normalisers of the resulting structured concept posterior reduce to weighted model counts that are linear in the compiled circuit size, because the neural leaf weights fold into the circuit before evaluation. The soft compilation strategy places expert axioms in the circuit's weights rather than its support (task-structural axioms guaranteed by the data-generating process stay hard), so noisy expert axioms only redistribute prior mass and cannot empty the support. We characterise how the prior reweights label-restricted shortcut mass through differences in ontology violation energy, show that soft priors incur bounded log-density perturbations under bounded axiom noise, and prove that the hard-support counterpart can be made degenerate by a single corrupted axiom. We validate these predictions on an audited six-concept view of the real-world BDD-OIA driving benchmark and on controlled NeSy tasks.

</details>


### [210] [RoleFlow: Self-Evolving Multi-Role Agentic Collaboration via Structural Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30429)
*Yi Ge,Pan Wang,Xuehao Cui,Zian Zeng,Xu Hu,Heng Huang,Furong Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: RoleFlow：通过反馈驱动的原子编辑与按需角色合成实现协作结构的自演化，并提出SECPO（单编辑反事实策略优化）为结构性编辑分配精确信用，在四个领域七个基准上平均性能最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的多智能体系统多依赖预定义协作结构，难以适应动态变化的任务需求；虽有工作引入动态编排，但其轨迹级奖励对每个决策只赋予单一结果值，难以辨识单个结构变动各自的贡献。

Method: 提出自演化多角色智能体系统RoleFlow，以反馈驱动的原子编辑和按需角色合成来迭代精化协作结构；为使结构自适应可学习，提出SECPO：在同一链状态下将每次编辑与其“无编辑”对应分支进行反事实对比，从而对编辑特定token分配定向信用。

Result: 在覆盖四个领域的七个基准上取得最优平均性能，超过最强基线4.7分；三个多跳QA基准上领先3.2–7.5个F1点，并在数学推理、网页交互与代码生成任务上同样表现领先。进一步分析显示其具备跨基准迁移性、训练数据高效性以及跨执行器泛化能力。

Conclusion: 以原子结构编辑为动作空间、以单编辑反事实对比进行信用分配，可有效将结构自适应转化为可学习问题，兼顾性能、迁移性与数据效率。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) based multi-agent systems often rely on predefined collaboration structures, limiting their adaptability to evolving task requirements. Although recent approaches enable dynamic orchestration, trajectory-level rewards they apply assign one outcome to each decision, ofen struggling to identify the contributions of individual structural changes. We propose RoleFlow, a self-evolving multi-role agentic system that refines collaboration structures through feedback-driven atomic edits and on-demand role synthesis. To make structural adaptation learnable, we introduce Single-Edit Counterfactual Policy Optimization (SECPO), which evaluates each edit against its no-edit counterpart at the same chain state and assigns targeted credit to edit-specific tokens. Across seven benchmarks spanning four domains, RoleFlow achieves the optimal average performance, surpassing the strongest competitor by 4.7 points. It leads on all three multi-hop QA benchmarks by 3.2-7.5 F1 points and also shows supremacy on mathematical reasoning, web interaction, and code generation. Further analyses demonstrate cross-benchmark transferability, training-data efficiency, and cross-executor generalization.

</details>


### [211] [Secure Agentic AI and Multimodal Intelligence in 6G Communication Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30436)
*Satyam Gaba,Devanshu Motwani,Siva Sai,Vineet Suri,Vikas Ranjan,Vinay Chamola*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文从隐私与安全视角综述了面向6G跨层通信系统的多模态智能与代理式AI（agentic AI），构建了覆盖感知、记忆、工具使用与多智能体编排的系统视图，梳理了跨感知/认知/行动/记忆/通信各层的威胁模型与攻击面，提出攻击分类体系，并评述了提示与记忆防御、智能体间信任、安全编排及隐私保护学习等缓解策略，最后给出可信多模态多智能体6G系统的开放研究方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 6G依赖多模态智能、边缘计算与自主网络控制的紧耦合以支撑沉浸式、意图驱动、时延敏感的服务，代理式AI因此具备异构推理、工具调用、分布式协同与环境自适应能力；但这些能力引入了超越传统AI与网络安全模型的风险，且漏洞可沿多模态数据管道、记忆、工具、通信接口与智能体协同回路传播，亟需系统性的安全与隐私综述。

Method: 综述性研究：提出面向6G的系统视图（感知—记忆—工具使用—多智能体编排）；跨感知层、认知层、行动层、记忆层与通信层分析威胁模型与攻击面；构建结构化攻击分类体系（taxonomy）；系统评述缓解策略，包括提示与记忆防御、智能体间信任机制、安全编排与隐私保护学习。

Result: 形成统一的系统级分析框架：给出跨层攻击面的结构化taxonomy，明确漏洞在多模态数据管道、记忆、工具、通信接口与协同回路中的传播路径，并对提示/记忆防御、信任机制、安全编排、隐私保护学习等防御手段进行归类与评估性梳理。

Conclusion: 面向6G的多模态多智能体系统安全需以跨层、端到端视角统筹；文章最后提出可信多模态多智能体6G系统的开放研究方向，为后续安全架构与防御机制设计提供研究议程。

Abstract: Sixth-generation (6G) communication systems are expected to support immersive, intent-driven, and latency-critical services through tight integration of multimodal intelligence, edge computing, and autonomous network control. In this setting, agentic AI systems can reason over heterogeneous inputs, use tools and network functions, coordinate across distributed entities, and adapt to dynamic environments. These capabilities make agentic multimodal intelligence promising for 6G applications such as semantic communications, digital twins, and zero-touch network management, but they also introduce security and privacy risks that extend beyond conventional AI and network security models. Vulnerabilities can propagate across multimodal data pipelines, memory, tools, communication interfaces, and inter-agent coordination loops. We survey multimodal intelligence and agentic AI for 6G cross-layered communication systems from the perspectives of privacy and security. We present a 6G-oriented system view spanning perception, memory, tool use, and multi-agent orchestration; analyze threat models and attack surfaces across sensing, cognition, action, memory, and communication layers; organize existing attacks into a structured taxonomy; and review mitigation strategies including prompt and memory defenses, inter-agent trust mechanisms, secure orchestration, and privacy-preserving learning. We conclude by outlining open research directions for trustworthy multimodal multi-agent 6G systems.

</details>


### [212] [SpecMAGIC: Specification-Guided Multi-Task Generalization in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30443)
*Zijian Guo,İlker Işık,H. M. Sabbir Ahmad,Wenchao Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出SpecMAGIC，一种基于时序逻辑任务规范自动机结构的分层多智能体强化学习框架，通过"高层集中规划+底层分散执行"的子任务分解与复用，实现对新任务的零样本泛化，并从理论上保证高层规划器的可靠性与概率完备性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多任务泛化在多智能体强化学习（MARL）中重要但研究不足。现实应用要求多智能体系统泛化到具有复杂、时间延展性及多样智能体间协调要求的任务上，而现有方法难以在不重训练的情况下应对新任务规范。

Method: 1）引入一种规范语言，将时序逻辑任务规范与表达智能体间协调需求的操作符相结合；2）提出分层框架SpecMAGIC，利用任务规范对应的自动机结构进行子任务分解；3）集中式高层规划器识别并跨智能体分配兼容的子任务序列，分散式底层策略执行各子任务；4）按新规范组合可复用子任务策略以实现零样本泛化；5）对高层规划器给出可靠性（soundness）与概率完备性证明。

Result: 在多智能体导航任务上，SpecMAGIC在未见过的任务规范上显著优于现有方法，且在智能体数量增加时仍保持良好性能。

Conclusion: 以时序逻辑自动机驱动的子任务分解与复用，是提升MARL多任务泛化能力的有效途径；配合具备理论保证的高层规划器，可在无需重训练的情况下实现对新任务规范的零样本泛化并具备良好的可扩展性。

Abstract: Multi-task generalization is an important yet underexplored problem in multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL). Many real-world applications require multi-agent systems to generalize across complex, temporally extended tasks with diverse inter-agent coordination requirements. We introduce a specification language that combines temporal-logic task specifications with operators for expressing such requirements. We propose SpecMAGIC, a hierarchical framework that leverages the automaton structure of task specifications for subtask decomposition. A centralized high-level planner identifies and allocates compatible subtask sequences across agents, while decentralized low-level policies execute individual subtasks. This enables zero-shot generalization to new tasks by composing reusable subtask policies according to new specifications, without retraining. We establish soundness and probabilistic completeness of the high-level planner. Experiments on multi-agent navigation tasks show that SpecMAGIC substantially outperforms existing approaches on unseen task specifications and maintains strong performance as the number of agents increases.

</details>


### [213] [A Three-Pillar Governance Framework for Safe and Trustworthy AI Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30445)
*Edward C. Cheng,Jeshua Cheng,Alice Siu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出三支柱（3P）模型与框架，通过透明性、问责性和可信性三条支柱，结合渐进式验证、结构化人类监督与可审计运行控制，为安全可信AI智能体的开发与自主性递增部署提供实践基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 具备自主决策能力的AI智能体在安全性、对齐、问责与人类监督方面带来重大挑战；现有Human-in-the-Loop与负责任AI方法虽有重要基础，但在系统设计、治理与运行部署层面仍较为碎片化，缺乏整合性框架。

Method: 构建三支柱（3P）模型与框架，以透明性、问责性、可信性为核心支柱；定义一条演化路径，通过渐进式验证、结构化人类监督与可审计的运行控制逐步提升智能体自主性；并阐述该模型如何在企业级智能体环境中支持生命周期监控、决策可追溯、升级管理与人类-智能体协作。

Result: 框架将监督原则与运行机制相整合，形成覆盖设计、治理与部署的统一结构，支持智能体生命周期监控、决策可追溯性、升级（escalation）管理与人类-智能体协作等关键能力。

Conclusion: 通过融合监督原则与运行机制，该框架为部署始终与人类意图保持对齐、并可受控地向更高自主性演进的AI智能体提供了实践基础。

Abstract: AI agents capable of autonomous decision-making introduce significant challenges related to safety, alignment, accountability, and human oversight. Existing Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) and responsible AI approaches provide important foundations, but many remain fragmented across system design, governance, and operational deployment. This paper presents a Three-Pillar (3P) model and framework for developing safe and trustworthy AI agents through transparency, accountability, and trustworthiness. The framework defines an evolutionary path in which increasing agent autonomy is introduced through progressive validation, structured human oversight, and auditable operational controls. We further describe how the model supports agent lifecycle monitoring, decision traceability, escalation management, and human-agent collaboration within enterprise agentic environments. By integrating oversight principles with operational mechanisms, the proposed framework provides a practical foundation for deploying AI agents that remain aligned with human intent while enabling controlled progression toward higher autonomy.

</details>


### [214] [Same Beliefs, Different Policies: Learning Reusable Representations for Early Stopping in LLM Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30450)
*Jingwei Ni,Dmitry Abulkhanov,Vladislav Smirnov,Markus Leippold,Elliott Ash,Timothy Baldwin,Artem Shelmanov,Mrinmaya Sachan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: BELT将“结果预测”与“停止控制”解耦：用冻结LLM隐状态学习关于当前/未来答案的信念，再在冻结特征上拟合线性停止策略，从而以一次性训练支持多价格(精度-成本)权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理型LLM达到正确答案后仍继续推理，浪费算力甚至改坏答案。何时停止属元推理问题，需权衡继续推理的收益与成本。直接效用训练把停止表示绑定在特定token价格上，支持新价格需重新训练控制器。

Method: BELT（BELief-based Termination）：从冻结LLM的隐藏状态学习对当前及未来答案的信念预测，其预测目标与token价格无关；随后在冻结特征上拟合线性停止策略，通过CPU端策略重拟合或阈值调整实现不同精度-成本权衡。

Result: 在五个OOD数学基准上平均，BELT在无精度损失下将生成token减少41%（Qwen3-1.7B）和51%（OLMo-3-7B-Think）；数学训练的BELT无需代码/智能体数据即可迁移至编码与智能体任务，三类任务中其精度-成本权衡与端到端控制器相当或更优；在OLMo3上探针参数比OS-Pruner单个checkpoint少21.2倍，训练GPU时数比其五个价格专用checkpoint少55倍。

Conclusion: 将信念预测与停止控制分离可构建价格无关、参数高效、可跨域迁移的推理终止机制，显著降低计算与训练成本且保持精度。

Abstract: Reasoning LLMs often continue reasoning after reaching a correct answer, wasting computation and sometimes replacing it with an incorrect one. Deciding when to stop is a metareasoning problem: the model must weigh what further reasoning could achieve against its cost, given what it can already answer. Direct utility training learns a stopping representation at a chosen token price; supporting new prices can require additional controller training. We introduce BELT (BELief-based Termination), which separates outcome prediction from stopping control. It learns beliefs about current and future answers from a frozen LLM's hidden states, then fits a linear stopping policy on the frozen features. The prediction targets are independent of token price, so one probe supports different accuracy-cost trade-offs through CPU policy refitting or threshold adjustment. Averaged over five out-of-distribution (OOD) math benchmarks, BELT reduces generated tokens by 41% on Qwen3-1.7B and 51% on OLMo-3-7B-Think without loss of accuracy. The same math-trained BELT transfers to coding and agentic tasks without training on code or agentic data. In all three domains, its accuracy-cost trade-offs are competitive with or better than those of end-to-end controllers. On OLMo3, its probe has 21.2x fewer parameters than one checkpoint of the strongest baseline, OS-Pruner, and needs 55x fewer training GPU-hours than OS-Pruner's five price-specific checkpoints.

</details>


### [215] [Why Bother Me Again? Benchmarking Personal Agent Memory for Interaction Preferences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30485)
*Jialin Li,Zhenhao Chen,Hanjun Luo,Hanan Salam*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 MemPABench 交互式基准，用于在策略（on-policy）评估个人智能体对"交互偏好"的记忆能力，发现现有记忆系统在偏好选择上收益有限，且难以适应偏好变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 个人智能体承担日益复杂的日常任务，但重复提问、多余确认和不必要的主动联系会把"能力"变成"交互负担"。降低负担需智能体记住用户希望被协助的方式，然而现有记忆基准只考察事实回忆与个性化回答，几乎不测试智能体如何学习并依交互偏好行事。

Method: 构建 MemPABench 交互环境：长程任务要求智能体决定何时澄清、确认或自主执行；4 个有据可依的模拟用户在工作与个人情境中持有 14 项偏好，反馈覆盖四个月 99 个会话，每用户含 5 次事件驱动的偏好变更以检验记忆更新；评估维度为偏好选择、实际交付行为、对情境与偏好变化的敏感性。在 4 个 LLM 骨干上评测 4 种记忆系统。

Result: 当前记忆在偏好选择上收益有限：检索式系统（Mem0、MemOS、简单 RAG）未优于 No Memory；基于文件的记忆提升准确率但会把偏好误用到不相关情境。分析表明现有记忆难以检索交互偏好、难以适应偏好变化；即使正确偏好可用，覆盖智能体默认交互习惯仍很困难。

Conclusion: 记忆的瓶颈已从"检索事实"转向"检索并遵循交互偏好"，且需解决默认行为的惯性问题；MemPABench 提供了该方向的可复现评测环境与数据集（https://mempabench.com）。

Abstract: Personal intelligence systems are taking on increasingly complex everyday tasks, yet repeated questions, unnecessary confirmations, and unwanted outreach can turn capable assistance into interaction burden. Reducing this burden requires agents to remember how users want to be assisted. However, existing memory benchmarks focus on factual recall and personalized answers and rarely test how agents learn and act on interaction preferences. We introduce MemPABench, an interactive environment for on-policy evaluation of memory in personal agents. MemPABench poses long-horizon tasks requiring agents to decide when to clarify, confirm, or act autonomously. Four grounded simulated users hold 14 preferences across work and personal contexts. Their feedback spans 99 sessions over four months, with five event-driven changes per user testing memory updates. We evaluate preference selection, delivered behavior, and sensitivity to context and preference change. Evaluating four memory systems across four LLM backbones, we find that current memory brings limited gains in preference selection. Retrieval-based systems (i.e. Mem0, MemOS, simple RAG) do not outperform No Memory, while File-based memory improves accuracy but applies preferences beyond relevant contexts. Our analysis shows that current memory struggles to retrieve interaction preferences and adapt to preference changes. Even with the correct preference available, overriding the agent's default interaction habits remains challenging. The environment and dataset are available at https://mempabench.com.

</details>


### [216] [From Single-Actor Environments to Multi-Actor Event Worlds: Can LLMs Be Event World Models?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30488)
*Juntong Ni,Zewen Liu,Bohan Wang,Lige Zhang,Wei Jin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文将"多主体、事件日志驱动、部分可观测"系统形式化为 event worlds，构建外交游戏与Polymarket交易两个基准，用分层框架评估LLM能否由日志与自身拟采取动作预测未来观测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实系统往往涉及多方自主决策、主体不动作时世界仍演化、且只能透过事件日志部分观测，现有世界模型研究未充分覆盖此类设定，需检验LLM能否作为event world model，尤其在仅给定自身动作时。

Method: 形式化event worlds；从人类Diplomacy对局与真实Polymarket交易构建互补基准；提出分层评测框架：先对比"给/不给其他主体动作"的预测，再做多步rollout、未执行动作的预测、以及对智能体的效用评估；另检验微调、数据规模、模型规模、历史长度的影响，以及用世界模型进行想象经验与初始化的策略学习。

Result: 当提供所有主体记录动作时，微调与更多数据可提升预测；仅给自身动作时，若其他主体对结果影响大，模型表现显著下降，更大模型与更长历史帮助有限；该差距进一步损害多步预测与智能体决策，模型高估计划成功率；但想象经验与世界模型初始化仍能改进策略学习。

Conclusion: 预测其他主体的行为是event world modeling的核心挑战；LLM此能力不足会传导至多步预测与决策，但世界模型仍可作为策略学习的辅助信号。

Abstract: World models help agents assess the consequences of their actions before acting. Many real systems, however, involve multiple actors who make their own decisions, can evolve even when the agent takes no action, and are only partially observed through event logs. We formalize these systems as event worlds and ask whether large language models can predict future observations from the log and the agent's proposed actions. We build complementary benchmarks from human Diplomacy games and real Polymarket trades. Our hierarchical framework compares prediction with and without other actors' actions, then tests multi-step rollouts, predictions for actions never taken, and usefulness to agents. Fine-tuning and more data improve prediction when all actors' recorded actions are given. With only the agent's action, models struggle when other actors strongly affect the outcome, and larger models and longer histories help little. This gap also limits multi-step prediction and agent decisions, with models overestimating plan success. Yet imagined experience and initialization from world models can still improve policy learning. Anticipating other actors' actions remains a central challenge for event world modeling.

</details>


### [217] [What the Trace Shows and What the Label Says: Auditing Behavioral Detectors in Agent Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30491)
*Idunnuoluwa A. Adeniji,Shilpika,Michael E. Papka*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文审计了LLM智能体执行轨迹上的三类自动检测器标签，发现标签间存在系统性分歧，尤以"静默工具输出覆盖"为典型失效模式；人工复核显示验证类检测器准确率仅67/81，且执行预算会改变报告结果，据此主张"测量透明性"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM智能体评估常把执行轨迹压缩为最终答案正确性、工具验证、故障传播等标签，但这些标签实为解析器与规则产生的测量值，未必完整反映轨迹内容；作者希望检验这些自动标签在多大程度上与人工判断一致，并揭示其偏差来源。

Method: 构建基于GSM8K的工具使用场景，智能体调用一个输出会被周期性污染的计算机，从而对"工具返回了什么、模型随后使用了什么、检测器报告了什么"具备清晰真值。在6个生产模型、每个模型30道题上审计三类轨迹级检测器；并对90条轨迹做人工复核，同时进行步数与token预算的执行上限消融实验。

Result: 最终正确性、可见再验证与故障传播三类标签出现系统性分歧。关键失效模式为"静默工具输出覆盖"：计算机返回被污染值，模型随后未经再次调用工具而改用另一（常为正确）值，使错误停止传播，而验证检测器记录为"未再核查"。人工复核与自动标签在最终正确性（67/67）、故障影响（19/19）、故障相关性（18/18）上完全一致，但验证项仅67/81一致，14处分歧归为四种重复模式。执行上限亦改变结论：两模型消融中，一个随步数与token预算在21/30至27/30间波动，另一个稳定在27/30至29/30。

Conclusion: 自动标签应附带支撑其结论的轨迹证据，包括检测器所问问题是否适用于该轨迹、运行是否被执行上限截断、以及人工修正记录。作者提供的轨迹查看器使这些信息可与报告结果一并检查，从而推动测量透明性。

Abstract: LLM agents are often evaluated by reducing execution traces to labels such as final-answer correctness, tool verification, and fault propagation. These labels are measurements produced by parsers, behavioral detectors, and harness rules, and they may not fully capture what the trace shows. We study this in a tool-use setting built on GSM8K, where agents call a calculator whose outputs are occasionally corrupted, giving clear ground truth for what the tool returned, what the model later used, and what the detectors reported. We audit three trace-level detectors across six production models and 30 problems per model. Final correctness, visible re-verification, and fault propagation can disagree in systematic ways. A key failure mode is silent tool-output override: the calculator returns a corrupted value, but the model later uses a different, often correct, value without calling the tool again, so the bad value stops propagating while a verification detector records no re-check. Human review of 90 traces agrees perfectly with the automated labels for final correctness (67/67), fault impact (19/19), and fault relevance (18/18), but only 67/81 for verification; all 14 disagreements fall into four recurring patterns. Execution limits also change the reported result: in an ablation across two models, one ranges from 21/30 to 27/30 correct as step and token budgets change, while the other stays between 27/30 and 29/30. These findings motivate measurement transparency: an automated label should come with the trace evidence behind it, whether the question the detector asks applied to that trace, whether the run was cut off by an execution limit, and any human corrections. Our trace viewer makes this information inspectable alongside the reported results.

</details>


### [218] [From Prose to Properties: Testing Research Claims with ARATest for Agent-Native Science](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30495)
*Yifeng He,Jiachen Liu,Hao Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出ARATest——一个基于属性的测试库，通过将论文中的经验性主张抽象为"属性骨架"（可参数化的关系），把隐式散文主张转化为可执行测试。在243条主张中，54条获得忠实声明并绑定证据：32条成立、8条被违反、14条不确定；两处违反暴露了经作者确认的已发表论文错误，且ARATest在19个有效对照上零误报地检出全部553个植入故障，性能优于两个LLM评审。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI代理能够自主开展实验并报告发现，使得研究主张的产生速度远超人工核查能力。每条经验性主张都隐含一个必须对其案例成立的性质，但该性质仅以自然语言散文陈述。缺少显式性质定义，就无法判定哪些证据可以证伪该主张，导致验证无法跟上代理产出主张的速度。因此作者希望让主张变得可测试。

Method: 作者通过抽象"属性骨架"（一种跨主张复现的参数化关系）来近似主张语义，并构建ARATest基于属性测试库：(1) 类型化声明将主张绑定到骨架，固定其比较量、案例、作用域与数值策略；(2) 共享案例类型确保每个生成器按主张的统计单元提供案例；(3) 三值语义为每个属性赋予成立/违反/不确定三种判定，每个违反附带可重放见证；(4) 默认生成器读取代理原生研究制品（ARA）链接到各主张的证据，自动研究生成器则调度代理运行已发布代码以产生新案例；DissClaimer插件提供该代理并将生成器作为持续测试运行。

Result: 在33个ARA制品的243条主张中，54条获得忠实声明并绑定证据：32条成立、8条违反、14条不确定。两处违反暴露了已发表论文中的错误，作者均予以确认。ARATest在19个有效对照上零误报地检出全部553个植入故障，优于两个LLM评审。新运行还暴露了已报告证据无法呈现的行为。

Conclusion: 结果表明，单一固定测试能够针对已报告证据与新鲜证据检查显式主张性质。ARATest使经验性主张具备可证伪性与可重放性，为代理驱动研究中主张产出速度与验证能力失衡的问题提供了可行方案。

Abstract: AI agents now run experiments and report findings, so research produces claims faster than researchers can check them. Each empirical claim implies a property that must hold over its cases, but it states that property only in prose. Without an explicit property, no test can decide which evidence would falsify a claim, so validation cannot keep pace with the claims agents produce. To make claims testable, we approximate a claim's semantics by abstracting its property skeleton, a parameterized relation that recurs across claims. We present ARATest, a property-based testing library that checks these skeletons as executable tests. A typed declaration binds a claim to a skeleton and fixes the claim's compared quantities, cases, scope, and numerical policy. A shared case type makes every generator supply cases in the claim's statistical unit. A three-valued semantics assigns each property one of three verdicts: holds, violated, or inconclusive. Every violation carries a replayable witness. A default generator reads the evidence that agent-native research artifacts (ARA) link to each claim, and auto-research generators dispatch an agent to run released code for fresh cases. Our DissClaimer plugin supplies that agent and runs these generators as continuous testing.
  Of 243 claims in 33 ARA artifacts, 54 received faithful declarations bound to evidence: 32 held, eight were violated, and 14 remained inconclusive. Two violations exposed errors in published papers that their authors confirmed. ARATest detected all 553 seeded faults without a false alarm on 19 valid controls, outperforming two LLM judges. Fresh runs exposed behaviors that reported evidence could not show. These results suggest that one fixed test can check explicit claim properties against both reported and fresh evidence.

</details>


### [219] [Can LLMs Improve Their Own Harness? A Controlled Study on ARC-AGI-3](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30499)
*Jens Lehmann,Sahar Vahdati*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文研究前沿语言模型能否自主构建并迭代改进用于ARC-AGI-3的符号化harness（编排模型调用的程序）。在27个谱系、两轮代码修订的协议下，模型自建harness性能跨度从零到接近上限，但修订对留出集RHAE的平均提升仅2.80分且置信区间跨零，说明自主harness构建与实际可靠自适应之间存在显著差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用智能系统应能高效获得新技能而无需人类为每个新任务重新设计软件脚手架。现实中语言模型很少单独行动，其表现依赖harness（负责感知、记忆、工具调用、恢复与推理分配的符号程序）。ARC-AGI-3上人类引导系统已报告公开游戏的上限分数，证明有效设计存在，因此作者想检验：前沿模型能否自行构建并改进这样的harness。

Method: 采用固定的编码引导流程（coding bootstrap）：每个模型先构建一个完整任务harness，借该harness在5个开发游戏上行动，随后对整个代码库进行两轮修订。所有版本均在20个从不参与自适应的游戏上评估。以Relative Human Action Efficiency（RHAE，结合关卡完成度与相对人类基线的动作效率）衡量任务表现，并以美元计价的推理成本作为实用资源指标。共27个谱系。

Result: harness表现跨度极大，从零分到接近上限。两轮修订使留出集平均RHAE仅提升2.80分（95%区间[-1.44, 7.35]）。开发集上的增益高估了留出集改进；推理成本下降可能以任务表现为代价。人类引导系统仍展现出进一步的上限空间。

Conclusion: 在两轮修订协议下，自主harness构建与可靠自适应之间存在差距：即便任务表现很强，也不能保证后续修订可泛化或保留既有能力。这揭示了自动脚手架设计与稳健持续学习之间的核心张力。

Abstract: A generally intelligent system acquires new skills efficiently without requiring humans to redesign its software scaffold for every new task. Yet language models rarely act alone. A harness is a symbolic program that orchestrates calls to the model, handling perception, memory, tool use, recovery, and inference allocation on the model's behalf. ARC-AGI-3 is an interactive benchmark in which agents must explore unfamiliar environments, figure out their goals on the fly, and keep learning as they go. On it, human-steered systems already report ceiling scores across the public games, so we know effective designs exist. We ask whether frontier models can build and improve such a harness on their own. Through a fixed coding bootstrap, each model constructs a complete task harness, acts through that harness on five development games, and revises the entire codebase twice. Every version is evaluated on twenty games that never influence adaptation. We measure task performance with Relative Human Action Efficiency (RHAE), which combines level completion with action efficiency relative to human baselines, and record dollar-denominated inference cost as a practical resource measure. Across 27 lineages, harness performance ranges from zero to near-ceiling scores. Two revisions raise mean held-out RHAE by only 2.80 points (95% interval [-1.44,7.35]). Development gains overstate held-out improvement, and reductions in inference cost can come at the expense of task performance. Human-steered systems demonstrate further headroom. These findings reveal a gap between autonomous harness construction and reliable adaptation under this two-revision protocol: even strong task performance does not ensure that subsequent revisions generalize or preserve existing capabilities.

</details>


### [220] [PLE: Physical-Engineering's Last Exam](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30537)
*Rujun Han,Yufan Zhuang,Arijit Ray,Han Yu,Zoey CuiZhu,George Lee,Yifei Ming,Binz Roy,Varun Sakalkar,Vishy Tirumalashetty,Burak Gokturk,Tomas Pfister,Chen-Yu Lee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 PLE 基准，包含 85 个长周期、智能体化的专业物理工程任务（电气、土木、结构、机械），以完成可计费的工程交付物为解题标准；最强前沿模型配置仅达 50.6% 均分且平均每任务耗费 27M tokens 与 63 分钟，揭示当前智能体与自主物理工程设计之间的显著差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有知识基准已趋饱和（前沿模型超 90%），但缺乏衡量模型能否承担真实、有经济价值的专业物理工程工作的基准。已有工程基准局限于教材问答、孤立工具调用或自包含的玩具设计问题，与真实工程设计交付相距甚远。

Method: 构建 PLE 基准，含 85 个长周期智能体任务，覆盖电气、土木、结构、机械四类工程，任务等价于完成真实可计费工程交付物（跨多格式项目语料建模物理与法规要求、优化材料与安装成本、输出可被持证审核者签认的 2D/3D 设计包）。采用两条互补策展路径：专家撰写（由执业工程师端到端创建）与协同撰写（基于执业工程师题面，由对抗性 Creator-Solver 智能体流水线构建真实项目环境、可执行评分器与参考交付物，再交专家验证并提升难度）。在 7 个公开智能体框架下评测多种前沿 LLM。

Result: 即便最强配置也仅取得 50.6% 的平均分，且平均每任务消耗 27M tokens、63 分钟。

Conclusion: 当前智能体与自主物理工程设计之间存在实质差距，PLE 提供了面向真实工程交付物的高难度评测范式。

Abstract: Frontier language models now score above 90% on popular knowledge benchmarks and are increasingly deployed as agents that carry out multi-hour professional work. Yet no existing benchmark tests whether they can perform the real-world, economically valuable work of a professional physical engineer, such as modelling physics and legal code requirements across a multi-format project corpus, optimising material and installation costs, and issuing 2D/3D engineering design packages that a licensed reviewer would sign off on. Existing engineering benchmarks focus on textbook question answering, isolated tool calls or self-contained toy design problems. As a result, most of these benchmarks are already saturated by leading agents and solving them is far away from delivering real engineering design. We introduce PLE, a benchmark of 85 long-horizon, agentic tasks in professional physical engineering consisting of electrical, civil, structural and mechanical engineering, where solving a task means completing a realistic, billable engineering deliverable. PLE combines two complementary curation paths. Expert-Authored tasks are created end to end by practising engineers from a professional data provider's expert pool. Co-Authored tasks start from problem statements written by practising engineers; an adversarial Creator-Solver agent pipeline constructs each task's realistic project environment, executable grader and reference deliverables before sending them to expert engineers for validation and difficulty intensification. We evaluate a variety of frontier LLMs under seven publicly available agent harnesses. Even the strongest configuration reaches a mean score of only 50.6%, while spending 27M tokens and 63 minutes per task on average, demonstrating the substantial gap between current agents and autonomous physical engineering design.

</details>


### [221] [Governed Self-Evolution for Autonomous Investing: A Multi-Agent LLM System with an Invariant Core](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30557)
*Yebo Feng,Jingyang Dai,Liangrui Pan,Nelson Lau,Jiahua Xu,Yang Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Steward is a multi-agent LLM system for autonomous investing in which the boundary of self-evolution is drawn in the type system: nine role-specialised agents produce typed reports and decisions, a seven-layer shared memory supplies context, and nightly grading plus quarterly gated reflection enable safe self-improvement around an invariant core of order arithmetic, risk rules and discipline prompts.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM agents acting on live, untrusted Web data must combine heterogeneous evidence, retain state, and improve from outcomes without weakening safeguards. Autonomous investing is a stringent testbed because actions are irreversible and driven by untrusted content.

Method: (1) Nine role-specialised agents: four analysts read news feeds, SEC filings, macroeconomic series and market data and emit typed reports; a Portfolio Manager sets target positions; a protected Risk Manager audits them. (2) A seven-layer shared memory assembled by code from the system's own record provides position context, market narrative, calibration and past decisions. (3) Self-improvement by review: code grades every trade and forecast nightly into memory; quarterly a reflector proposes prompt learnings applied reversibly by a deterministic gate and verified via replay. All wrapped around an invariant core (order arithmetic, risk rules, discipline-agent prompts) unreachable by self-edit.

Result: Live deployment: 102 trading days, 1,632 LLM calls; contained a 24.6% sector drawdown to a 0.3% loss. Replay of recorded inputs: a single model on the same raw data traded more and lost 1.35 points vs. market over five days, while the joint design showed no significant loss; no injected instruction was followed. 2015–2026 backtest: the core alone lowered maximum drawdown under all 50 random entry policies.
