We introduce PhysTrace, a training-free framework aligning MLLM-generated, history-conditioned expectations with observed video windows to temporally localize physical violations and provide interpretable descriptions without task-specific probes or classifiers. We also introduce IntPhys2-Timing, adding violation intervals to IntPhys2. PhysTrace achieves a Hit Rate of up to 70.7% across physical principles on IntPhys2-Timing and outperforms the compared methods in overall possible-impossible discrimination accuracy on IntPhys2. Applied to reconstructed videos along the trajectories of pretrained diffusion/flow-based video models, PhysTrace reveals attribute- and noise-dependent patterns in physical violation localization, enabling interpretable physical consistency analysis across timesteps.

</details>


### [292] [Conservative Meta-Agent Search: Architecture Adaptation under Non-Stationarity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31436)
*Ali Atiah Alzahrani*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文将meta-agent架构搜索形式化为带切换成本与风险约束的序贯现任替换问题，提出CMAS（归档检索+类型化图编辑+配对影子回放+校准的方差惩罚显著性门槛+模拟canary与回滚），并构建MetaInvest-Bench基准；96条流上归一化regret由0.116降至0.104、留出效用0.44→0.48，部署推理成本约低6%，但搜索含token总成本最高，更新级误晋升率3.4%（名义5%），密封重跑4.8%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有agentic系统自动设计的评测基于静态任务集与即时标量奖励，而真实部署面临持续性分布漂移、延迟且相互依赖的反馈、组件失效相关性和高昂的架构变更成本，静态基准无法反映meta层面的适应能力，也缺乏对风险的硬约束。

Method: 将meta-agent架构搜索形式化为带切换成本与硬风险约束的序贯现任替换（incumbent replacement）；CMAS从架构归档中检索并生成类型化图编辑（typed graph edits），在公共随机数下用配对影子回放打分，并进行干预式组件信用分配；晋升需通过经验校准、方差惩罚的同时显著性分数超过预设margin，随后进入模拟canary阶段并预设回滚。构建MetaInvest-Bench：区制切换模拟器，给定worker能力可计算代理最优架构，含泄漏受控回放、对抗性治理赛道与五项负对照；金融流仅作风险敏感测试床，不主张alpha。

Result: 96条流上，相对最强自适应基线，归一化平均代理动态oracle regret由0.116降至0.104，留出效用由0.44升至0.48；额外worker无增益时团队收缩至近单agent；部署推理成本约低6%，但含搜索的token成本为对比方法中最高；观测到的每更新误晋升率3.4%（名义目标5%），密封重跑为4.8%。

Conclusion: 校准仅为经验性，针对作者自设基准上的更新级回放统计量，不保证全效用提升、不保证无模拟canary阶段伤害、也不提供序列级错误控制；即回测无法证明meta层面技能，需以可控模拟器与负对照审视泛化声明。

Abstract: Automated agentic-system design is typically evaluated on static task suites with immediate scalar rewards. Deployed systems face persistent shift, delayed dependent feedback, correlated component failures, and costly architecture changes. We formalize meta-agent architecture search as sequential incumbent replacement with switching costs and hard risk constraints and introduce Conservative Meta-Agent Search (CMAS). CMAS retrieves archived architectures and proposes typed graph edits, then scores each against the incumbent by paired shadow replay under common random numbers, with interventional component credit. Promotion requires an empirically calibrated, variance-penalized simultaneous score above a pre-specified margin, and is followed by a simulated canary stage and pre-specified rollback. Since backtests cannot certify meta-level skill, we introduce MetaInvest-Bench, a regime-switching simulator whose specified worker competence makes a surrogate-optimal architecture computable, with leakage-controlled replay, adversarial governance tracks, and five negative controls. Financial streams serve as a risk-sensitive testbed for meta-level generalization; we claim no alpha. Across 96 streams, CMAS cuts normalized mean surrogate dynamic-oracle regret from 0.116 to 0.104 and raises held-out utility from 0.44 to 0.48 over the strongest adaptive baseline; when extra workers add no value, it contracts to near-single-agent teams. Its deployment inference cost is ~6% lower, though its search-inclusive token cost is the highest of the methods compared. The observed per-update false-promotion rate is 3.4% against a nominal 5% target, and 4.8% in a sealed rerun. The calibration is empirical: it concerns an update-level replay statistic on an author-designed benchmark, and guarantees neither full-utility improvement, nor absence of simulated canary-stage harm, nor sequence-level error control.

</details>


### [293] [DIAL: Steerable Language Models with Distilled Instruction-Adherence Levels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31438)
*Thanh Q. Tran,John Russell Himawan,Arun Verma,Kiwan Wong,Wei Xiao,Daniela Rus,Bryan Kian Hsiang Low*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出DIAL方法，通过对冻结LLM做CFG生成训练信号并蒸馏，配合轻量文本条件化steering adapter，实现对指令遵循程度的细粒度、高效、可扩展的数值化控制，并发布SteerIF数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 提示词（prompting）无法可靠地提供对"指令遵循程度"的细粒度控制，而用户与应用对遵循强度的需求各异；现有可操控语言模型方法无法同时兼顾细粒度控制、效率与跨指令可扩展性。

Method: 1) 用冻结LLM执行无分类器引导（CFG），为不同遵循水平的on-policy蒸馏提供训练信号；2) 设计轻量steering adapter，以LLM隐状态的分类器计算闭式steering编辑，按目标遵循水平在每token自适应设定编辑幅度，并考虑隐状态几何以保持连贯性；3) 分类器以文本为条件，使共享adapter无需逐指令拟合即可支持新指令，训练只需指令与请求文本。

Result: 在多个LLM家族上评估，DIAL在概念表达与响应流畅性之间取得有竞争力的平衡，概念得分随遵循水平单调递增；训练于自建SteerIF（98,625条concept/persona/verifiable/descriptive指令）时，可细粒度控制persona，与提示结合还能提升可验证指令遵循。

Conclusion: DIAL同时实现细粒度控制、效率与可扩展性，是steering language model的可行方案；SteerIF数据集支撑其训练与评估。

Abstract: When a user says "Keep it short", how short should the LLM's response be? More generally, users and applications require different levels of instruction adherence, but prompting does not reliably provide fine-grained control over them. We therefore study "steerable language models" that provide fine-grained numerical control over the degree to which models follow general instructions specified in text. However, existing approaches do not jointly offer fine-grained control, efficiency, and scalability across diverse instructions. To address this gap, we introduce DIAL (Distilled Instruction-Adherence Levels) to achieve all three properties. For fine-grained control, we perform classifier-free guidance (CFG) with a frozen LLM to provide training signals for on-policy distillation of instruction adherence at different levels. For efficiency, we design a lightweight steering adapter that uses a classifier over the LLM's hidden states to compute a closed-form steering edit. The classifier adaptively sets the steering magnitude at each token based on the target adherence level, while accounting for the geometry of the LLM's hidden states to preserve response coherence. For scalability, the classifier is text-conditioned, allowing a shared adapter to support new instructions without per-instruction fitting, and training requires only instruction and request text. Evaluation across multiple LLM families shows that DIAL achieves a competitive balance between concept expression and response fluency, with concept scores increasing monotonically across adherence levels. We introduce SteerIF, an instruction-only dataset of 98, 625 concept, persona, verifiable, and descriptive instructions. When trained on SteerIF, DIAL provides fine-grained control over personas and, when combined with prompting, improves verifiable instruction following.

</details>


### [294] [Adaptive Skill Granularity for Coding Agents: Runtime Routing and Macro-to-Micro Recovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31461)
*Dingxuan Zhang,Yanhui Jiang,Jun Wang,Hefeng Zhou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出“自适应技能粒度”框架，将技能粒度视为以任务结构、执行状态和宏技能失败为条件的动作抽象策略，并用基于特征的粒度控制器与有限状态恢复执行器实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有研究多关注执行前的技能检索、组合与合成，而编码智能体在执行阶段还面临运行时控制问题：同一任务可由原始工具调用、宏技能或“先宏后退回微观恢复”的混合执行完成，技能粒度如何动态选择尚缺系统研究。

Method: 将技能粒度建模为条件化动作抽象策略；系统由两部分组成：基于特征的粒度控制器（按任务结构与执行状态路由），以及有限状态机式恢复执行器（显式处理宏技能失败并向微观恢复回退）；采用确定性编码智能体协议评测，以验证器定义的成败、总成本及宏采用率、失败恢复率、路径匹配度、状态转移正确性等过程指标度量。

Result: 固定宏执行在适用时高效，但在不匹配情形下脆弱；运行时路由与显式的宏到微观恢复提升了鲁棒性，并能恢复固定粒度执行无法解决的受控宏失败。

Conclusion: 编码智能体的技能库不应仅视为可检索资源，更应视为可控、可验证、可恢复的执行抽象。

Abstract: Reusable skills allow large language model agents to package task-specific procedures, tool affordances, and execution guidance into modular units. Prior work has largely studied how agents retrieve, compose, or synthesize skills before execution. In coding agents, however, execution poses an additional runtime control problem: the same task may be solved through primitive tool calls, macro skills, or hybrid execution that starts with a macro and falls back to micro-level recovery. We introduce Adaptive Skill Granularity, a framework that treats skill granularity as an action-abstraction policy conditioned on task structure, execution state, and macro-skill failures. The system combines a feature-based granularity controller and a finite-state recovery executor. We evaluate the framework with a deterministic coding-agent protocol using verifier-defined success, total cost, and process metrics such as macro adoption, failure recovery, route match, and transition correctness. Results show that fixed macro execution is efficient when applicable but brittle under mismatch, while runtime routing and explicit macro-to-micro recovery improve robustness and recover controlled macro failures that fixed-granularity execution leaves unresolved. Our findings suggest that skill libraries for coding agents should be treated not only as retrievable resources, but also as controllable, verifiable, and recoverable execution abstractions.

</details>


### [295] [FairFRESH: A Neuro-Symbolic Framework for Fair and Explainable Household Food Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31506)
*Kodur Sai Vinay Sathvik,Kakoli Bora,Tejaswini R. M*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出FairFRESH——将家庭食物推荐建模为受约束的公平分配问题，用神经符号框架学习个体效用、按显式福利目标分配食物、以确定性过滤器保证饮食规则，并用Shapley/Banzhaf归因给出解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统推荐系统一次只服务一个用户；家庭场景中成员共享有限食物储备且遵循不同饮食规则，独立推荐易导致资源冲突与饮食违规，因此需要将家庭推荐形式化为受约束的公平分配问题。

Method: 神经符号框架：学习每位成员的效用函数；在功利主义与平滑Nash等福利目标下进行贪心分配并给出近似保证；用确定性过滤强制饮食规则；用Shapley与Banzhaf归因做解释；用极小极大定理分析共享餐的轮换机制。

Result: NHANES衍生数据上Recall@20为0.293，优于五个学习型推荐器（≤0.244），但不及前日重复启发式（0.321）；四人家庭留存集上Nash分配使Gini差距较冲突消解降低42%，Recall@20由0.180提升至0.197，距平滑Nash上界仅2%，单成员效用重缩放至多改变1.5%的分配；所有推荐满足饮食规则，归因分数与组件移除后效用损失相关r=0.76；模拟中共享餐使食物储备消耗减少约三分之一，周轮换使最差成员效用较最佳固定餐提升38%。

Conclusion: FairFRESH在保证饮食合规与分配公平的同时保持有竞争力的推荐精度，并具备可解释性与理论保证，共享餐与轮换机制可显著降低储备消耗并提升弱势成员福利。

Abstract: Recommender systems typically serve one user at a time. However, in households, members share a finite pantry and follow different dietary rules, making independent recommendations prone to resource conflicts and dietary violations. We formulate household food recommendation as constrained fair division and present FairFRESH, a neuro-symbolic framework that learns per-member utilities, allocates foods under explicit welfare objectives, enforces dietary rules through a deterministic filter, and explains recommendations using Shapley and Banzhaf attributions. Theoretically, we show that no finite penalty guarantees compliance near a dietary-rule threshold, establish approximation guarantees for greedy allocation under utilitarian and smoothed Nash objectives in the stock-free model before filtering, and characterize the scale invariance of Nash welfare. We also use the minimax theorem to analyze rotating shared meals. On NHANES-derived data, the learned utility model achieves Recall@20 of 0.293, outperforming five learned recommenders (at most 0.244) but not a previous-day repetition heuristic (0.321). On held-out four-person households, Nash allocation reduces Gini disparity by 42% relative to conflict resolution while improving Recall@20 from 0.180 to 0.197. It comes within 2% of an upper bound on the smoothed Nash optimum, and rescaling one member's utilities changes at most 1.5% of assignments. All recommendations satisfy the encoded dietary rules, while attribution scores correlate with utility loss upon component removal (r = 0.76). In simulation, shared meals reduce pantry use by about one-third, and weekly rotation increases the worst-off member's utility by 38% over the best fixed meal.

</details>


### [296] [DuoCook: An Overcooked-Inspired Benchmark for Visual Planning and Coordination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31511)
*Ziyi Jiao,Heng Zhang,Drishti Regmi,Xiaokang Ye,Lianhui Qin,Peter Yichen Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出一个基于Unreal Engine、由编码智能体构建的Overcooked风格基准，用于评估单个视觉语言模型同时控制两名玩家的协作烹饪能力；在20张地图上评测4个VLM，并考察共享笔记本记忆的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 协作烹饪任务要求视觉语言智能体追踪动态场景状态、安排配方步骤顺序并在时间预算下分配共享资源，现有基准缺少在真实引擎环境中对这类集中式协调能力的系统评估。

Method: 在Unreal Engine中构建Overcooked灵感基准，由单个VLM基于俯视视觉观测同时控制两名玩家，输出高层动作、由引擎执行导航；共20张地图分五类，覆盖设备争用、地形变化与交接依赖下的集中式协调。提供道具图例、锅中食材数量指示与网格目标点以支持视觉与空间定位。对4个VLM在全部20张地图上评测任务得分、订单完成率、交付精度、动作接受率与API花费，并进行共享自撰笔记本的记忆消融（两条件均保留六轮动作历史）。

Result: 最强模型gpt-6-astra平均订单完成率为26.2%；笔记本记忆的影响因模型而异，Claude与Qwen平均得分提升，GPT与Gemini下降。

Conclusion: 该基准揭示了当前VLM在集中式双人协调任务上能力有限，且外部记忆机制的收益并不稳定、具有模型依赖性；为后续研究提供了多维评测框架与构建方法。

Abstract: Coordinating two players in a cooking task requires a vision-language agent to track changing scene states, sequence recipe steps, and allocate shared resources under a time budget. We introduce an Overcooked-inspired benchmark for evaluating these capabilities in Unreal Engine environments constructed using coding agents. A single vision-language model controls both players from top-down visual observations, selecting high-level actions while the engine executes navigation. The benchmark contains 20 maps in five categories. These categories support evaluation of centralized coordination under equipment contention, changing terrain, and handoff dependencies. A prop legend and pot ingredient-count indicators provide explicit visual cues, while grid-based destinations support spatial grounding. The evaluation compares four VLMs on all 20 maps, measuring task score, order completion, delivery precision, action acceptance rate, and model API expenditure. A memory ablation on the same 20 maps examines the effect of a shared, self-authored notebook while retaining six-response action history in both conditions. The strongest evaluated model, \texttt{gpt-6-astra}, achieves 26.2\% mean order completion. Notebook memory has mixed score effects across models, with positive mean differences for Claude and Qwen and negative differences for GPT and Gemini.

</details>


### [297] [From Prompt Rules to Golden Data Model: Production-Scale Generation of Personalized, Compliant Pharmaceutical Claims](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31519)
*Suyash Mishra,Qiang Li,Subhabrata Adak,Upender Phogat,Srikanth Patil,Satyanarayan Pati*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 在制药等受监管行业生成营销/医学声明（claims）时，本文把合规与个性化信号从"提示词规则"迁移到"检索阶段的结构化上下文"，基于含1,867条claims的Golden Data Model构建内部工具Composer，取得意图命中、6C质量分与复用率显著提升，并降低API成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM已广泛用于受监管行业（如制药）的商业与医学内容生成，但合规性、事实准确性与受众个性化难以保障；依赖在提示词中堆叠规则难以扩展，作者希望验证重构数据架构、在检索期注入结构化信号是否为更可扩展的杠杆。

Method: 生产案例研究。构建Golden Data Model（GDM），整合claim元数据、参考文献、受众标签、材料类型、使用历史、Match Text Variant（MTV）链接及六维质量分（6C），共1,867条claims、覆盖4个产品；在此之上部署内部工具Composer，将合规与个性化信号置于检索时过滤的结构化上下文中。

Result: 在六个产品—受众细分上，上下文管线使目标适应症（+29%）、目标内容类型（+62%）、目标受众（+67%）、6C质量分（+86%）及claim复用（+34%）均提升；部署期生产日志显示每周API成本下降29.5%。

Conclusion: 在受监管、高风险场景下，为检索时过滤而重构claim数据比扩展提示词规则更具可扩展性；工作属系统与数据架构贡献，记录了数据清洗、图链接与质量评分的工程路径；结果为描述性部署证据。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate domain-specific commercial & medical content (e.g., claims, statements, and promotional phrases) in regulated industries such as pharmaceuticals. However, ensuring its regulatory compliance, factual accuracy, and audience-specific personalization remains a major challenge. We report a production case study asking whether moving compliance and personalization signal from prompt-level rules into retrieval time structured context improves pharmaceutical claims generation, using Composer, a deployed internal tool built on a Golden Data Model (GDM) of 1,867 pharmaceutical claims spanning four products. The GDM integrates claim metadata, references, audience labels, material type, usage history, Match Text Variant (MTV) links, and a six dimension quality score (6C). Across six product-audience segments, the context pipeline improves intended indication (+29%), intended content type (+62%) and intended target audience (+67%), 6C quality score (+86%), and claim reuse (+34%). Production log analysis over the deployment period shows a 29.5% reduction in weekly API cost. We report this as descriptive deployment evidence. This work is a systems and data architecture contribution: it shows that in a regulated, high-stakes domain, restructuring claim data for retrieval-time filtering is a more scalable lever than expanding prompt-level rules, and documents the engineering path data cleaning, graph linking, and quality scoring.

</details>


### [298] [Jev-DLC: Decision-Level Continual Learning from Typed Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31521)
*Yangyang Feng,Jianle Gan,Zhuoyan Feng,Chengwei Qin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 Jev-DLC：将用户对决策的接受/撤销作为带类型的反馈，转化为可跨请求持久化的紧致因果状态，并构建 TCPA-Bench 进行时序评测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 个体偏好往往只在部署后才显现——用户接受某一决策或撤销它以选择另一决策。现有方法难以把这种反馈显式、可累积地用于后续决策。

Method: Jev 风格类型化接口显式标识被选动作及被替换决策；Jev-DLC 将每次纠正同时视为（1）关于可复用动作身份的证据，（2）偏好与拒绝选项间的有向关系，存入冻结打分器之上的两个互补有界通道并融合打分。方法不保留原始交互历史、不增加打分器调用、不做运行时语言模型反向传播。

Result: 提出按时间顺序、仅以对后续决策的影响计功的 TCPA-Bench。TCPA-Repeat 上用户宏平均准确率 44.83%，高于 Recent-4 历史重放 2.43 点；在至少两次先前反馈事件后达 56.07%，较该深度最强基线领先 7.54 点。

Conclusion: 显式类型化纠错可被压缩为紧致的因果状态，实现持续个性化。

Abstract: Individual preferences often become visible only after deployment, when a user accepts one decision or revokes it in favor of another. Jev-style typed interfaces make this feedback explicit by identifying the selected action and, under revocation, the decision it replaces. We study how these consequences persist across requests as Decision-Level Continual Learning from Typed Feedback (Jev-DLC). Jev-DLC treats each correction as both evidence about a recurring action identity and a directed relation between the preferred and rejected choices. It preserves these signals in complementary bounded channels above a frozen scorer and combines their scores to shape the next decision. The method retains no raw interaction history, adds no scorer call, and performs no runtime language-model backward pass. We also introduce TCPA-Bench, a chronological suite that credits a correction only through its effect on later decisions. On TCPA-Repeat, Jev-DLC reaches 44.83% user-macro accuracy overall, 2.43 points above Recent-4 history replay. After at least two earlier feedback events, it reaches 56.07%, a 7.54-point margin over the strongest reported comparison at this depth. These results show how explicit typed corrections can become compact causal state for continual personalization.

</details>


### [299] [Beyond Causal Masks: Auditing and Localizing Hidden Future-Token Leakage in Adaptive Sequence Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31522)
*Huiting Liu,Jinsong Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究发现自适应残差路由解码器中存在隐藏的未来token泄漏，使其teacher-forcing验证损失虚低（1.4259 vs 3.5958），但自由生成时困惑度反而升高；定位为全序列摘要经动态路由查询路径广播所致，修复后虚假优势消失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 未来token泄漏会造成虚假的架构增益：模型在teacher-forced评估下表现优异，但自由运行生成效果变差。作者希望在一个自适应残差路由解码器上系统调查此类失效，并强调仅看teacher-forced损失不足以判断架构进步。

Method: 以一个序列级路由摘要通过动态路由-查询路径广播全序列信息的自适应残差路由解码器为对象，采用前缀不变性契约、最大前缀输出差异（LeakScore）、互补行为指标与逐层诊断进行审计，并结合实现检查；辅以六组合成实现对照（跨五个模块族）、干净预训练对照、受控故障注入及多数值精度下的缓存一致性实验。

Result: 异常24层检查点将验证损失从基线3.5958降至1.4259，但未通过前缀不变性审计，生成时参考模型困惑度显著更高；逐层诊断与实现检查将违规溯源至经动态路由查询路径广播的全序列摘要。两个独立训练的12层因果修复均消除可检测泄漏，使验证损失与参考困惑度回到对照量级，虚假优势随之消失。

Conclusion: 隐藏的未来token访问可导致对架构进展的误导性结论；较低的teacher-forced损失必须与整模型因果性检查及自由运行评估结合解读，前缀不变性审计是必要诊断手段。

Abstract: Hidden future-token leakage can create false architectural gains: an autoregressive model may appear substantially better under teacher-forced evaluation while its free-running generation deteriorates. We investigate this failure in an adaptive residual-routing decoder whose sequence-level routing summary exposes prefix positions to future tokens despite a correct causal attention mask. An anomalous 24-layer checkpoint reduces validation loss from the baseline's 3.5958 to 1.4259, yet it fails a prefix-invariance audit and has substantially higher reference-model perplexity during generation. Layer-wise diagnostics and implementation inspection trace the violation to a full-sequence summary broadcast through the dynamic routing-query path. Two independently trained 12-layer causal repairs eliminate detectable leakage and return validation loss and reference perplexity to the control scale, removing the large apparent advantage. As diagnostic tools, we use the established prefix-invariance contract, maximum prefix-output discrepancy (LeakScore), complementary behavioral metrics, and layer-wise profiles. Supporting experiments cover six synthetic implementation pairs spanning five module families, clean pretrained controls, controlled fault injection, and cache consistency across numerical precisions. These results illustrate how hidden future-token access can produce misleading claims of architectural progress and why lower teacher-forced loss should be interpreted together with whole-model causal checks and free-running evaluation.

</details>


### [300] [Contestable Agents for Data Governance: Recording Human Stewardship of AI-Generated Metadata Across Structured and Unstructured Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31553)
*Humza Akhtar,Brian Freeman*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出"可争辩治理"（contestable governance）框架：LLM 专业智能体为有争议的元数据决策产出带评分、带引用的论证，数据管理员可接受/驳回/修改/补充后再提交，并留存包含证据、干预与结果的治理记录；含分诊路径、评分与记录模型、先例准入闸门，并以 HVAC 点位分类与保修失效模式两个用例说明。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业组织的运行知识分散于结构化记录（遥测、点位表、交易记录）与非结构化来源（手册、服务记录、通信、巡检报告），治理程序通常割裂管理二者；分类、关联与文档化高度依赖少数具备深度领域知识的员工，形成瓶颈。LLM 智能体虽可提出元数据、引用文档、标记质量问题，但未经审查的提案会把错误扩散到下游系统，而敷衍的审批又不留审查痕迹。

Method: 1) 专业智能体针对存在争议的元数据决策生成带评分与引用的论证；2) 管理员在提交前可接受、驳回、修改或新增论证；3) 治理记录保存证据、人工干预与最终结果；4) 版本化领域术语表为智能体提供模型特定术语与缩略语定义；5) 分诊路径将完整论证仅用于不确定提案，同时保留提交前审查；6) 定义评分模型与记录模型，并设置闸门控制哪些经验证的决策可成为先例。

Result: 给出工作流、分诊路径、评分与记录模型及先例闸门的设计说明；两个 HVAC 用例验证该模式：基于 Brick Schema 类标签的点位分类（附开源参考实现），以及将索赔字段与遥测关联到服务记录和版本化公告的保修失效模式决策示例。

Conclusion: "可争辩治理"通过让机器提案保持可质询、使人工审查留痕并可复用为先例，在保留人工问责的前提下缓解领域知识瓶颈，降低未审查提案导致的下游错误扩散风险。

Abstract: Industrial organizations hold operational knowledge in structured records, such as telemetry, point lists, and transactions, and in unstructured sources, such as manuals, service notes, communications, and inspection reports. Governance programs often manage these sources separately. Classifying, linking, and documenting them depends on a small group of employees with deep domain knowledge. Agents built on large language models can propose metadata, cite documents, and flag quality issues, but unreviewed proposals can spread errors into downstream systems. A perfunctory approval leaves no record of what a reviewer checked. We present contestable governance: specialist agents produce scored, cited arguments for disputed metadata decisions; a steward can accept, reject, modify, or add arguments before commit; and a governance record retains the evidence, interventions, and outcome. A versioned domain glossary supplies model-specific terms and acronym definitions to the agents. We describe the workflow, a triage path that reserves full argumentation for uncertain proposals while preserving review before commit, the scoring and record models, and a gate that controls which verified decisions become precedent. Two HVAC use cases illustrate the pattern: point classification using Brick Schema class labels, supported by an open reference implementation, and an illustrative warranty failure-mode decision linking claim fields and telemetry to service notes and revisioned bulletins.

</details>


### [301] [What Makes a Good Unmasking Policy? A Controlled Study of Learned Unmasking in Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31576)
*Jinya Sakurai,Xun Xu,Jaehong Yoon*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文系统拆解了掩码扩散语言模型的有监督解掩码策略设计空间，指出"匹配最终输出"的标注在低NFE下过于宽松，提出基于轨迹收缩目标、结合置信度与隐状态的轻量策略，在LLaDA-8B-Instruct上取得更优精度–NFE前沿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 掩码扩散语言模型可并行生成，效率取决于哪些预测被"提交"（commit）；学习式解掩码策略虽改善速度–精度权衡，但各方法在监督信号、输入特征与模型容量上差异混杂，难以判断哪些设计真正起作用。因此需要受控地逐一分离并剖析这些选择。

Method: 将监督式策略视为通过教师解码过程的蒸馏，独立检验四个维度：教师将何种预测标为可提交、策略在何种状态上模仿、策略观察到什么输入、以及需降低多少NFE才能抵消策略开销。据此提出以"轨迹收缩"为目标的训练方式：仅接受仍停留在参考轨迹上的提交，输入为置信度与隐状态的组合；策略规模856K参数。

Result: "匹配最终输出"的标注在低NFE下过于宽松；隐状态单独使用较弱，但可与置信度互补。对≤7.5M参数的策略，约10%的NFE下降即可抵消其额外开销。在LLaDA-8B-Instruct上，856K参数策略在GSM8K上取得最佳精度–NFE前沿与最高吞吐，在MATH-500与HumanEval中等目标下具竞争力，并可较大程度迁移至Dream-7B-Instruct。

Conclusion: 解掩码策略的有效性主要取决于监督目标（轨迹收缩优于最终输出匹配）与输入组合（置信度+隐状态），而非大容量；极轻量策略即可在多种任务与模型上实现更优的精度–效率权衡与跨模型迁移。

Abstract: Masked diffusion language models generate tokens in parallel, but their efficiency depends on which predictions are committed. Learned unmasking policies improve the speed--accuracy trade-off, yet differ in supervision, inputs, and capacity, obscuring which choices matter. We view supervised policies as distilling a decoding procedure through a teacher and examine independently what the teacher labels as committable, on which states the policy imitates it, what the policy observes, and how much the number of function evaluations (NFE) must decrease to offset policy overhead. We find that labeling predictions matching the final output is overly permissive at low NFE, and hidden states are weak alone but can complement confidence. About a 10% NFE reduction suffices to offset policy overhead for policies up to 7.5M parameters across tested settings. We therefore train a policy on trajectory-contraction targets, which accept only commitments staying on a reference trajectory, using confidence and hidden states. On LLaDA-8B-Instruct, the resulting 856K-parameter policy achieves the best accuracy--NFE frontier and highest throughput on GSM8K, is competitive at moderate targets on MATH-500 and HumanEval, and largely transfers to Dream-7B-Instruct.

</details>


### [302] [Who Is Sycophantic to Whom? Confident LLMs, Human Deference, and the Collapse of Trust Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31579)
*Deepthika S,Pawni Yadav,B. Sankar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究将被试内实验反转"谄媚"方向：检验当LLM自信、一致却错误时，用户是否会向模型"屈服"。32名被试与同一模型（GPT-5-mini）构建的5个助手学习科学话题，各助手事实被替换为可信谬误的比例为0/25/50/75/100%。结果显示，被植入谬误被采纳约60%（对照11%，OR=12.5），成绩从7.4降至2.9/10；被吸收的谬误以高置信度持有（8.4/10），置信度对正确性的判别力从AUROC 0.70跌至随机水平，而信任评分几乎不变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有谄媚研究多关注模型是否迎合用户；本文反向追问：当模型自信、一致但错误时，人类是否会反向迎合模型，即"人类侧谄媚"。

Method: 采用被试内实验设计（N=32），每名被试就至多5个科学话题与5个基于同一模型（GPT-5-mini）的助手对话；各助手简报中被替换为貌似合理虚假事实的比例分别为0%、25%、50%、75%、100%，且均以完全自信的口吻表述。每话题后进行突袭测验，选项含正确事实、植入谬误及两个干扰项，并对每个作答附带置信度评分。共104次测验、1,040次作答；辅以对话文本编码，并引入基线校正的人类顺从指数（Human Deference Index）。

Result: 得分从7.4降至2.9（满分10）；谬误项在伪造条目上被选率60%，对照正确教学条目仅11%（OR=12.5）。凡助手陈述谬误，各伪造水平下采纳率均约65%；被吸收的谬误以高置信度持有（8.4/10），正确答案相对错误答案的置信度优势消失，置信度判别正确性的AUROC由0.70降至随机水平，而任务后信任评分几乎未变。被试在助手表现更差时更倾向返回对话，但返回伴随更多谬误吸收而非更少；全部对话轮次中30%系将被测问题回贴给被检验的来源。助手本身几乎从不谄媚，且在用户反驳下从不退让。

Conclusion: 用户会对自信而错误的LLM产生显著顺从，且置信度校准被破坏而主观信任无明显变化；可信赖性应视为人机配对系统的属性，谄媚评估须双向测量，学习类界面应逐条声明地使可靠性可见。

Abstract: Research on sycophancy asks whether large language models (LLMs) bend towards what their users want to hear. We ask the reverse question: when an LLM is confident, consistent, and wrong, do users bend towards it? In a within-subjects experiment, 32 participants learned up to five science topics by chatting with five assistants built on the same model (GPT-5-mini). Unknown to participants, each assistant's briefing had 0, 25, 50, 75, or 100% of its facts replaced by plausible falsehoods, and every assistant spoke with full confidence. A surprise quiz after each topic offered the correct fact, the planted falsehood, and two distractors, with a confidence rating for every answer. Across 104 quizzes and 1,040 answers, scores fell from 7.4 to 2.9 out of 10, and the planted option was chosen on 60% of falsified items against 11% of correctly taught ones (odds ratio 12.5). Transcript coding showed that whenever the assistant stated a falsehood, it was adopted about 65% of the time at every falsification level. Absorbed falsehoods were held with high confidence (8.4/10), the modeled confidence advantage of right over wrong answers vanished, and the discrimination of confidence for correctness fell from an AUROC of 0.70 to chance, while post-task trust ratings barely moved. Participants tended to return to the chat more when the assistant was worse, but returning went with more absorption, not less, and 30% of all turns pasted quiz questions back to the source being checked. The assistant itself was almost never sycophantic and never conceded under pushback. We introduce a baseline-corrected Human Deference Index to quantify this human-side sycophancy and argue that trustworthiness is a property of the human-AI pair, that sycophancy evaluations should measure both directions, and that learning interfaces must make reliability legible claim by claim.

</details>


### [303] [Simulated Control Evals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31593)
*Jeffrey Olmo,David Zhang,Tyler Tracy*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出"模拟控制评估"(SCEs)：用语言模型模拟工具响应替代真实环境，从而在具体部署环境上直接开展控制评估，比在独立控制设置(如BashArena)中执行更准确、更样本高效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有控制评估依赖专门构建的控制设置，并将其结果外推到模型部署。但防护措施在部署中的有效性取决于控制设置未表征的环境与任务特征，因此外推可能失真。作者希望拓宽控制评估可运行的场景，使其能针对具体部署环境进行。

Method: 提出SCEs：以语言模型模拟工具响应来代替真实执行环境，从而在目标部署环境上运行控制评估。在可提供真实执行结果的LinuxArena上进行验证：将SCE预测误差与另一控制设置BashArena的误差以及LinuxArena内部控制指标的方差进行比较；在独立采样的评估与部署任务集上，跨五个监控器、5%审计预算测量安全性的RMSE；比较攻击策略、攻击者推理与监控推理分布的KL散度；进行方差解释分析；测试样本效率；并检验模拟中发现的策略在留出攻击上的迁移效果。

Result: 1) SCE预测安全性的RMSE为3.6个百分点，BashArena为10.1；2) 在攻击策略、攻击者推理和监控推理分布上，SCE的KL散度比BashArena低十倍以上；3) SCE解释了78–85%的跨环境方差(攻击成功率、监控分数、安全性)；4) 样本效率高：所用任务对抽样量不足部署任务集的5%，误差仍低于BashArena；5) 模拟发现的策略能提升监控器在留出LinuxArena攻击上的表现，优于BashArena，并大致接近真实执行策略带来的提升。

Conclusion: 针对具体部署的模拟控制评估比在独立控制设置中执行的控制评估更具预测力，且样本效率更高，为在真实部署特征下评估防护措施提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Control evaluations measure whether safeguards can prevent an AI model from causing undesired outcomes even when it is intentionally trying to do so. These evaluations typically use purpose-built control settings and extrapolate their results to a model's deployment. However, the effectiveness of safeguards in deployment can depend on features of environments and tasks that control settings do not represent. To broaden where control evaluations can be run, we introduce simulated control evaluations (SCEs), which use a language model to simulate tool responses in place of an environment. We evaluate SCEs on LinuxArena, where execution provides ground-truth outcomes. We compare SCE prediction errors with those from a separate control setting, BashArena, and with variation in control metrics within LinuxArena. For independently sampled evaluation and deployment task sets, SCEs predict safety with a root mean squared error of 3.6 percentage points across five monitors at a 5% audit budget, compared with 10.1 for BashArena. SCEs closely reproduce distributions of attack strategies, attacker reasoning, and monitor reasoning, with over tenfold lower KL divergence from execution than BashArena. SCEs explain 78-85% of the between-environment variance in attack success, monitor scores, and safety. This accuracy is sample efficient: SCEs predict safety with less error than BashArena using fewer than 5% as many task-pair draws as the deployment task set. Strategies discovered through simulation also improve monitor performance on held-out LinuxArena attacks, outperforming BashArena and approximately matching improvement from executed strategies. These results suggest that deployment-specific SCEs can be more predictive than control evaluations executed in separate control settings.

</details>


### [304] [Direct Pass@$k$ Optimization for Thought Pruning: Balancing Quality and Diversity in Test-Time Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31667)
*Mahdi Salmani,Adel Javanmard,Devansh Gupta,Meisam Razaviyayn*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一种直接优化 pass@k 的候选解剪枝方法，以统一目标自然平衡质量与多样性，在八个开源推理模型上优于现有质量/多样性剪枝策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 测试时缩放需生成大量候选解，全部运行到底计算代价高，故在短前缀后剪枝；但现有质量型与多样性型剪枝各自偏重一端，其实质是探索-利用权衡，而少有工作显式暴露并优化该权衡。

Method: 选择候选池以最大化"池中至少一个部分解续写后得到正确答案"的概率，即直接在选中解池上优化 pass@k；该目标同时奖励高质量部分解、惩罚其冗余，使质量与多样性由准则本身自然平衡，而非分离的启发式设计。

Result: 在八个开放权重推理模型上超越现有质量型与多样性型剪枝策略；当保留中等数量的部分解继续生成时，增益尤为显著。

Conclusion: 将剪枝显式表述为 pass@k 优化可有效统一质量与多样性，印证在剪枝阶段直接平衡两者对推理模型测试时缩放的价值。

Abstract: Test-time scaling has emerged as a key inference strategy for reasoning models, where a model generates a large number of candidate solutions in the hope of finding at least one correct solution. Running all candidate solutions to completion can be computationally demanding, so recent work prunes the candidate pool after generating only a short prefix, committing further computation only to the surviving candidates. Existing pruning strategies divide broadly into two categories: Quality-based methods assign a score to each partial solution and discard those predicted to ultimately lead to an incorrect final solution, while diversity-based methods select partial solutions that follow different reasoning trajectories and are therefore likely to cover different final solutions. The tension between these two objectives is an instance of exploration versus exploitation, yet little to no prior work on pruning exposes this trade-off directly, let alone optimizes it. In this paper, we introduce a pruning procedure that addresses this trade-off directly by optimizing pass@$k$ over the selected solution pool. In particular, it chooses the pool to maximize the probability that at least one of its partial solutions, when continued to completion, yields a correct answer. Because this objective simultaneously rewards high-quality partial solutions and penalizes redundancy among them, quality and diversity are naturally balanced by the criterion itself rather than through separate ad-hoc design choices. On eight open-weight reasoning models, our method outperforms existing quality-based and diversity-based pruning strategies. The gains are particularly pronounced when the pruning procedure keeps a moderate number of partial solutions for continued generation, highlighting the value of directly balancing quality and diversity during pruning.

</details>


### [305] [EpiSEM-Bench: Evaluating Safety and Evidence Recovery in LLM Agents under Missing Evidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31650)
*Qijin Zhang,Hanzhen Wang,Yuehan Zhao,Haoyu Dai,Yao Shu,Zhongxiang Dai,Shuang Qiu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出可执行基准 bench，在关键事实缺失条件下评估LLM智能体的不安全执行、安全边界与证据恢复能力，覆盖六领域300对匹配的不安全/安全任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工具调用型语言模型智能体依赖环境事实判断动作是否被允许；当工具响应遗漏安全相关事实时，即使用户请求无害且所有返回陈述为真，智能体也可能执行被禁止的动作。

Method: 构建含300对匹配不安全/安全任务、跨六领域的可执行基准；通过系统性抑制关键事实，度量关键证据缺失下的不安全执行率并确定最小可观测失败基数（含全证据失败与穷尽测试后无失败的情形）；引入独立审计工具，检验智能体是否主动寻求缺失事实，并在完成允许任务的同时扣留被禁止动作。

Result: 十个模型在遗漏鲁棒性、证据获取与恰当行动上存在显著差异；对缺失证据的抵抗力不一定转化为有效恢复；恢复通道可降低全部十个模型的不安全执行率，但各智能体在是否主动获取缺失事实并将其用于两类场景的恰当行动上表现不一。

Conclusion: 仅凭"抵抗缺失证据"不足以保证安全，需同时考察证据寻求与恢复后决策；基准为智能体在证据不完整条件下的安全边界评估提供可执行、可审计的框架。

Abstract: Tool-using language model agents rely on environmental facts to decide whether an action is permitted. When a tool response omits a safety-relevant fact, an agent may carry out a prohibited action even though the user request is benign and every returned statement is true. We introduce \bench{}, an executable benchmark for evaluating unsafe execution, safety boundaries, and evidence recovery in LLM agents under missing evidence. It contains 300 matched unsafe/safe task pairs across six domains. By systematically suppressing critical facts, the benchmark measures unsafe execution under critical evidence omission and determines the minimum observed failure cardinality, including failures with full evidence and cases with no observed failure after exhaustive testing. An independent audit tool tests whether agents seek missing facts and then withhold prohibited actions while completing permissible tasks. The benchmark reveals substantial variation across the ten models in omission robustness, evidence acquisition, and appropriate action. Resistance to missing evidence does not necessarily translate into useful recovery. Recovery access reduces unsafe execution for all ten models, but agents differ in whether they actively obtain the missing facts and use them to act appropriately in both worlds.

</details>


<div id='cs.AR'></div>

# cs.AR [[Back]](#toc)

### [306] [Verified DRAM Address Mapping Reverse Engineering with Threshold Sweep](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30397)
*Hewen Zhang,Ian G. Harris*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出端到端软件流水线，在嵌入式LPDDR5系统上求解并验证DRAM地址映射函数，通过阈值扫描+Knock-Knock线性约束求解+DDR RREF恢复bank掩码，并用组验证与单函数验证两阶段校验，为Rowhammer分析提供更稳健的映射恢复方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法通常只返回单一推断映射，缺乏对不同阈值候选的系统记录与验证，难以保证在ARM嵌入式设备上恢复bank掩码的稳健性；同时后续Rowhammer分析需要可靠的地址映射函数。

Method: 从大规模地址对延迟数据集出发，构建延迟直方图并进行阈值扫描以获得候选同bank地址对；对每个阈值应用Knock-Knock风格线性约束求解器恢复候选bank掩码，并用GF(2)行简化阶梯形（RREF）计算最终掩码；实现组验证（检验掩码诱导的bank划分与实测时序行为是否一致）与单函数验证（逐一移除某个地址函数并测量验证通过率变化）两阶段验证。

Result: 对每个候选阈值系统记录求解出的bank掩码及验证指标（而非仅输出单一映射），从而支持在ARM嵌入式设备上更稳健地选择bank掩码，并形成高效的地址映射逆向工程流程。

Conclusion: 该流水线为嵌入式LPDDR5平台的DRAM地址映射函数逆向提供了可验证、可比较的端到端方案，提升了bank掩码选择的稳健性，并可支撑后续Rowhammer分析。

Abstract: We propose an end-to-end software pipeline for solving and validating DRAM address mapping functions on embedded LPDDR5 systems, and we instantiate it on embedded platforms. Starting from a large latency dataset of address pairs, the pipeline first builds a latency histogram and then performs a threshold sweep to obtain candidate same-bank address pairs. For each threshold, we apply a Knock-Knock-style linear-constraint solver to recover candidate bank masks. Final bank masks are calculated using GF(2) reduced row echelon form (RREF). To verify correctness, we implement two verification stages, group verification and single function verification, inspired by prior work. Group verification checks whether bank partitions induced by the recovered masks agree with observed timing behavior. Single function verification removes one addressing function at a time and measures the resulting change in verification pass rate. Unlike approaches that return only a single inferred mapping, our workflow systematically records, for each candidate threshold, the solved bank masks and validation metrics. This pipeline supports more robust selection of bank masks on ARM-based embedded devices and provides an efficient method for reverse engineering DRAM address mapping functions and subsequent Rowhammer analysis.

</details>


### [307] [Proba: A High-Performance, Low-Traffic Probabilistic Spatial Memory Streaming Prefetcher](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30448)
*Yinting Huang,Jacky Wong,Sam Ainsworth*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: Proba 是一种反馈驱动的空间内存流（SMS）预取器，通过概率化模式更新、边际精度决策和多触发特征模式累积，实现细粒度精度-覆盖率权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 SMS 预取器虽然能利用重复空间访问模式，但对激进程度控制粗糙，且对动态程序行为与历史模式适应性不足，难以在精度与覆盖率间灵活调节。

Method: 提出 Proba 反馈定向 SMS 预取器，集成三项机制：概率化模式更新、基于边际精度的决策、以及跨多个触发特征的模式累积，从而对预取激进程度进行细粒度调控。

Result: Proba 相比其他 SMS 预取器取得更高加速比，同时 DRAM 流量效率显著更优；在多核与 DRAM 受限场景下与其他技术形成显著性能差距，且不损害单线程吞吐。

Conclusion: 通过反馈驱动的细粒度精度-覆盖率调节，Proba 在保持单线程性能的同时，于多核和带宽受限环境下实现了优于现有 SMS 方案的性能与能效平衡。

Abstract: Spatial Memory Streaming (SMS) prefetchers exploit recurring spatial access patterns across memory regions to predict future accesses. Despite their effectiveness, existing SMS-based designs suffer from coarse control over aggressiveness and limited adaptability to dynamic program behavior and historical patterns. In this work, we present Proba, a feedback-directed SMS-based prefetcher that integrates probabilistic pattern updates, marginal accuracy decision-making, and pattern accumulation over several trigger features to achieve fine-grained accuracy-coverage trade-offs. When accuracy deteriorates, Proba moderates its aggressiveness to prioritize accurate prefetches; conversely, when accuracy rises, it expands its coverage. Proba achieves higher speedups than any other SMS-based prefetcher while being vastly more efficient in DRAM traffic. This culminates in a large performance gap between Proba and other techniques in multicore and DRAM-constrained scenarios without harming single-threaded throughput.

</details>


### [308] [FIGFLEX: A Mixed-Precision FP-INT GEMM Accelerator Co-Designed with Low-Bit LLM Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30480)
*Faraz Tahmasebi,Haocheng Xu,Andrew Trauger,Yomal Perera,Zhenyu Tang,Nael Chowdhury,Sitao Huang*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: FIGFLEX 是一种算法-硬件协同设计的混合精度加速器，通过 shift-add radix-4 FP-INT 分解与混合精度量化器，使 bit-parallel 数据通路在权重精度降低时吞吐线性提升，在 LLaMA-2-7B 上以更低比特达到更优困惑度并获得更高面积效率吞吐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仅权重量化（weight-only quantization）将激活保持为浮点、权重存为低比特整数，使主负载变为 FP-INT GEMM。现有量化器可达 2-3 bit 平均精度，但硬件未跟上：GPU 在 tensor-core MAC 前先反量化到 FP16，bit-parallel FP-INT 加速器仅支持单一权重精度，因此减少比特只省内存、不省计算。

Method: (1) 提出 shift-add、radix-4 的 FP-INT 乘法重写，将 MAC 融合为统一的、精度灵活的部分积归约，粗略减半部分积数量，并提出 INT3 优化以回收 radix-4 在该精度下闲置的数据通路；(2) 设计混合精度量化器，按 GPTQ 无法补偿的误差为每个通道组分配比特宽度，并采用逐输入通道列缩放，其 2 的幂归一化使缩放后激活不落入 FP16 subnormal 范围，使量化模型可直接映射到 FIGFLEX 数据通路且精度与 GPU 一致。

Result: 在 LLaMA-2-7B 上，3-bit 与 2-bit 平均精度下 WikiText-2 困惑度分别为 5.85 和 8.77，优于 GPTQ、AWQ、SliM-LLM、AMQ 和 QuIP#（无微调）；在 3-bit 混合精度模型的线性 GEMM 上，整芯片单位面积吞吐分别比 AxCore 和 FIGLUT 高 1.56x 和 1.42x。

Conclusion: 通过算法-硬件协同设计使 FP-INT 数据通路吞吐随精度下降而扩展，FIGFLEX 同时实现更优量化精度与更高面积效率吞吐，验证了精度灵活数据通路与误差导向混合精度量化的有效性。

Abstract: Weight-only quantization keeps LLM activations in floating point and stores weights as low-bit integers, turning the dominant workload into floating-point-integer (FP-INT) general matrix multiplication. Recent quantizers reach a 2-3-bit average with mixed precision, but hardware has not kept pace: GPUs dequantize weights to FP16 before the tensor-core multiply-accumulate, and bit-parallel FP-INT accelerators run at a single weight precision, so fewer bits save memory but not computation. In this paper, we present FIGFLEX, an algorithm-hardware co-designed mixed-precision accelerator whose bit-parallel datapath scales throughput as precision falls. FIGFLEX contributes (1) a shift-add, radix-4 reformulation of FP-INT multiplication that fuses the multiply-accumulate into a unified, precision-flexible partial-product reduction and roughly halves the partial products, together with a novel INT3 optimization that reclaims the idle datapath radix-4 leaves at that precision; and (2) a mixed-precision quantizer that assigns each channel group its bit-width according to the error GPTQ cannot compensate, with a per-input-channel column scaling whose power-of-two normalization keeps the scaled activations out of the FP16 subnormal range, so that the quantized model maps directly onto FIGFLEX's datapath with the same accuracy as on a GPU. On LLaMA-2-7B, FIGFLEX attains 5.85 and 8.77 WikiText-2 perplexity at 3- and 2-bit average precision, lower than GPTQ, AWQ, SliM-LLM, AMQ, and QuIP# (without fine-tuning), while delivering 1.56x and 1.42x higher whole-chip throughput per area on the linear GEMMs of a 3-bit mixed-precision model than AxCore and FIGLUT, respectively.

</details>


### [309] [HDLouvain: High-Throughput Incremental Clustering for Hyperdimensional Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30687)
*Beenish Gul,Mahbod Afarin,Farhat Ahmed,Sumukh Pinge,Tsung-Han Lu,Tajana Rosing,Kevin Skadron*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出HDLouvain，将Louvain社区检测与超维计算(HDC)的位并行相似度计算结合，用于大规模shotgun蛋白质组学质谱流的增量聚类，在保持聚类质量的同时显著提升吞吐量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代shotgun蛋白质组学每小时产生数万张串联质谱图、数百GB数据，传统聚类流程难以承受。DBSCAN对数据密度变化不稳定，HAC复杂度为O(n²)，两者聚类质量均较差；Louvain等图方法聚类质量高但在流式数据上扩展性差。作者认为Louvain的扩展性问题可以在不牺牲质量的前提下解决。

Method: HDLouvain先用bootstrap采样部分流数据，按precursor质量分桶，对每个桶的kNN相似度图运行Louvain；再用按位多数投票(bundling)将每个社区压缩为单个二值超向量，替代迭代质心重算。新谱图通过GPU加速的Hamming距离在其质量桶内对代表向量进行查找匹配，若未达到相似度阈值τ则新建簇，从而增量扩展划分而无需全量重聚类。实验中在五个PRIDE数据集(0.99M–21.13M谱图)上将bootstrap比例α从0.2扫描至0.9。

Result: α从0.2到0.9呈现显式单调的吞吐量-保真度权衡。在PXD003258上，α=0.3时加速4.5倍，α=0.7时加速1.65倍；模块度从α=0.2时的0.75–0.76升至α=0.9时的0.95–0.97，始终不低于全静态重算结果的92%。Louvain阶段在30k–2M节点的LFR基准网络上NMI达0.86–0.93，而DBSCAN与HAC降至0.57。

Conclusion: HDLouvain通过HDC位并行相似度计算与Louvain社区检测的结合，解决了图聚类在流式质谱数据上的扩展性瓶颈，提供了可通过α显式调控的吞吐量与聚类质量权衡，并在大规模真实数据集和基准网络上均优于DBSCAN与HAC。

Abstract: Modern shotgun proteomics generates tens of thousands of tandem mass spectra per hour, producing hundreds of gigabytes of data that strain conventional clustering pipelines. DBSCAN and hierarchical agglomerative clustering (HAC) offer flexible similarity search, but DBSCAN is unstable across varying data densities, HAC costs $O(n^2)$, and both yield poor cluster quality. Graph-based methods such as Louvain produce high-quality clusters but scale poorly on streaming data. We observe that Louvain's poor scalability can be resolved without sacrificing its quality, and present HDLouvain, which combines Louvain community detection with the bit-parallel similarity computation of hyperdimensional computing (HDC). HDLouvain partitions a bootstrap fraction of the stream into precursor-mass buckets, applies Louvain to each bucket's kNN similarity graph, and condenses each community into a single binary hypervector by bitwise-majority bundling rather than iterative centroid recomputation. New spectra are assigned by a GPU-accelerated Hamming distance lookup against representatives in their mass bucket, or seed a new cluster when no match meets a similarity threshold $τ$, so the partition grows incrementally without full re-clustering. On five PRIDE datasets (0.99M to 21.13M spectra), sweeping the bootstrap fraction $α$ from 0.2 to 0.9 exposes an explicit, monotonic throughput-fidelity trade-off. On PXD003258, speedup ranges from 4.5x at $α=0.3$ to 1.65x at $α=0.7$. Modularity rises from 0.75-0.76 at $α=0.2$ to 0.95-0.97 at $α=0.9$, never more than 8% below full static recomputation. The Louvain stage achieves 0.86-0.93 normalized mutual information (NMI) on LFR benchmark networks with 30k to 2M nodes, whereas DBSCAN and HAC degrade to 0.57.

</details>


### [310] [SnakeCharmer: Orchestrating Utility, Timeliness, and Placement in GPU Prefetching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30990)
*Yuhan Tang,Tiejun Li,Jianmin Zhang,An Hu,Guangyu Sun,Sheng Ma,Yiqun Lang,Hanqing Li,Siqing Fu*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出SnakeCharmer——面向地址预测型GPU预取器的统一后端预取控制框架，将地址预测与预取"实现"解耦，在A100模型上相对Snake/APOGEE提升性能12.8%/1.7%、能效20.8%/3.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GPU依赖大规模线程级并行掩盖长内存延迟，但大量warp同时等待内存数据时仍出现严重停顿。基于地址预测的预取器可缓解此类停顿，然而仅提高预测准确率并不能保证性能提升：一个预测的预取只有在"值得发射、时机恰当、且被保留而不造成有害干扰"时才真正有益，而这三个需求相互耦合，孤立优化任一维度只会把瓶颈转移到别处。

Method: 以"预测预取→实际收益"的视角建模上述需求，提出统一的预取后端控制框架SnakeCharmer，将地址预测与预取实现分离：前端预测器仅产生预取候选，后端控制路径联合决定每个候选是否发射、何时发射、返回数据存放在何处。具体机制包括：零值感知过滤（效用/utility）、基于层次反馈的预取距离调优（及时性/timeliness）、以及寄存器辅助的预取缓冲区（放置/placement）。在Snake基础上实现，并将同一后端控制原则迁移至APOGEE以验证通用性。

Result: 在A100 GPU模型上，SnakeCharmer相对Snake提升性能12.8%、能效20.8%；相对APOGEE提升性能1.7%、能效3.2%；硬件开销适中。

Conclusion: 预取收益需在效用、及时性与放置三个维度上协同控制，而非仅追求预测准确率；将预测与实现解耦的统一后端控制可跨不同前端预取器带来额外收益，且成本可控。

Abstract: GPUs rely on massive thread-level parallelism to tolerate long memory latency, yet they still suffer severe stalls when many warps simultaneously wait for data from the memory system. Address-prediction-based GPU prefetchers can mitigate such stalls, but accurate prediction alone does not guarantee performance improvement: a predicted prefetch becomes beneficial only if it is worth issuing, arrives at the right time, and is retained without harmful interference. Because these requirements interact, optimizing any single dimension in isolation can simply move the bottleneck to another.
  We capture these requirements with a predicted-prefetch-to-realized-benefit perspective and propose SnakeCharmer, a unified backend prefetch-control framework for address-prediction-based GPU prefetchers. SnakeCharmer separates address prediction from prefetch realization: the frontend predictor generates prefetch candidates, while the backend control path jointly controls utility, timeliness, and placement by determining whether each candidate should be issued, when it should be issued, and where the returned data should be retained. SnakeCharmer realizes this control path with zero-value-aware filtering for utility, hierarchical feedback-driven distance tuning for timeliness, and a register-assisted prefetch buffer for placement. We design and implement SnakeCharmer primarily on top of Snake, and adapt the same backend-control principles to APOGEE to demonstrate that SnakeCharmer's benefits are not limited to a single frontend predictor. On an A100 GPU model, SnakeCharmer improves performance/energy efficiency by 12.8%/20.8% over Snake and by 1.7%/3.2% over APOGEE, with modest hardware overhead.

</details>


### [311] [Ray-by-Ray: Fine-Grained Resource Management for GPU Ray Tracing Units](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31630)
*Junrui Pan,Cesar Avalos Baddouh,Kai Ze Ee,Timothy G. Rogers*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文验证开源RT基础设施中的假设，揭示SIMT与专用RT单元粒度不匹配导致的资源管理低效，并提出按单条光线粒度分解片上缓冲的Ray-by-Ray方案，在0.19%面积开销下取得平均1.91倍性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 光线追踪中每条光线遍历的加速结构节点、材质与终止深度各不相同，导致控制流与数据发散严重，线程一致性下降；GPU的SIMT执行模型与专用RT单元的逐线程（逐光线）执行模型之间存在粒度失配，造成片上缓冲等资源管理低效，RT单元利用率与内存级并行度受限。

Method: 先验证开源基础设施中的建模假设，定位RT流水线中的资源管理低效点；进而提出Ray-by-Ray，将片上缓冲区划分粒度细化到单条光线，并引入轻量级管理结构，在不增加缓冲容量的前提下让更多warp并行执行。

Result: 实验显示Ray-by-Ray相比基线平均性能提升1.91倍，面积开销仅0.19%；同时提升了RT单元利用率与内存级并行度。

Conclusion: 通过将片上资源管理粒度对齐到单光线级，可有效缓解SIMT与RT执行粒度失配问题，以极低硬件代价显著提升光线追踪流水线性能，为RT硬件与开源仿真基础设施的协同优化提供了方向。

Abstract: Ray tracing (RT) generates photorealistic images by simulating the physical behavior of light as it interacts with surfaces in a virtual scene. In film production and high-end rendering pipelines, this technique computes global illumination, reflections, refractions, and soft shadows by tracing millions of light rays per frame and accurately modeling their bounces and attenuation. Contemporary GPUs incorporate specialized ray tracing hardware to accelerate key operations in the traversal pipeline. By accelerating these stages in hardware, the unit enables real-time ray tracing for complex scenes that previously required offline computation. However, ray tracing introduces substantial control and data divergence. Each ray may traverse a different set of nodes in the acceleration structure, encounter distinct materials, or terminate at varying depths. This irregularity reduces thread coherence and exposes a fundamental disparity between the GPU SIMT and per-thread execution model of dedicated RT units, where each ray progresses independently.
  In this work, we seek to validate assumptions made in open-source infrastructure and identify potential inefficiencies in resource management within the ray tracing pipeline. To address inefficiency caused by mismatches between SIMT and RT granularities, we propose Ray-by-Ray, which decomposes on-chip buffers into the granularity of individual rays and introduces lightweight management structures that enable more warps to run in parallel without increasing buffer capacity. This approach improves ray tracing unit utilization and increases memory-level parallelism. Experimental results show that Ray-by-Ray achieves an average performance improvement of 1.91x over the baseline, with an area overhead of 0.19\%.

</details>


<div id='eess.SP'></div>

# eess.SP [[Back]](#toc)

### [312] [Semblance Distance Analysis for Channel Quality Assessment in Distributed Acoustic Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30401)
*Reinhardt Rading,Markus Hoffmann,Norbert Meyners,Holger Schlarb,Céline Hadziioannou,Oliver Gerberding,Katharina-Sophie Isleif*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文提出基于相似度距离（semblance distance）的统计框架，用于评估分布式声学传感（DAS）通道质量，实现相干信号空间中的通道选择与光纤健康监测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DAS可提供千米级密集测量，但受空间非均匀噪声和光纤-地面耦合差异限制；传统基于信噪比（SNR）或相关性的方法在非平稳复杂噪声环境下不足以识别高质量通道。

Method: 定义semblance距离度量，量化单通道相对局部相干参考信号的偏离；将通道选择转化为相干增强信号空间中的距离估计问题，无需安装条件或噪声统计的先验知识，可识别非相干噪声与耦合畸变。

Result: 在2023年土耳其-叙利亚地震记录、可控震源实验和长期连续观测等多套独立数据集上验证；所识别低噪声、强耦合区域与独立SNR和RMSE指标相关；并能检测季节尺度上亚分贝级的耦合变化。

Conclusion: semblance距离分析是一种物理可解释的DAS通道选择工具，可应用于地震成像、结构健康监测及引力波探测器等高灵敏系统的噪声抑制。

Abstract: Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) enables dense, kilometer-scale measurements for seismic and environmental monitoring, but its performance is limited by spatially heterogeneous noise and fiber to ground coupling. Identifying high-quality sensing channels remains a challenge, particularly in nonstationary and complex noise environments where conventional signal to noise ratio (SNR) or correlation based approaches are insufficient. In this work, we introduce a statistical framework for DAS channel quality assessment based on a semblance distance metric, which quantifies the deviation of individual channels from a locally coherent reference signal. Unlike traditional pairwise similarity measures, the proposed method formulates channel selection as a distance estimation problem in a coherence enhanced signal space, enabling identification of incoherent noise and coupling induced distortions without requiring prior knowledge of installation conditions or noise statistics. The method is validated using multiple independent datasets, including recordings of the 2023 Turkish-Syrian earthquakes, a controlled seismic source experiment, and long-term continuous measurements. Across all scenarios, the approach identifies regions of low noise and strong coupling, with results that correlate with independent SNR and root mean square error (RMSE) metrics. Furthermore, the method detects subtle sub-decibel temporal variations in coupling conditions over seasonal timescales, demonstrating its capability for continuous fiber health monitoring. These results establish semblance distance analysis as a physically interpretable tool for DAS channel selection with direct applications in seismic imaging, structural health monitoring, and noise mitigation in high sensitivity systems such as gravitational wave detectors.

</details>


### [313] [Damage detection in railway wheels from impact-induced ultrasonic ring-down using self-referenced decay features](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30541)
*Aashish Shaju,Steve Southward,Mehdi Ahmadian*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 该研究提出并验证一种基于锤击激励、空气耦合超声测量的非接触式固定轮对筛查方法，使用有效阻尼比与击间变化两个衰减特征，在两处铁路设施共22个轮对上实现了跨数据集可迁移的缺陷判别（21/22正确，全部缺陷轮对均被识别）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 铁路轮对损伤需要高效、非接触的筛查手段；作者希望检验简单的衰减特征检测器能否在不同数据集、不同设施之间迁移，并替代在跨数据集测试中表现不佳的复杂数据驱动模型（随机森林）。

Method: 通过锤击激励产生振动，用空气耦合超声测量轮对响应衰减；提取两个特征：(1) 有效阻尼比，即将测得的衰减率按主响应频率归一化；(2) 击间变化量，用于评价整轮能量衰减拟合质量。先训练随机森林跨数据集迁移；随后改用对两特征设阈值的简单方法，固定特征定义并在一个数据集上校准阈值、在另一数据集上测试；进一步采用更严格的轮级留一验证，在每个测试轮对被留出时重复第二特征选择与阈值校准。

Result: 随机森林在一个数据集训练、另一数据集测试时表现较差；两特征阈值法在跨数据集测试中正确分类全部轮对；严格轮级留一验证正确分类22个轮对中的21个，所有缺陷轮对均被识别，仅有1个健康轮对误报。

Conclusion: 两特征检测器在固定状态评估下可在所测试数据集之间迁移，适用于轮对损伤的非接触筛查；但尚需使用磨损但可服役的轮对、受控支撑条件及更多独立数据集进一步评估。

Abstract: This study evaluates a non-contact screening method for stationary railroad wheelsets using air-coupled ultrasonic measurements excited by hammer impacts. Two decay features are considered. First, an effective damping ratio is obtained by normalizing the measured decay rate by the dominant response frequency. Second, strike-to-strike variations are measured to assess the quality of the energy-decay fit for the overall wheel. The method was evaluated using 22 wheelsets at two railroad facilities. The analysis indicates that a random forest trained on one dataset and tested on another performed poorly. This result motivated a simpler approach based on thresholds applied to the two decay features, which fixed the feature definitions and calibrated the thresholds on either dataset. This approach correctly classified every wheelset in the other dataset. A more stringent wheel-level validation repeated second-feature selection and threshold calibration while each test wheelset was withheld. This procedure correctly classifies 21 of 22 wheelsets. All defective wheelsets are identified, while one healthy wheelset yields a false positive. The results further show that the two-feature detector transferred between the tested datasets for stationary assessment of wheel damage. Further evaluation is required using worn but serviceable wheels, controlled support conditions, and additional independent datasets.

</details>


### [314] [In-Orbit Computing for Remote Sensing: Task-Oriented Processing and Transmission](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30693)
*Yi Zhang,Zesong Fei,Jingxuan Huang,Hua Dang,Jihao Luo,Wenyu Liang,Haoran Zhang,Xinyi Wang*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出语义感知星地协同遥感（SSGC-RS）框架，按任务需求与可用通算资源对遥感数据做不同"语义深度"处理，包含三种运行模式，并以土地覆盖识别为例说明其应对通信与计算瓶颈的作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 遥感数据量激增与实时性要求提高，传统"先传输后处理"架构在星地间歇连接、下行带宽受限、星上算力有限的条件下失效，需要重新设计星地数据处理分工。

Method: 构建SSGC-RS语义感知星地协同框架，将遥感数据处理划分为不同语义深度层级；设定三种运行模式：完全星上任务推理、语义表示下传、星地拆分推理，依据任务需求与通信-计算资源进行模式选择。

Result: 以土地覆盖识别为案例验证，展示了三种模式分别针对不同通信与计算瓶颈场景的有效性（属框架性与案例性论证，非定量对比结果）。

Conclusion: 语义级协同处理可缓解星地传输与星上算力矛盾；文章进一步梳理了智能遥感系统的新兴挑战与未来方向。

Abstract: The growing volume and timeliness requirements of remote sensing data are exposing the limitations of the conventional "transmit-then-process" architecture, particularly under intermittent satellite-ground connectivity, constrained downlink bandwidth, and limited onboard computing resources. This article presents a semantic-aware space-ground collaborative remote sensing (SSGC-RS) framework, in which remote sensing data are processed to different semantic depths according to task requirements and available communication-computing resources. Three operating modes are considered, ranging from fully onboard task inference to semantic representation delivery and space-ground split inference. A land-cover recognition case study illustrates how these modes address different communication and computing bottlenecks. Finally, emerging challenges and future directions for intelligent remote sensing systems are discussed.

</details>


### [315] [Electromagnetic Modeling of Deformation-Based Pinching Antennas](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30906)
*Dimitrios Tyrovolas,Nikos C. Sagias,Ke Guan,George K. Karagiannidis,Stylianos D. Asimonis*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文建立了基于有限形变的pinching antenna（PA）电磁模型，将波导扰动量与其复反射/透射响应及三维辐射特性直接关联，并揭示PA几何参数可作为控制辐射响应的自由度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Pinching-antenna systems（PAS）通过局部扰动引导结构实现能量辐射，其PA的物理响应同时决定导波传播与自由空间辐射。为刻画这一耦合行为，需要建立扰动量与电磁响应之间的显式模型。

Method: 构建有限形变PA的电磁模型，将施加的波导扰动直接映射到复反射与透射响应及三维辐射特性；采用全波MEEP仿真对模型进行验证，并系统分析pinching ratio与pinched-section length对透射功率与相位、辐射功率占比和辐射方向图的影响。

Result: 全波仿真验证了模型的有效性；pinching ratio与pinched-section length共同影响透射功率与相位、辐射功率占比及辐射方向图。接收SNR结果表明，最小化PA—用户距离或最大化辐射功率占比均不必然带来最高SNR，因为扰动同时决定了指向用户方向的实现增益。

Conclusion: PA几何构型构成控制辐射响应的独立自由度，且通信性能由扰动引起的方向性增益与功率分配共同决定，PA设计需联合优化几何参数而非单一指标。

Abstract: Pinching-antenna systems (PAS) rely on local perturbations of a guiding structure to radiate part of the guided electromagnetic energy, making the physical response of the resulting pinching antenna (PA) fundamental to both guided-wave propagation and free-space radiation. To capture this coupled behavior, we develop an electromagnetic model of a finite deformation-based PA that directly relates the applied waveguide perturbation to its complex reflection and transmission responses and three-dimensional radiation characteristics. Full-wave MEEP simulations validate the model and demonstrate how the pinching ratio and pinched-section length jointly affect the transmitted power and phase, radiation power-fraction, and radiation pattern, thereby establishing PA geometry as a degree of freedom for controlling the radiation response. Importantly, this geometric dependence extends to communication performance, as the received signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) results reveal that neither minimizing the PA--user distance nor maximizing the radiation power-fraction necessarily yields the highest SNR, since the applied perturbation also determines the realized gain toward the user.

</details>


### [316] [Energy-Efficient Risk-Constrained Adaptive Semantic Communications Under Uncertain Adversarial Threats](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30911)
*Maedeh Fallahreyhani,Paeiz Azmi,Nader Mokari,M. Reza Abedi*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出一种风险约束的能效语义通信框架，在源域/OTA/复合对抗条件下，用循环原始-对偶PPO控制器联合调节发射功率、带宽比与净化复杂度，并显式约束CVaR尾部风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度联合信源信道编码的语义通信可实现任务导向传输，但对抗鲁棒性往往依赖大量射频与接收端防御计算能耗，缺乏在部分可观测攻击条件下兼顾能耗与风险的调度机制。

Method: 以长期总能耗（通信+扩散净化）最小化为目标，受平均语义损失、轨迹级尾部风险与端到端时延约束；采用循环原始-对偶近端策略优化控制器，利用因果信道观测、语义置信度、不完美攻击信念估计与循环历史，联合自适应发射功率、语义/信道带宽比与净化复杂度；以CVaR约束限制严重语义失效。

Result: CIFAR-100上，未见源域ε=12/255时鲁棒Top-1约61%、CVaR0.9≈0.36，总能耗较纯扩散防御低约9%；未见OTA Γ_A=-5 dB时鲁棒Top-1约52%，语义尾部风险降低40%，总能耗低约8%。

Conclusion: 在部分可观测对抗条件下实现了能效与鲁棒性的折中，验证了风险约束强化学习调度对语义通信防御的有效性。

Abstract: Semantic communication systems based on deep joint source-channel coding can provide task-oriented wireless transmission, but adversarial robustness may require substantial radio and receiver-side defensive-computation energy. This paper develops an energy-efficient, risk-constrained semantic communication framework under source-domain, over-the-air (OTA), and potentially composite adversarial conditions. Long-term total energy, including communication and diffusion-purification energy, is minimized subject to average semantic-loss, trajectory-level tail-risk, and end-to-end latency constraints. A recurrent primal-dual proximal policy optimization controller jointly adapts transmit power, semantic/channel bandwidth ratio, and purification complexity using causal channel observations, semantic confidence, imperfect attack-belief estimates, and recurrent history. A conditional value-at-risk (CVaR) constraint explicitly limits severe semantic failures. On CIFAR-100, at the unseen source-domain level $ε=12/255$, the proposed controller achieves approximately $61\%$ robust Top-1 accuracy with $\mathrm{CVaR}_{0.9}\approx0.36$ while using about $9\%$ less total energy than diffusion-only defense. At the unseen OTA level $Γ_A=-5$ dB, it achieves approximately $52\%$ robust Top-1 accuracy, reduces semantic tail risk by $40\%$, and consumes about $8\%$ less total energy than diffusion-only defense. These results demonstrate energy-efficient semantic defense under partially observable adversarial conditions.

</details>


### [317] [Beyond Binary Encoding: Qudit-Based QAOA Framework for ML Detection in $M$-QAM MIMO Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30925)
*Chiran Siriwardena,Chanula Luckshan,Samiru Gayan,Hazer Inaltekin,Wonjae Shin*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出基于qudit的QAOA框架，将每个M-QAM符号直接编码为一对d维量子态(d=√M)，在保持星座几何结构的同时把量子载流子数从O(N_t log2 M)降至O(N_t)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: massive MIMO的ML检测是NP-hard组合问题，复杂度随发射天线数与调制阶数指数增长；现有基于qubit的QAOA需每符号log2 M个量子比特，导致电路宽度与深度膨胀。

Method: 通过星座的实-虚分解推导厄米代价哈密顿量；引入广义循环移位mixer以保证无非二进制编码下的遍历搜索；将每个M-QAM符号编码为两个d维量子态(d=√M)。

Result: 量子载流子数由O(N_t log2 M)降至O(N_t)，哈密顿量相互作用复杂度由O((N_t log2 M)^2)降至O(N_t^2)；在2×2 MIMO、4-QAM/16-QAM、Rayleigh衰落、电路深度p=3下，BER性能接近最优ML检测器，并持续优于MMSE检测器。

Conclusion: qudit-QAOA为massive MIMO ML检测提供了一种更紧凑的量子编码方案，在保持星座结构的同时显著降低资源开销，BER性能接近ML且优于MMSE。

Abstract: Maximum likelihood (ML) detection in massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) systems is an NP-hard combinatorial problem whose complexity grows exponentially with the number of transmit antennas and the modulation order. The Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) has recently emerged as a promising near-term quantum heuristic for such problems; however, existing qubit-based formulations require $\log_2 M$ qubits per $M$-QAM symbol, inflating both circuit width and depth. In this paper, we propose a qudit-based QAOA framework that encodes each $M$-QAM symbol directly into a pair of $d$-dimensional quantum states, where $d=\sqrt{M}$. We derive a Hermitian cost Hamiltonian via a real-imaginary decomposition of the constellation, and introduce a generalized cyclic-shift mixer that ensures ergodic exploration of the search space without binary encoding. The proposed formulation reduces the number of quantum carriers from $\mathcal{O}(N_t \log_2 M)$ to $\mathcal{O}(N_t)$ and the Hamiltonian interaction complexity from $\mathcal{O}((N_t \log_2 M)^2)$ to $\mathcal{O}(N_t^2)$, while preserving the geometric structure of the constellation. Bit-error-rate (BER) simulations for $2\times 2$ MIMO systems employing 4-QAM and 16-QAM over Rayleigh fading channels, with circuit depth $p=3$, demonstrate that the proposed detector closely approximates the performance of the optimal classical maximum-likelihood (ML) detector, while consistently outperforming the conventional minimum mean square error (MMSE) detector.

</details>


### [318] [Array Rotation in Near-Field ISAC: Communication, Detection, and Estimation Under Low-Complexity Transmit Architectures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31136)
*Marziyeh Soltani,Mark F. Flanagan*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 该文研究基于精确球面波模型的近场ISAC，提出可旋转基站阵列的CRB分解框架，并分析单流叠加与双波形分离两种架构下通信/检测/估计最优旋转角，含目标状态不确定下的鲁棒旋转设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近场球面波下阵列几何与目标侧几何强耦合，固定阵列朝向可能限制感知（尤其距离估计）性能，需明确旋转对通信与感知的差异化影响并给出低复杂度架构下的最优/鲁棒旋转设计。

Method: 在精确有限阵列球面波模型下，对一般发射协方差推导CRB分解（分离目标侧几何项与协方差相关项）；针对单流叠加架构与双波形分离架构，用精确模型刻画通信、检测、估计最优旋转角；用二阶近似给出紧凑角度表达式；并以相关高斯扰动建模目标状态不确定性，推导最优鲁棒旋转角近似。

Result: 两架构旋转行为不同：单流设计可使通信与检测对齐，双波形设计存在直接通信—检测权衡，感知优先时通信损失更大；数值结果表明相对固定朝向有明显增益（距离估计尤甚），近似与精确旋转选择高度一致；在所考察场景中检测对目标状态误差的敏感度低于估计。

Conclusion: 阵列旋转是近场ISAC中低成本、高效能的自由度；架构选择决定通信—感知是否可协同或必然折衷；二阶近似与鲁棒近似可作为实用设计准则。

Abstract: This paper studies near-field integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) with a rotatable base-station array under an exact spherical-wave propagation model. For a general transmit covariance, we derive a Cramér--Rao bound (CRB) decomposition that separates target-side geometry from transmit-covariance-dependent terms. We then specialize the framework to two representative low-complexity architectures: a single-stream superposition architecture, and a dual-waveform split architecture design. We characterize the communication-, detection-, and estimation-optimal rotations for each architecture using the exact finite-array model. In addition, we show how a second-order approximation yields compact approximate expressions for the optimal rotation angles. We also study uncertainty in the target state used for beamforming design through a correlated Gaussian perturbation model, and derive approximations of the optimal robust rotation angles for target sensing and detection. The analysis shows that the two architectures behave differently under rotation: the single-stream design can align communication and detection tasks, whereas the dual-waveform design exhibits a direct communication--detection tradeoff and can incur a larger communication loss when sensing is prioritized. Numerical results show clear gains over a fixed array orientation, especially for range estimation, and close agreement between the approximate and exact rotation choices. Detection is less affected by target-state errors than estimation in the considered cases.

</details>


### [319] [Telling Neural Network What We Know: Weight Configuration for RNN and Its Application to NextG Real-Time Neural Receiver](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31210)
*Ummay Sumaya Khan,Lizhong Zheng,Lingjia Liu*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文提出 skip-RNN——一种轻量级、跳连增强的循环神经网络接收机，用固定循环/跳连分支加自适应线性读出实现在线时域接收处理；借助其与混合相位信道稳定因果逆滤波器的结构对应关系，用信道统计配置权重，实现极低导频开销下的有效神经接收。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统神经接收机需大量离线训练和昂贵反向传播，难以用于低时延蜂窝系统；经典 MIMO-OFDM 接收机则依赖精确信道估计，带来显著导频开销。

Method: 构建 skip-RNN：固定循环分支与跳连分支分别实现 IIR 与 FIR 基函数，可解释为结构化反卷积滤波器；提出领域知识引导的权重配置框架——由估计信道统计提取主导 IIR 结构配置循环动态，非最小相位成分由跳连分支处理，并结合统计 FIR 读出先验，在"先验中心"正则化下在线自适应线性读出；推导近似误差界刻画配置后神经接收机的表示能力。

Result: 推导出配置后神经接收机表示的近似误差界；在标准化 3GPP 信道上仿真验证，所提配置神经接收机在极低导频开销下仍保持有效性能。

Conclusion: 通过将领域知识（信道逆滤波结构）嵌入轻量循环神经网络的结构与权重配置，可在无需大规模离线训练和反向传播的前提下实现在线自适应接收，并在极低导频开销下取得良好性能。

Abstract: AI-enabled receivers offer a promising approach to adaptive physical-layer processing, but conventional neural receivers often require extensive offline training and computationally expensive backpropagation, limiting their suitability for low-latency cellular systems. Moreover, classical MIMO-OFDM receivers rely on accurate channel estimation, leading to substantial pilot overhead. This paper introduces skip-RNN, a lightweight skip-augmented recurrent neural receiver that performs online time-domain receive processing using fixed recurrent and skip branches with an adaptive linear readout. We show that the skip-RNN can be interpreted as a structured deconvolution filter whose recurrent and skip branches realize IIR and FIR basis functions, respectively. We develop a domain-knowledge informed weight-configuration framework for the skip-RNN by exploiting its structural correspondence with the target stable and causal inverse filter of mixed-phase channels. The dominant IIR structure extracted from estimated channel statistics is used to configure the recurrent dynamics, while the non-minimum-phase component is addressed through the skip branch and a statistical FIR readout prior incorporated into prior-centered regularized online readout adaptation. We further derive an approximation-error bound that characterizes the resulting configured neural-receiver representation. Simulations over standardized 3GPP channels demonstrate the effectiveness of the configured neural receiver under extremely low pilot overhead.

</details>


### [320] [Can An Array of Magnetometers Replace a DVL - A Cramér-Rao Bound Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31217)
*Ludvig Lindström,Isaac Skog,Magnus Lundberg Nordenvaad,Andreas Gällström*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文推导了基于磁传感器阵列的一维磁速度估计的Cramér-Rao下界（CRLB），量化其潜在精度，并指出在空间磁变化充足且时变可校正时可达出口管制级DVL水平，否则需将传感器噪声降低约两个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 水下航行器依赖DVL辅助惯性导航等死推算系统定位，但DVL需主动声学测量，不适合隐蔽作业，因此需要静默的替代测速手段；磁速度估计是潜在方案，但户外环境中磁场空间变化小而时间变化大，可达精度不确定，需定量评估。

Method: 在不考虑平台扰动的一维情形下，针对不同传感器配置与观测模型，推导磁速度估计的CRLB，以量化磁传感器阵列的潜在精度。

Result: 分析表明：当空间磁场变化充分、且利用校正数据修正时变时，所得CRLB可与出口管制级DVL相当；若不对时变进行校正，则需将传感器噪声降低约两个数量级才能达到同等精度。

Conclusion: 现有磁传感器阵列在惯性导航系统中可能作为DVL的补充而非替代。

Abstract: Underwater vehicles rely on noisy dead-reckoning systems, such as Doppler velocity log (DVL)-aided inertial navigation systems, for positioning. However, DVLs rely on active acoustic measurements and are thus unsuitable for covert operations. Magnetic velocity estimation using a magnetic sensor array is a potential silent alternative. In outdoor environments, spatial variations in magnetic field magnitude are small, whereas temporal variations are large, making the achievable velocity-estimation accuracy uncertain. In this paper, Cramér-Rao lower bounds (CRLBs) are derived for magnetic velocity estimation using different sensor configurations and measurement models in one dimension, ignoring platform disturbances, to quantify the potential accuracy of magnetic sensor arrays. The analysis suggests that, when spatial variations are sufficient and temporal variations can be corrected using correction data, the resulting CRLB is comparable to that of an export-controlled DVL. If, instead, temporal variations are not corrected, the sensor noise must be reduced by around two orders of magnitude for the CRLB to reach the accuracy of an export-controlled DVL. Therefore, the results indicate that current magnetic sensor arrays may complement, rather than replace, DVLs in inertial navigation systems.

</details>


### [321] [Stochastic Geometry Analysis and Optimization for Multi-LEO Satellite-Assisted Communications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31373)
*Xu Hu,Bin Lin,Ping Wang,Xiao Lu,Weihua Zhuang,Shuang Qi*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 该文研究多颗低轨卫星（LEO）协作服务地面用户的通信网络，采用串行传输方案，借助随机几何推导在阴影莱斯衰落下含卫星失效概率的传输成功概率、平均速率与端到端时延，并提出簇化近似与一维搜索优化卫星数量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单星传输因星地复杂传播环境与不可忽略的卫星失效概率而可靠性不足，需要多星协作提升可靠性；同时需量化串行激活机制的端到端性能并优化服务卫星数量。

Method: 将卫星位置建模为球面上的二项点过程并按与用户的距离排序；采用串行通信方案（前序卫星均未达目标信噪比阈值时才激活下一颗）；利用随机几何推导串行方案下的整体传输成功概率、平均传输速率和端到端时延，同时计入阴影莱斯（SR）衰落与卫星失效概率；利用SR衰落的渐近表达式与Gamma分布给出两种特殊情形下端到端成功概率的渐近式，并提出基于分簇的近似方法计算整体成功概率；进而构建最大化“成功概率/端到端时延”比值的优化问题，用一维搜索求解。

Result: 得到可解析的整体传输成功概率、平均速率与端到端时延表达式；给出两种特殊情形下的渐近成功概率和分簇近似结果，并通过数值仿真验证分析准确性，揭示关键参数影响及不同星座高度下的最优服务卫星数量。

Conclusion: 多星串行协作可有效提升LEO网络可靠性，且存在与星座高度相关的最优服务卫星数量；所提解析与近似框架可支撑可靠性与时延的联合优化设计。

Abstract: Low Earth orbit (LEO) satellites are vital in providing seamless connectivities to ground users (GUs). However, complex satellite-to-ground propagation and non-negligible satellite failure probabilities make single-satellite transmission unreliable. To address this issue, we consider a multi-LEO-satellite communication network (mLEO-CN), where a typical GU is served by multiple LEO satellites. The satellite locations are modeled as a binomial point process on a sphere and ordered according to their distances to the GU. To improve communication reliability, a serial communication scheme is adopted, in which the subsequent satellite is activated only when all preceding satellites fail to satisfy the target signal-to-noise ratio threshold. By employing the tool of stochastic geometry, we derive key performance metrics, including overall transmission success probability, average transmission rate, and end-to-end delay under the serial communication scheme by incorporating both shadowed Rician (SR) fading and satellite failure probabilities. To improve analytical tractability, we derive asymptotic expressions for the end-to-end transmission success probability in two special cases by leveraging the asymptotic expression of the SR fading model and a Gamma-distribution, and further propose a cluster-based approximation approach for the overall transmission success probability. Building on these analyses, we formulate an optimization problem to maximize the ratio of the overall transmission success probability to the end-to-end delay, and obtain its solution using a one-dimensional search approach. Numerical results validate the analysis, reveal the impact of key parameters, and identify the optimal number of serving LEO satellites under different constellation altitudes.

</details>


### [322] [SR-ANM: A Square-Root Atomic Norm Minimization Estimator for Noise-Robust Direction-of-Arrival Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31509)
*Youval Klioui*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出平方根原子范数最小化（SR-ANM）估计器，用于单测量矢量（SMV）场景下的波达方向（DoA）估计，通过将残差项由平方L2范数改为L2范数，使原子范数的超参数对噪声水平更具鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典原子范数最小化（ANM）的无约束凸优化形式中，原子范数的正则化超参数需随噪声水平调整，缺乏对噪声的鲁棒性。受平方根LASSO（Square-root LASSO）启发，作者希望构建一种超参数不敏感于噪声水平的ANM变体。

Method: 在SMV设定下，将ANM中的残差项由平方L2范数替换为L2范数（即平方根形式），构造新的凸优化问题并给出SR-ANM估计器；理论分析其超参数相对于噪声水平的鲁棒性，并与经典ANM对比。

Result: 在0 dB至40 dB的宽信噪比范围内，采用检测概率与角度均方根误差（RMSE）作为指标进行实验验证，结果表明SR-ANM相较经典ANM具有更强的噪声鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 平方根形式的残差项可有效解耦超参数与噪声水平，SR-ANM在宽SNR范围内性能更稳定，为SMV场景下的DoA估计提供了一种对噪声更鲁棒的原子范数方法。

Abstract: This paper proposes a Square-root Atomic Norm Minimization (SR-ANM) estimator for direction-of-arrival (DoA) estimation in the single measurement vector (SMV) setting. This new framework, inspired by the Square-root Least Absolute Shrinkage and Selection Operator (Square-root LASSO), relies on a residual term based on the $L_{2}$-norm rather than the usual squared $L_{2}$-norm so as to obtain an estimator whereby the hyperparameter of the atomic norm in the unconstrained convex optimization problem exhibits robustness to the noise level compared to classical ANM. Experimental verification across a wide signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) range from 0 dB to 40 dB using the the probability of detection and the angular root-mean-squared error (RMSE) confirms the increased noise robustness of the proposed framework compared to ANM.

</details>


<div id='physics.app-ph'></div>

# physics.app-ph [[Back]](#toc)

### [323] [Phase-Matched Chirps for Energy-Efficient Excitation of Magneto-Mechanical Resonators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31296)
*Sarah Reiss,Fabian Mohn,Jonas Faltinath,Tobias Knopp*

Main category: physics.app-ph

TL;DR: 本研究通过仿真比较了线性啁啾与恒频磁场激励在磁机械谐振器(MMR)上的激励效率，发现正弦线性下啁啾信号产生的偏转角最大，最有利于降低能耗并提升测量时间分辨率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MMR是一类无源无线传感与追踪器件，其工作依赖振荡磁场激励与感应读出；关键难题在于如何生成高效激励信号以使传感器获得最大能量收集，从而降低能耗、提高测量时间分辨率。

Method: 采用仿真研究，针对啁啾磁场激励与传统恒频激励进行对比，并分别考察正弦波与矩形波两种波形（含线性上/下啁啾等形式），以偏转角为效率指标评估激励效果。

Result: 不同激励方案的效率存在差异；正弦线性下啁啾（sinusoidal linear down-chirp）激励使MMR获得最大偏转角，效率最优。

Conclusion: 正弦线性下啁啾磁场激励在提升能量收集效率方面优于恒频激励，具备降低系统能耗与改善测量时间分辨率的潜力；该结论基于仿真，尚需实验验证。

Abstract: Magneto-mechanical resonators (MMRs) are a recently proposed class of passive, wireless devices used for sensing and tracking. The operating principle of MMRs relies on an excitation of the sensor by oscillating magnetic fields, followed by an inductive readout to measure the sensor's dynamics. One challenge lies in generating efficient excitation signals to ensure maximum energy harvesting by the sensor. In this simulation study, we focus on chirped magnetic-field excitations and compare their performance with conventional constant-frequency excitation for both sinusoidal and rectangular waveforms. The results indicate varying levels of efficiency, with a sinusoidal linear down-chirp excitation signal yielding the largest deflection angle, offering the best potential for reducing the energy consumption and improving the temporal resolution of the measurement.

</details>


### [324] [Orbital-coherence memory in electrical transport and its self-consistent Maxwell response](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31390)
*Pengfei Zhu*

Main category: physics.app-ph

TL;DR: 论文提出一个约化模型，刻画"内电子相干仅当反馈到物理电流时才改变电输运"这一机制：由宇称相反的双方轨道哈密顿量导出电流耦合的轨道力，在明确的矩闭合与碰撞假设下得到被指数衰减振荡记忆支配的三态无源响应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 内电子相干并非总能影响输运，只有在它反馈作用于物理电流时才产生可观测效应。作者希望厘清该反馈的精确结论与实现微观机制所需假设之间的界线，并为轨道动力学—输运记忆—电磁可观测量之间建立有条件联系。

Method: 采用约化描述：构造宇称相反的双轨道哈密顿量，识别出电流耦合的轨道力；引入明确陈述的矩闭合与碰撞拟设，得到含指数衰减振荡记忆的三态无源响应；进一步做保持电荷守恒的空间延拓，通过正定能量收支耦合麦克斯韦方程，分离本构响应与纵向集体模、横向电磁模。

Result: 所得电导重新分配固定光学权重，并预言在其余参数固定时直流电导对相干阻尼呈非单调依赖；轨道约化通过共享的裸能级劈裂约束耦合强度与内禀频率，提供超越无约束谱拟合的检验；空间延拓给出正定能量收支与模式分离，并给出复电导与透射检验及有限带宽下参数可辨识性的极限。

Conclusion: 模型在轨道动力学、输运记忆与电磁可观测量之间建立了有条件的联系；仅凭电导不能确立唯一量子机制，仍需材料特定的碰撞计算与闭合误差评估。

Abstract: An internal electronic coherence changes electrical transport only when it feeds back on the physical current. We develop a reduced description of this feedback and distinguish its exact consequences from the assumptions required for a microscopic realization. An opposite-parity two-orbital Hamiltonian identifies a current-coupled orbital force. Under an explicitly stated moment closure and collision ansatz, it yields a passive three-state response with an exponentially damped oscillatory memory. The resulting conductivity redistributes a fixed optical weight and predicts a nonmonotonic dependence of dc conduction on coherence damping at fixed remaining parameters. The orbital reduction constrains the coupling and internal frequency through a shared bare splitting, providing a test beyond unconstrained spectral fitting. A charge-conserving spatial extension couples to Maxwell equations through a positive energy balance and separates the constitutive response from longitudinal collective and transverse electromagnetic modes. We formulate complex-conductivity and transmission tests, including the limits of parameter identification over a finite bandwidth. The model supplies a conditional connection between orbital dynamics, transport memory, and electromagnetic observables; conductivity alone does not establish a uniquely quantum mechanism, and a material-specific collision calculation and closure-error assessment remain necessary.

</details>


### [325] [Analytical Modeling of Modulated Heating for Three-Dimensional Anisotropic Optical Thermometry of Multilayered Cylinders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31424)
*William Spirnock,Dihui Wang,Heng Ban*

Main category: physics.app-ph

TL;DR: 提出一个解析框架，用于对正交各向异性任意分层圆柱体的频率依赖热输运建模，可作为光学热计量技术的前向模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有圆柱样品热计量方法只能解析各向同性热物性、假设界面完美、且缺乏温度空间分布的公式化描述；而制造工艺会引入显著各向异性比与方向依赖热输运，材料复杂性也导致热物性差异。
